defEn: the details of where a person lives or where a building is
defUz: biror kishi yashaydigan yoki bino joylashgan joyning manzili

examples.en: My address is 2, Green Road.
examples.grammar: 'There is/My ... is' tuzilmasi orqali joy/manzil bildiriladi; 'is' — to be fe'lining hozirgi zamon shakli.

examples.en: Could you write down your home address, please?
examples.uz: Iltimos, uy manzilingizni yozib bera olasizmi?
examples.grammar: Modal fe'l 'could' bilan xushmuomala iltimos; 'write down' — phrasal verb (yozib qo'ymoq).

defEn: a thick soft material used to cover floors
defUz: polni yopish uchun ishlatiladigan qalin yumshoq mato, gilam

examples.en: There is a red carpet on my bedroom floor.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a/an + ot' — birlikdagi narsa borligini bildiradi; 'on the floor' — joy predlogi.

examples.en: We need to clean the carpet in the hall.
examples.grammar: 'need to + infinitive' — zarurat; 'in the hall' — joy predloglik birikmasi.

defEn: the inside surface at the top of a room
defUz: xonaning yuqori ichki yuzasi, shift

examples.en: The ceiling of my room is white.
examples.grammar: 'The ... of my room is ...' — egalik ('of') va sifat (white) bilan tavsif; 'is' to be.

examples.en: There is a lamp hanging from the ceiling.
examples.grammar: 'hanging' — hozirgi zamon sifatdoshi (otni aniqlaydi); 'from' — manba/o'rin predlogi.

defEn: pieces of cloth that hang to cover a window
defUz: derazani yopish uchun osib qo'yiladigan matolar, parda

examples.en: There are green curtains on the windows.
examples.grammar: 'There are + ko'plik' — bir nechta narsa; 'curtains' har doim ko'plikda ishlatiladi.

examples.en: Please close the curtains; it is getting dark.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap (close ...); 'it is getting dark' — Present Continuous (asta o'zgarayotgan holat).

defEn: a set of rooms to live in on one floor of a building
defUz: binoning bir qavatidagi yashash uchun xonalar to'plami, kvartira

examples.en: We live in a flat in Leicester.
examples.grammar: 'live in a flat' — yashash joyi 'in' predlogi bilan; Present Simple (doimiy holat).

examples.en: They are looking for a flat to rent in the city.
examples.uz: Ular shaharда ijaraga olish uchun kvartira qidirishyapti.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous (are looking for); 'to rent' — maqsad bildiruvchi infinitiv.

defEn: a comfortable chair with supports for your arms
defUz: qo'l tirsaklari uchun tayanchi bor qulay o'rindiq, kreslo

examples.en: There is a big armchair in the living room.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + ot' birlik; 'in the living room' joy predlogi.

examples.en: He fell asleep in the armchair.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'fell asleep' (noto'g'ri fe'l fall->fell); 'in' joy predlogi.

defEn: a seat for one person with a back
defUz: bir kishi uchun suyanchiqli o'rindiq, stul

examples.en: She was sitting in her favourite chair.
examples.grammar: 'was sitting' — Past Continuous (o'tmishda davom etgan harakat); 'in her favourite chair'.

examples.en: Please take a chair and sit down.
examples.grammar: Ikki buyruq gap ('take', 'sit down'); 'sit down' — phrasal verb.

defEn: a piece of furniture that you sleep on
defUz: uxlash uchun ishlatiladigan mebel, yotoq

examples.en: I'm really tired, so I'm going to bed.
examples.uz: Men juda charchaganman, shuning uchun yotoqqa
examples.grammar: 'going to bed' — 'go to bed' iborasi (uyquga yotmoq); 'so' — natija bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: She makes her bed every morning before school.
examples.uz: U har kuni ertalab maktabdan oldin to'shagini yig'ishtiradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (makes); 'every morning' — takroriylik; 'before' — vaqt predlogi.

defEn: a piece of furniture with shelves for books
defUz: kitoblar uchun javonli mebel, kitob javoni

examples.en: The books are in the bookcase.
examples.grammar: 'The books are in the bookcase' — Present Simple (are), 'in' joy predlogi.

examples.en: She put the dictionary back on the bookcase.
examples.uz: U lug'atni kitob javoniga qaytarib qo'ydi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'put' (shakli o'zgarmaydi); 'back' ravishi (joyiga qaytarish).

defEn: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for storing things
defUz: narsalarni saqlash uchun eshikli va javonli mebel, shkaf

examples.en: It was an old kitchen cupboard.
examples.uz: U eski bir oshxona javoni edi.
examples.grammar: 'It was an old kitchen cupboard' — Past Simple to be (was) + sifat.

examples.en: The cups are in the cupboard above the sink.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (are); 'above' joy predlogi.

defEn: a comfortable seat for two or more people
defUz: ikki yoki undan ortiq kishi uchun qulay o'rindiq, divan

examples.en: Our new sofa is really comfortable.
examples.uz: Bizning yangi divanimiz juda ham qulay.
examples.grammar: 'Our new sofa is really comfortable' — egalik olmoshi + sifat; 'really' — kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: We bought a new sofa for the living room.
examples.uz: Biz mehmonxona uchun yangi divan sotib oldik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple (bought — noto'g'ri fe'l); 'for' — maqsad/atalganlik predlogi.

defEn: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
defUz: tekis ustki yuzasi va oyoqlari bor mebel, stol

examples.en: We eat at the kitchen table.
examples.grammar: 'eat at the kitchen table' — 'at' joy predlogi (stol yonida); Present Simple.

examples.en: Could you please clear the table after dinner?
examples.uz: Kechki ovqatdan keyin stolni yig'ishtira olasizmi?
examples.grammar: Modal 'could' bilan iltimos; 'after' — vaqt predlogi.

defEn: a large cupboard for keeping clothes in
defUz: kiyimlarni saqlash uchun katta shkaf, garderob

examples.en: Molly puts her clothes in the wardrobe.
examples.grammar: 'puts her clothes in the wardrobe' — Present Simple 3-shaxs (-s); 'in'.

examples.en: I need a bigger wardrobe for all my clothes.
examples.uz: Barcha kiyimlarim uchun kattaroq garderob kerak.
examples.grammar: 'need + ot'; 'bigger' — sifatning qiyosiy darajasi (-er).

defEn: an area of ground near a house for plants and flowers
defUz: uy yonidagi o'simlik va gullar ekiladigan yer, bog'

examples.en: There isn't a garden at this house.
examples.grammar: 'There isn't a garden' — 'there is' inkori (isn't); 'at this house' joy predlogi.

examples.en: My grandmother grows vegetables in her garden.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (grows); egalik 'her'; 'in' — joy predlogi.

defEn: the levels of a building, counted from the bottom upwards
defUz: binoning pastdan yuqoriga qarab sanaladigan qavatlari

examples.en: Our flat is on the second floor.
examples.grammar: 'on the ... floor' - qavatni bildiruvchi joy predloglik birikmasi; tartib son (second) bilan.

examples.en: The kitchen is on the ground floor.
examples.grammar: 'is on the ground floor' - 'to be' + joy predlogi; Britaniya inglizchasida 'ground floor' eng pastki qavat.

uz: uy ishlari: supur-sudur, chang artish va hokazo
defEn: the work of cleaning and looking after a house
defUz: uyni tozalash va parvarish qilish ishi, uy ishlari

examples.en: The children help with the housework.
examples.grammar: 'help with the housework' — 'help with + ot' tuzilmasi; Present Simple.

examples.en: I do the housework on Sundays.
examples.uz: Men yakshanba kunlari uy ishlarini qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (do); 'on Sundays' takroriy vaqt.

defEn: a small metal object used to open or close a lock
defUz: qulfni ochish yoki yopish uchun ishlatiladigan kichik metall buyum, kalit

examples.en: Is this the key to your flat?
examples.grammar: 'Is this the key to ...?' — Present Simple savol (to be); 'to' — biror narsaga tegishlilik.

examples.en: I have lost the key to the front door.
examples.uz: Men old eshik kalitini yo'qotib qo'ydim.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect (have lost) — natijasi hozir muhim bo'lgan o'tgan harakat.

defEn: a room with a bath or shower and often a toilet
defUz: vanna yoki dush, ko'pincha hojatxonasi bor xona, vannaxona

examples.en: Your toothbrush is in the bathroom.
examples.grammar: 'Your toothbrush is in the bathroom' — egalik (your) + Present Simple (is).

examples.en: There is a shower in the bathroom.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a' birlik; 'in' joy predlogi.

defEn: a room used for sleeping in
defUz: uxlash uchun ishlatiladigan xona, yotoqxona

examples.en: There are two bedrooms in my house.
examples.grammar: 'There are two bedrooms' — 'there are + son + ko'plik'.

examples.en: I share a bedroom with my brother.
examples.uz: Men yotoqxonani akam bilan baham ko'raman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (share); 'with' birgalik predlogi.

defEn: a room where you cook food
defUz: ovqat pishiriladigan xona, oshxona

examples.en: Is there a table in the kitchen?
examples.grammar: 'Is there a table in the kitchen?' — 'there is' savol shakli; 'in' joy predlogi.

examples.en: My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous (is cooking) — hozir davom etayotgan harakat.

defEn: a room in a house where people sit and relax
defUz: uydagi o'tirib dam olinadigan xona, mehmonxona

examples.en: We watch TV in the living room.
examples.grammar: 'We watch TV in the living room' — Present Simple; 'in' joy.

examples.en: The living room has a large window.
examples.grammar: 'has' — have fe'lining 3-shaxs birlik shakli.

defEn: one of the sides of a room or building
defUz: xona yoki binoning yon tomonlaridan biri, devor

examples.en: There is a photo on the wall.
examples.grammar: 'There is a photo on the wall' — 'there is'; 'on' yuzaga tegish predlogi.

examples.en: They painted the walls white.
examples.grammar: Past Simple (painted); 'white' — natija holatini bildiruvchi sifat.

defEn: to clean your teeth with a brush
defUz: tishlarni cho'tka bilan tozalash

examples.en: Do you brush your teeth before you go to bed?
examples.grammar: Savol shakli 'Do you ...?'; 'before you go to bed' vaqt ergash gapi.

examples.en: Remember to brush your teeth twice a day.
examples.uz: Tishlaringizni kuniga ikki marta yuvishni unutmang.
examples.grammar: Buyruq 'remember to + infinitive'; 'twice a day' takroriylik.

defEn: to remove dirt from something
defUz: biror narsadan kirni ketkazish, tozalash

examples.en: My mum cleans the house on Saturdays.
examples.grammar: 'cleans the house on Saturdays' — Present Simple (3-shaxs birlik -s); 'on' kunlar bilan.

examples.en: You should clean your room before guests arrive.
examples.uz: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin xonangizni tozalashingiz kerak.
examples.grammar: Modal 'should' (maslahat); 'before' — ergash gapни boshlovchi vaqt bog'lovchisi.

defEn: to remove dust from surfaces
defUz: yuzalardan changni artish, changini olish

examples.en: My sister and I dust the furniture once a week.
examples.uz: Singlim va men bir haftada bir marta
examples.grammar: 'dust the furniture once a week' — Present Simple; 'once a week' takroriylik.

examples.en: Could you dust the shelves, please?
examples.uz: Iltimos, javon tokchalarining changini arta olasizmi?
examples.grammar: Modal 'could' bilan iltimos.

defEn: to give food to an animal
defUz: hayvonga ovqat berish, ovqatlantirish

examples.en: Do you feed your dog every day?
examples.grammar: Savol 'Do you ...?'; 'every day' takroriy vaqt; Present Simple.

examples.en: Don't forget to feed the cat tonight.
examples.grammar: Inkor buyruq 'don't forget to + infinitive'; 'tonight' vaqt ravishi.

defEn: to get out of bed in the morning
defUz: ertalab o'rindan turish

examples.en: We get up at 7 am and go to school at 8 am.
examples.uz: Biz tonggi soat 7 da turamiz va 8 da maktabga
examples.grammar: 'We get up at 7 am' — phrasal verb 'get up'; 'at' aniq vaqt bilan; Present Simple.

examples.en: I had to get up early to catch the train.
examples.uz: Poyezdga ulgurish uchun erta turishimga to'g'ri keldi.
examples.grammar: 'had to' — 'have to' ning o'tgan zamoni (majburiyat); 'to catch' — maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: to put something back in its usual place
defUz: biror narsani odatdagi joyiga qaytarib qo'yish

examples.en: Put your books away now. It's time to go home.
examples.uz: Endi kitoblaringizni joyiga qo'ying. Uyga ketish
examples.grammar: 'Put your books away' — phrasal verb 'put away' (ot orasida); buyruq gap.

examples.en: She always puts her toys away after playing.
examples.uz: U o'ynagandan keyin doim o'yinchoqlarini joyiga qo'yadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (puts); 'after playing' — 'after + V-ing'.

uz: baham ko'rmoq, bo'lishmoq, birga foydalanmoq · baham ko'rmoq, bo'lishmoq, ulashmoq · birga ishlatmoq, birga foydalanmoq
defEn: to use or have something together with others
defUz: biror narsani boshqalar bilan birga ishlatish yoki bo'lishish

examples.en: Do you share a bedroom with your sister?
examples.grammar: Savol 'Do you share ...?'; 'with' birgalik predlogi.

examples.en: We should share the work equally.
examples.grammar: Modal 'should' (maslahat); 'equally' tarz ravishi.

examples.en: Do you want to share a pizza with me?
examples.uz: Men bilan birga pitsa yeyishni xohlaysizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Do you want + to + share + ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'l, 'to share' infinitiv.

examples.en: I share my books with my brother.
examples.grammar: 'share + ot + with + ot' - Present Simple, 'with' predlogi birga ishlatadigan kishini bildiradi.

defEn: to make a place neat and in order
defUz: joyni tartibli va saranjom holatga keltirish, yig'ishtirish

examples.en: I tidy my room at the weekend.
examples.uz: Men xonamni dam olish kunida yig'ishtiraman.
examples.grammar: 'I tidy my room at the weekend' — Present Simple; 'at the weekend' vaqt birikmasi.

examples.en: Please tidy up your desk before you leave.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap; 'tidy up' — phrasal verb; 'before you leave' — vaqt ergash gapi.

defEn: to clean something with water
defUz: biror narsani suv bilan tozalash, yuvish

examples.en: We wash our hands in the bathroom.
examples.grammar: 'We wash our hands' — Present Simple; 'in the bathroom' joy.

examples.en: I usually wash the dishes after dinner.
examples.uz: Men odatda kechki ovqatdan keyin idishlarni yuvaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'usually' takroriylik ravishi; 'after' vaqt predlogi.

defEn: to pour water on plants
defUz: o'simliklarga suv quyish, sug'orish

examples.en: Please water the flowers in the garden.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap 'Please water ...'; 'in the garden' joy predlogi.

examples.en: Remember to water the plants while I am away.
examples.grammar: 'while + gap' — vaqt ergash gapi; 'am away' to be + ravish.

examples.en: We must drink water every day.
examples.uz: Biz har kuni suv ichishimiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'We must drink water every day' - 'must + infinitiv' modal fe'l majburiyatni bildiradi, 'every day' takroriy harakatni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I drink water when I am thirsty.
examples.grammar: 'drink + water' - Present Simple, 'when' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi.

defEn: pleasant and easy to use, sit in or wear
defUz: yoqimli, foydalanish yoki o'tirish qulay bo'lgan

examples.en: This is a very comfortable armchair.
examples.grammar: 'This is a very comfortable armchair' — to be + sifat; 'very' kuchaytiruvchi.

examples.en: These shoes are very comfortable for walking.
examples.uz: Bu poyabzal yurish uchun juda qulay.
examples.grammar: 'for walking' — 'for + V-ing' (maqsad).

examples.en: I like these trainers. They're really comfortable for kicking a football.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'I like these trainers' - 'these' ko'rsatish olmoshi ko'plikda; 'They're really comfortable' - to be fe'li, 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'for kicking' - 'for + -ing' shakli.

examples.en: This bed is very comfortable.
examples.grammar: 'This + ot + is + sifat' - to be fe'li; 'very' - kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'comfortable' - sifat.

defEn: happening or done every day
defUz: har kuni sodir bo'ladigan yoki bajariladigan

examples.en: My dad has a daily walk before work.
examples.uz: Dadam ish(ga ketish)dan oldin har kunlik piyoda sayrga
examples.grammar: 'a daily walk' — 'daily' sifat sifatida otni aniqlamoqda.

examples.en: The library is open on a daily basis.
examples.grammar: 'on a daily basis' — har kunlik degan ibora.

defEn: putting a lot of effort into work
defUz: ishga ko'p kuch va g'ayrat sarflaydigan, mehnatkash

examples.en: Sam is hard-working. He always gets high test scores.
examples.uz: Sem mehnatkash. U har doim testlardan
examples.grammar: 'Sam is hard-working' — to be + sifat; ikkinchi gap natijani izohlaydi.

examples.en: She is a hard-working and reliable employee.
examples.grammar: Ikki sifat 'and' bilan bog'langan; 'employee' ot.

defEn: not wanting to work or do anything
defUz: ishlashni yoki biror narsa qilishni istamaydigan, dangasa

examples.en: Evie is lazy. She doesn't study.
examples.grammar: 'Evie is lazy' — to be + sifat; 'doesn't study' — Present Simple inkor.

examples.en: Don't be so lazy; help me with the dishes.
examples.uz: Bunchalik dangasa bo'lma; idish yuvishga yordam ber.
examples.grammar: Inkor buyruq 'don't be'; 'help me with' tuzilmasi.

defEn: dirty or not tidy
defUz: kir yoki tartibsiz, betartib

examples.en: Your room is messy. Put your things away in the cupboard.
examples.grammar: 'Your room is messy' — to be + sifat; keyin buyruq gap beriladi.

examples.en: His handwriting is very messy and hard to read.
examples.uz: Uning qo'lyozmasi juda betartib va o'qish qiyin.
examples.grammar: 'hard to read' — 'sifat + to + infinitive'.

defEn: to or on a lower floor of a building
defUz: binoning pastki qavatiga yoki qavatida, pastga

examples.en: I washed my face and went downstairs for breakfast.
examples.grammar: 'went downstairs for breakfast' — 'downstairs' ravish (pastga); 'for' maqsad.

examples.en: Wait for me downstairs, please.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap; 'downstairs' bu yerда joy ravishi (pastda).

defEn: to or on a higher floor of a building
defUz: binoning yuqori qavatiga yoki qavatida, tepaga

examples.en: My sister went upstairs to do her homework in her room.
examples.grammar: 'went upstairs to do her homework' — 'upstairs' ravish; 'to do' maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: The bathroom is upstairs, on the right.
examples.grammar: 'upstairs' joy ravishi; 'on the right' yo'nalish birikmasi.

defEn: to put your clothes on
defUz: kiyimlarini kiyish, kiyinish

examples.en: I can get dressed in two minutes when I'm late for school.
examples.grammar: 'get dressed in two minutes' — 'get dressed' iborasi; 'when' vaqt ergash gapi.

examples.en: Get dressed quickly, we are going to be late!
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap; 'be going to' — yaqin kelajak/bashorat.

examples.en: I get dressed every morning.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'get dressed' - ibora (kiyinmoq); 'every morning' - takroriy vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to prepare yourself before doing something
defUz: biror ishdan oldin o'zini tayyorlash

examples.en: We get up at 7.30 am and get ready for school.
examples.uz: Biz tonggi soat 7.30 da turamiz va maktabga
examples.grammar: 'get ready for school' — 'get ready for + ot'; Present Simple.

examples.en: It takes me an hour to get ready in the morning.
examples.grammar: 'It takes + vaqt + to + infinitive' tuzilmasi.

defEn: to leave for home or go to sleep
defUz: uyga jo'nash yoki uxlashga yotish

examples.en: We go to bed at about 10 pm.
examples.uz: Biz taxminan tungi soat 10 larda uyquga yotamiz.
examples.grammar: 'go to bed at about 10 pm' — 'go to bed' iborasi; 'at about' taxminiy vaqt.

examples.en: I want to go home early today.
examples.grammar: 'want to + infinitive'; 'go home' (predlogsiz) iborasi.

uz: biron kimga biron ishda yordam bermoq
defEn: to make a task easier for another person
defUz: boshqa odamga biror ishni osonlashtirib yordam berish

examples.en: My mum helps me with my homework.
examples.uz: Oyim menga uyga vazifalarim bilan yordamlashadilar.
examples.grammar: 'helps me with my homework' — 'help + kishi + with + ot' tuzilmasi.

examples.en: Can you help me with this exercise?
examples.uz: Bu mashqда menga yordam bera olasizmi?
examples.grammar: Modal 'can' savol; 'help ... with ...' tuzilmasi.

defEn: to arrange the covers neatly on a bed
defUz: yotoqning ustini saranjom qilib yig'ishtirish

examples.en: Tidy up your room. And don't forget to make your bed!
examples.grammar: 'don't forget to make your bed' — 'make your bed' iborasi; inkor buyruq.

examples.en: I make my bed as soon as I wake up.
examples.grammar: 'as soon as' — vaqt bog'lovchisi (darhol).

defEn: to make a place dirty or untidy
defUz: joyni kir yoki betartib qilib qo'yish

examples.en: My brother makes a mess in our bedroom and I have to clean it.
examples.grammar: 'makes a mess ... and I have to clean it' — 'make a mess' iborasi; 'have to' majburiyat.

examples.en: Try not to make a mess in the kitchen.
examples.grammar: 'try not to + infinitive' — inkor harakat.

defEn: to prepare a small amount of food to eat
defUz: yeyish uchun ozgina yegulik tayyorlash

examples.en: When I'm late for work, my wife makes a snack for me.
examples.grammar: 'makes a snack for me' — 'make a snack' iborasi; 'for' atalganlik.

examples.en: I will make a snack if you are hungry.
examples.uz: Agar och bo'lsang, men tezgina yegulik tayyorlayman.
examples.grammar: Shartli gap 'if + Present, will + infinitive' (1-tur).

uz: biron kimga biron narsa qilishni aytmoq, buyurmoq
defEn: to order or instruct a person to do an action
defUz: biror kishiga biror ish qilishni buyurish yoki aytish

examples.en: My teachers told me to do a project.
examples.uz: O'qituvchilarim menga bir loyihani amalga oshirishni
examples.grammar: 'told me to do a project' — 'tell + kishi + to + infinitive'.

examples.en: The teacher told us to be quiet.
examples.grammar: Past Simple (told); 'to be quiet' — infinitiv.

defEn: to have the same opinion as someone
defUz: kimdir bilan bir xil fikrda bo'lish, fikriga qo'shilish

examples.en: I totally agree with you!
examples.grammar: 'I totally agree with you' — 'agree with + kishi'; 'totally' ravish.

examples.en: Most people agree that exercise is important.
examples.grammar: 'agree that + gap' tuzilmasi; Present Simple.

defEn: to have a different opinion from someone
defUz: kimdir bilan har xil fikrda bo'lish, fikriga qo'shilmaslik

examples.en: We sometimes disagree but we never fight.
examples.uz: Biz ba'zan kelisha olmaymiz, lekin hech qachon
examples.grammar: 'We sometimes disagree but never fight' — 'but' zidlovchi bog'lovchi.

examples.en: I disagree with that decision.
examples.uz: Men bu qaror bilan rozi emasman.
examples.grammar: 'disagree with + ot'; Present Simple.

defEn: not pleasant or easy to use or sit in
defUz: yoqimsiz yoki foydalanish noqulay bo'lgan, noqulay

examples.en: This chair is uncomfortable
examples.uz: can I sit there? – Bu stul noqulay ekan–anavi yerda o'tirsam
examples.grammar: 'This chair is uncomfortable' — to be + sifat (un- inkor old qo'shimchasi).

examples.en: I felt uncomfortable during the meeting.
examples.uz: Yig'ilish davomida o'zimni noqulay his qildim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'felt'; 'during' vaqt predlogi.

examples.en: These shoes are uncomfortable.
examples.grammar: 'These + ot + are + sifat' - to be fe'li ko'plikda; 'uncomfortable' - sifat; 'are' - ko'plik shakli.

defEn: a period of 24 hours
defUz: 24 soatlik vaqt oralig'i, kun

examples.en: We spent five days in Paris.
examples.grammar: 'We spent five days in Paris' — Past Simple (spent); 'days' ko'plik.

examples.en: Have a nice day!
examples.grammar: Tilak/buyruq iborasi ('Have a ... day').

defEn: a substance such as mud or dust that makes things unclean
defUz: narsalarni kir qiladigan loy yoki chang kabi modda, kir

examples.en: The white rug really shows the dirt.
examples.uz: Oq gilamcha rostdan ham kirni ko'rsatadi.
examples.grammar: 'The white rug shows the dirt' — Present Simple; 'shows' 3-shaxs birlik.

examples.en: There was a lot of dirt under the bed.
examples.uz: Karavot tagida juda ko'p kir bor edi.
examples.grammar: 'There was' (Past); 'dirt' sanalmaydigan ot (a lot of).

defEn: not clean
defUz: toza emas, kir, iflos

examples.en: When my clothes are dirty, I wash them and iron them.
examples.grammar: 'When my clothes are dirty, I wash them' — vaqt ergash gapi ('when'); Present Simple.

examples.en: Your hands are dirty; go and wash them.
examples.grammar: Ikki buyruq 'go and wash'; 'dirty' sifat.

defEn: covered with dust
defUz: chang bilan qoplangan, chang bosgan

examples.en: The old house was very dusty and dirty.
examples.uz: Eski uy juda chang bosgan va kir edi.
examples.grammar: 'The old house was very dusty and dirty' — Past to be (was) + ikki sifat.

examples.en: The road was dusty after the dry summer.
examples.uz: Quruq yozdan keyin yo'l changga botgandi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple (was); 'after' vaqt predlogi.

defEn: the state of not wanting to work
defUz: ishlashni istamaslik holati, dangasalik

examples.en: You haven't cleaned your room. I don't like your laziness!
examples.grammar: 'I don't like your laziness' — 'laziness' mavhum ot (-ness qo'shimchasi).

examples.en: His laziness caused a lot of problems.
examples.uz: Uning dangasaligi ko'p muammo keltirib chiqardi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple (caused); 'laziness' — 'lazy' sifatidan yasalgan ot.

defEn: a party to celebrate someone's birthday
defUz: kishining tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun uyushtiriladigan bazm

examples.en: I’m going to my BFF’s birthday party next week.
examples.uz: Kelasi hafta men eng yaqin do'stimning
examples.grammar: 'be going to + fe'l' - Present Continuous yordamida rejalashtirilgan kelajak harakatini bildiradi - 'my BFF's' egalik shaklini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We have a birthday party for my mum.
examples.uz: Biz onam uchun tug'ilgan kun bazmini o'tkazamiz.
examples.grammar: 'have a + ot' - Present Simple - bazm o'tkazishni bildiradi - 'for my mum' predlogli iborasi maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

uz: chiroyli va bashang kiyimlar kiyib boriladigan bazm, maskarad
defEn: a party where people wear funny or special clothes
defUz: odamlar kulgili yoki maxsus kiyimlar kiyib boradigan bazm

examples.en: I'm going to a fancy dress party.
examples.grammar: 'be going to + ot' - Present Continuous bilan kelajak rejasini bildiradi - 'a' artikli birlikdagi sanaladigan otni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I love a fancy dress party.
examples.grammar: 'love + a + ot' - Present Simple - yoqtirishni bildiradi - 'a' artikli birlikdagi otni ko'rsatadi.

uz: shunaqangi bazmki, unda siz va boshqa mehmonlar bazmni uyushtirgan do'stingizning uyida tunab qolasiz bir kecha (asosan yoshlar bunday bazm uyushtirishadi)
defEn: a party where young friends stay the night at one house
defUz: yosh do'stlar bir uyda tunab qoladigan bazm

examples.en: Our neighbours invited our son to a pyjama party.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'invited' fe'lining II shakli o'tgan zamonni bildiradi - 'to a pyjama party' predlogli ibora harakat yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My friends come to my pyjama party.
examples.grammar: 'come to + ot' - Present Simple - kelishni bildiradi - 'my' egalik olmoshi bazm egasini ko'rsatadi.

uz: bazm sababchisiga aytilmay tashkillashtirilgan bazm, syurpriz qilingan bazm
defEn: a party that is secret until the person arrives
defUz: bazm sababchisiga aytilmay, sir saqlangan holda tayyorlanadigan bazm

examples.en: She's planning a surprise party for her boyfriend.
examples.uz: U yoqtirgan yigiti uchun syurpriz bazm
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is planning' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi - 'for her boyfriend' predlogli ibora kim uchunligini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We plan a surprise party for dad.
examples.uz: Biz dadam uchun syurpriz bazm rejalashtiramiz.
examples.grammar: 'plan a + ot' - Present Simple - rejalashtirishni bildiradi - 'for dad' predlogli ibora kim uchunligini ko'rsatadi.

uz: taxtachada o'ynaladigan o'yin, misol uchun shaxmat, monopoliya, narda
defEn: a game you play on a board, like chess
defUz: taxtacha ustida o'ynaladigan o'yin, masalan shaxmat

examples.en: Backgammon is my grandad's favourite board game.
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l ega va kesimni bog'laydi - 'my grandad's' egalik shaklini bildiradi.

examples.en: We play a board game at home.
examples.grammar: 'play a + ot' - Present Simple - o'ynashni bildiradi - 'at home' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a game you play on a computer
defUz: kompyuterda o'ynaladigan o'yin

examples.en: My missus doesn't like computer games.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'doesn't like' uchinchi shaxs birlikda 'does not' yordamchi fe'li bilan yasaladi - 'computer games' ko'plikdagi ot.

examples.en: I play computer games after school.
examples.uz: Men maktabdan keyin kompyuter o'yinlari o'ynayman.
examples.grammar: 'play + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple - odatiy harakatni bildiradi - 'after school' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a game you play on a screen
defUz: ekranda o'ynaladigan o'yin

examples.en: We play video games every day.
examples.uz: Biz har kuni video o'yinlar o'ynaymiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'play' odatiy harakatni bildiradi - 'every day' ravishi takrorlanish chastotasini, 'video games' ko'plikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My brother likes video games.
examples.grammar: 'like + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple - 'likes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi.

defEn: a thing you use to take photos
defUz: rasm olish uchun ishlatiladigan asbob

examples.en: My new camera takes great pictures.
examples.uz: Mening yangi fotokameram zo'r rasmlar oladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'takes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi - 'my new camera' ega, 'great pictures' ko'plikdagi to'ldiruvchi.

examples.en: I have a new camera.
examples.grammar: 'have a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - egalikni bildiradi - 'a' artikli birlikdagi otni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a film with drawings, often for children
defUz: rasmlardan iborat film, ko'pincha bolalar uchun, multfilm

examples.en: Megan's watching cartoons on TV now.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is watching' qisqargan shakli (Megan's) hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi - 'on TV' va 'now' joy va vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I watch cartoons in the morning.
examples.grammar: 'watch + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple - odatiy harakatni bildiradi - 'in the morning' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a place where you go to watch films
defUz: film tomosha qilish uchun boriladigan joy, kinoteatr

examples.en: Do you like watching films at the cinema or on TV?
examples.grammar: so'roq gap - Present Simple - 'Do you like' yordamchi fe'l bilan savol yasaladi - 'watching' gerundiy, 'at the cinema' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We go to the cinema on Friday.
examples.grammar: 'go to the + ot' - Present Simple - borishni bildiradi - 'on Friday' predlogli ibora kunni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a place or party where people dance to music
defUz: odamlar musiqaga raqsga tushadigan joy yoki bazm, diskoteka

examples.en: I danced a lot at the school disco.
examples.uz: Men maktab diskotekasida rosa raqsga tushdim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'danced' fe'lning II shakli o'tgan zamonni bildiradi - 'a lot' ravishi miqdorni, 'at the school disco' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: There is a disco at our school.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + ot' - Present Simple - biror narsa borligini bildiradi - 'at our school' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a story you watch on a screen, a movie
defUz: ekranda tomosha qilinadigan hikoya, kino

examples.en: Let's stay in and watch a film.
examples.uz: Keling, uyda qolib film tomosha qilamiz.
examples.grammar: buyruq gap - 'Let's + fe'l' taklifni bildiradi - 'stay in' va 'watch' fe'llari 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: I watch a film at the weekend.
examples.uz: Men dam olish kunlari film ko'raman.
examples.grammar: 'watch a + ot' - Present Simple - tomosha qilishni bildiradi - 'at the weekend' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: traditional music of a country or people
defUz: xalqning an'anaviy musiqasi, milliy musiqa

examples.en: We sometimes listen to folk music.
examples.uz: Biz ba'zan milliy musiqa tinglab turamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'listen to' fe'li 'to' predlogini talab qiladi - 'sometimes' ravishi takrorlanish chastotasini bildiradi.

examples.en: My grandad likes folk music.
examples.grammar: 'like + ot' - Present Simple - 'likes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi.

uz: pop musiqa: 1950-yildan beri mashhur bo'lib kelayotgan, kuchli ritmga ammo oddiy ohangga ega bo'lgan musiqa turi
defEn: popular modern music with a strong beat
defUz: kuchli ritmga ega bo'lgan zamonaviy ommabop musiqa

examples.en: They listen to pop music and watch trash TV all day.
examples.uz: Ular pop musiqasi tinglaydilar va kuni
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'listen to' va 'watch' fe'llari 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan - 'all day' davomiylikni bildiradi.

examples.en: I listen to pop music every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni pop musiqa tinglayman.
examples.grammar: 'listen to + ot' - Present Simple - tinglashni bildiradi - 'every day' ravishi takrorlanishni ko'rsatadi.

uz: rep musiqa: ushbu musiqa turida qo'shiq so'zlari kuylanmaydi, balki tez aytiladi
defEn: music where the words are spoken fast, not sung
defUz: so'zlar kuylanmay, tez aytiladigan musiqa turi, rep

examples.en: He's using his rap music to spread the message that violence is wrong.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is using' qisqargan shakli (He's) hozirgi harakatni bildiradi - 'to spread' infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi - 'that' ergash gapni boshlaydi.

examples.en: My friend loves rap music.
examples.uz: Do'stim rep musiqani juda yaxshi ko'radi.
examples.grammar: 'love + ot' - Present Simple - 'loves' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi.

uz: rok musiqa: elektrik gitara va barabanlarda ijro etiladigan baland shovqinli musiqa turi
defEn: loud music played with electric guitars and drums
defUz: elektrgitara va barabanlarda ijro etiladigan baland musiqa, rok

examples.en: He is a big name in the world of rock music.
examples.uz: U rok musiqasi olamida mashhur inson.
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'a big name' ega-kesim, 'in the world of rock music' predlogli ibora sohani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I like rock music a lot.
examples.uz: Men rok musiqani juda yaxshi ko'raman.
examples.grammar: 'like + ot' - Present Simple - yoqtirishni bildiradi - 'a lot' ravishi darajani ko'rsatadi.

defEn: time when you are not working or busy
defUz: ishlamayotgan yoki band bo'lmagan paytdagi vaqt, bo'sh vaqt

examples.en: What do you do in your free time?
examples.grammar: so'roq gap - Present Simple - 'What do you do' yordamchi 'do' bilan savol yasaladi - 'in your free time' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I read books in my free time.
examples.grammar: 'read + ot' - Present Simple - odatiy harakatni bildiradi - 'in my free time' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: something you like to do in your free time
defUz: bo'sh vaqtda yoqtirib qilinadigan mashg'ulot, hobbi

examples.en: My favourite hobby is reading.
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l ega va kesimni bog'laydi - 'reading' gerundiy ot vazifasida kelmoqda.

examples.en: My hobby is drawing.
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'drawing' gerundiy ot vazifasini bajaradi.

defEn: a musical instrument you hit with sticks
defUz: tayoqchalar bilan urib chalinadigan musiqa asbobi, baraban

examples.en: Leo plays the drums in his band.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'plays' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi - 'the drums' musiqa asbobi oldidan 'the' artikli ishlatiladi.

examples.en: I want to play the drums.
examples.grammar: 'want to + fe'l' - Present Simple - istakni bildiradi - 'the drums' asbob oldidan 'the' artikli keladi.

defEn: a musical instrument with strings
defUz: torlari bo'lgan musiqa asbobi, gitara

examples.en: I want to learn to play the guitar.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want to + fe'l' istakni bildiradi - 'to learn to play' ketma-ket infinitivlar - 'the guitar' asbob oldidan 'the' artikli keladi.

examples.en: She plays the guitar very well.
examples.grammar: 'play the + ot' - Present Simple - 'plays' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s oladi - 'very well' ravishi tarzni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a large musical instrument with black and white keys
defUz: qora va oq tugmalari bo'lgan katta musiqa asbobi, pianino

examples.en: There's a piano in my house, but I don't know how to play it.
examples.grammar: 'There's a + ot' biror narsa borligini bildiradi - 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni, 'don't know how to play' inkor shaklini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My sister plays the piano.
examples.grammar: 'play the + ot' - Present Simple - 'plays' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s oladi - 'the piano' asbob oldidan 'the' artikli keladi.

defEn: a brass musical instrument you blow into
defUz: puflab chalinadigan mis musiqa asbobi, truba

examples.en: Liam is learning to play the trumpet.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is learning' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi - 'to play' infinitiv, 'the trumpet' asbob oldidan 'the' artikli keladi.

examples.en: I can play the trumpet.
examples.grammar: 'can + fe'l' - modal fe'l qobiliyatni bildiradi - 'the trumpet' asbob oldidan 'the' artikli keladi.

defEn: a small musical instrument you play with a bow
defUz: kamoncha bilan chalinadigan kichik musiqa asbobi, skripka

examples.en: I like listening to him play the violin.
examples.uz: Men uning skripka chalishini tinglashni yotiraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'like' fe'lidan keyin 'listening' gerundiy keladi - 'him play' tuzilmasida 'play' infinitiv toza shaklda ishlatiladi.

examples.en: My friend plays the violin.
examples.grammar: 'play the + ot' - Present Simple - 'plays' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s oladi - 'the violin' asbob oldidan 'the' artikli keladi.

defEn: a drawing or photo of something
defUz: biror narsaning rasmi yoki surati

examples.en: This picture shows me on my birthday.
examples.uz: Bu surat meni tug'ilgan kunimni ko'rsatadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'shows' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi - 'This picture' ega, 'on my birthday' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I draw a picture of my cat.
examples.grammar: 'draw a + ot' - Present Simple - chizishni bildiradi - 'of my cat' predlogli ibora rasm mavzusini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a piece of music with words you sing
defUz: so'zlari kuylanadigan musiqa parchasi, qo'shiq

examples.en: I want to play that song again. I like it.
examples.uz: Bu qo'shiqni qayta qo'yishni xohlayman. U menga
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want to play' istakni bildiradi - 'that song' ko'rsatuvchi olmosh, 'again' ravishi takrorlashni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: This is my favourite song.
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'my favourite' egalik va sifat otni aniqlaydi.

defEn: a place where you watch plays on a stage
defUz: sahnada spektakllar tomosha qilinadigan joy, teatr

examples.en: There isn't a theatre in my town
examples.uz: only a cinema. – Mening shahrimda teatr mavjud emas–bor
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'There isn't a + ot' biror narsa yo'qligini bildiradi - 'in my town' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We go to the theatre on Sunday.
examples.grammar: 'go to the + ot' - Present Simple - borishni bildiradi - 'on Sunday' predlogli ibora kunni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a show on television
defUz: televizordagi ko'rsatuv, teledastur

examples.en: It's my favourite TV programme
examples.uz: I never miss an episode. – U mening sevimli teledasturim–men
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'It's' qisqargan shakli (It is) bog'lovchi fe'l - 'my favourite' egalik va sifat otni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: I watch my favourite TV programme at night.
examples.grammar: 'watch + ot' - Present Simple - tomosha qilishni bildiradi - 'at night' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to make a picture with a pen or pencil
defUz: qalam yoki ruchka bilan rasm yasamoq, chizmoq

examples.en: Katie is drawing pictures in her sketchpad.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is drawing' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi - 'pictures' ko'plikdagi to'ldiruvchi, 'in her sketchpad' joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I like to draw animals.
examples.grammar: 'like to + fe'l' - Present Simple - yoqtirishni bildiradi - 'animals' ko'plikdagi to'ldiruvchi.

uz: rohatlanmoq, mazza qilmoq, yoqtirmoq · rohatlanmoq, lazzat olmoq, yoqtirmoq
defEn: to like doing something
defUz: biror ishni qilishdan zavqlanmoq, yoqtirmoq

examples.en: My sister and I enjoy going to the cinema.
examples.uz: Singlim va men kinoga borishni yoqtiramiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'enjoy' fe'lidan keyin 'going' gerundiy keladi - 'My sister and I' qo'shma ega, 'to the cinema' joy yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I enjoy playing football.
examples.grammar: 'enjoy + gerundiy' - Present Simple - 'enjoy' dan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida keladi.

examples.en: I don't enjoy travelling on a plane but I love trains.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'enjoy' fe'lidan keyin 'going' gerundiy keladi - 'My sister and I' qo'shma ega, 'to the cinema' joy yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi.

uz: biror tadbirda qatnashish yoki vaqtni biror joyda o'tkazish uchun uydan chiqmoq
defEn: to leave home to do something fun
defUz: vaqt o'tkazish yoki biror tadbir uchun uydan chiqmoq

examples.en: We don't go out when we have school the next day.
examples.uz: Ertasi kuni maktab bo'lganda biz ko'chaga
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'don't go out' phrasal fe'l 'do not' bilan yasaladi - 'when' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi.

examples.en: We go out with friends on Saturday.
examples.uz: Biz shanba kuni do'stlar bilan tashqariga chiqamiz.
examples.grammar: 'go out' phrasal fe'l - Present Simple - 'with friends' predlogli ibora hamrohlikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to make sounds because something is funny
defUz: biror narsa kulgili bo'lgani uchun ovoz chiqarmoq, kulmoq

examples.en: My sister is laughing at me! She thinks I'm funny!
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is laughing' hozirgi harakatni bildiradi - 'at me' predlogli ibora yo'nalishni, 'thinks' Present Simple fikrni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We laugh at the funny film.
examples.grammar: 'laugh at + ot' - Present Simple - 'at' predlogi kulgi sababini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: When I heard her excuse, I just laughed.
examples.uz: Uning bahonasini eshitganimda, men shunchaki kulib
examples.grammar: 'When + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi. 'heard' - 'hear' fe'lining Past Simple shakli. 'just laughed' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi.

examples.en: The children laugh and play.
examples.grammar: 'laugh and play' - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki fe'lni bog'laydi, Present Simple, ega ko'plikda.

defEn: to make a picture using colours
defUz: bo'yoqlar yordamida rasm yasamoq, bo'yamoq

examples.en: I want to learn to paint pictures.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want to learn to paint' ketma-ket infinitivlar istakni bildiradi - 'pictures' ko'plikdagi to'ldiruvchi.

examples.en: I paint a picture of the sea.
examples.grammar: 'paint a + ot' - Present Simple - chizishni bildiradi - 'of the sea' predlogli ibora rasm mavzusini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to rest and feel calm
defUz: dam olib, xotirjam bo'lmoq, hordiq chiqarmoq

examples.en: After school, I come home to relax.
examples.uz: Maktabdan so'ng, men dam olish uchun uyga kelaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'come home to relax' tuzilmasida 'to relax' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi - 'After school' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I relax at home in the evening.
examples.grammar: 'relax' fe'l - Present Simple - 'at home' va 'in the evening' predlogli iboralar joy va vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to use time doing something
defUz: vaqtni biror ishga sarflamoq, o'tkazmoq

examples.en: Do you spend a lot of time in your bedroom?
examples.grammar: so'roq gap - Present Simple - 'Do you spend' yordamchi 'do' bilan savol yasaladi - 'a lot of time' miqdorni, 'in your bedroom' joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I spend a lot of time with my family.
examples.uz: Men oilam bilan ko'p vaqt o'tkazaman.
examples.grammar: 'spend + time' - Present Simple - 'a lot of' miqdorni, 'with my family' hamrohlikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to make music with your voice
defUz: ovoz bilan musiqa ijro etmoq, kuylamoq

examples.en: Oscar is singing and playing the guitar now.
examples.uz: Oskar hozir qo'shiq kuylayapti va gitara chalyapti.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is singing' va 'playing' qo'shma harakatlar 'and' bilan bog'langan - 'now' hozirgi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I like to sing in the shower.
examples.grammar: 'like to + fe'l' - Present Simple - yoqtirishni bildiradi - 'in the shower' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

uz: uyda qolmoq, biror joyga borishni o'rniga vaqtni uyda o'tkazmoq
defEn: to stay at home instead of going out
defUz: tashqariga chiqmasdan uyda qolmoq

examples.en: I like to stay in and watch TV on Sundays.
examples.uz: Yakshanba kunlari men uyda qolib televizor tomosha
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'like to stay in' istakni bildiradi - 'stay in' phrasal fe'l, 'and watch TV' bog'langan harakat, 'on Sundays' vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We stay in when it is cold.
examples.grammar: 'stay in' phrasal fe'l - Present Simple - 'when' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi.

defEn: to look at something on TV for a time
defUz: televizordagi narsani tomosha qilmoq

examples.en: Do you watch TV every day?
examples.uz: Siz har kuni televizor tomosha qilasizmi?
examples.grammar: so'roq gap - Present Simple - 'Do you watch' yordamchi 'do' bilan savol yasaladi - 'every day' ravishi takrorlanish chastotasini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I watch TV after dinner.
examples.uz: Men kechki ovqatdan keyin televizor ko'raman.
examples.grammar: 'watch + TV' - Present Simple - tomosha qilishni bildiradi - 'after dinner' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: very good or wonderful
defUz: juda yaxshi, ajoyib

examples.en: I love this film. It's amazing!
examples.uz: Bu kino menga juda yoqadi. U ajoyib!
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'It's' qisqargan shakli (It is) bog'lovchi fe'l - 'amazing' sifat kesim vazifasida keladi.

examples.en: This song is amazing.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'amazing' sifat kesim vazifasida keladi.

defEn: not interesting
defUz: qiziq emas, zerikarli

examples.en: This film is boring. Let's play a game.
examples.uz: Bu kino zerikarli. Keling bir o'yin o'ynaymiz.
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l, 'boring' sifat kesim - 'Let's + fe'l' taklif gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: This game is boring.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'boring' sifat kesim vazifasida keladi.

examples.en: I like my school subjects. They're not boring.
examples.uz: Men maktab fanlarimni yoqtiraman. Ular zerikarli
examples.grammar: 'A is B' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l, 'boring' sifat kesim - 'Let's + fe'l' taklif gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: not easy to do
defUz: qilish oson emas, qiyin

examples.en: This test is very difficult. I don't understand it.
examples.uz: Bu test juda qiyin. Uni tushunmayapman.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravishi sifat darajasini kuchaytiradi - 'don't understand' inkor shaklini bildiradi.

examples.en: This book is difficult for me.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'for me' predlogli ibora kim uchunligini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: making you feel happy and interested
defUz: hayajon va qiziqish uyg'otadigan, hayajonli

examples.en: This film is very exciting. I'm enjoying it.
examples.uz: Bu film juda qiziqarli. Men undan zavqlanyapman.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravishi sifatni kuchaytiradi - 'I'm enjoying' Present Continuous hozirgi holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: This game is very exciting.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravishi sifat darajasini kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: It is very exciting to arrive in Venice at night.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravishi sifatni kuchaytiradi - 'I'm enjoying' Present Continuous hozirgi holatni bildiradi.

defEn: the one you like best
defUz: eng yoqtirgan, sevimli

examples.en: My favourite programme is on TV now.
examples.grammar: 'A is on TV' - Present Simple - 'My favourite programme' ega, 'favourite' sifat otni aniqlaydi - 'now' hozirgi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Blue is my favourite colour.
examples.grammar: 'A is + egalik + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'favourite' sifat 'colour' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: making you laugh
defUz: kuldiradigan, kulgili

examples.en: This is a very funny cartoon.
examples.grammar: 'A is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'very' ravishi 'funny' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: My friend is very funny.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravishi 'funny' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

defEn: very nice or beautiful
defUz: juda yoqimli yoki chiroyli, ajoyib

examples.en: It's a lovely day
examples.uz: let's go for a walk. – Bugun ajoyib kun–keling sayrga chiqamiz.
examples.grammar: 'A is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'It's' qisqargan shakli (It is) - 'lovely' sifat 'day' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: It is a lovely song.
examples.grammar: 'It is a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'lovely' sifat 'song' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: very or truly
defUz: chindan ham, juda

examples.en: I think rap music is really great!
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'I think' fikrni bildiradi - 'really' ravishi 'great' sifatini kuchaytiradi - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l.

examples.en: This film is really good.
examples.grammar: 'really + sifat' - Present Simple - 'really' ravishi 'good' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: You're a great cook. That food was really good!
examples.uz: Siz zo'r oshpaz ekansiz. Bu ovqat juda yaxshi
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'You're a great cook' - to be fe'li; 'That food was really good!' - to be fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'was', 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish 'good' sifatidan oldin.

examples.en: This dress is really nice.
examples.grammar: 'is + really + sifat' - to be fe'li; 'really' - kuchaytiruvchi ravish sifatdan oldin keladi.

uz: biror nima qilishda yaxshi bo'lmoq, yaxshi qila olmoq
defEn: to be able to do something well
defUz: biror ishni yaxshi bajara olmoq

examples.en: I enjoy learning Japanese but I'm not good at it.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'enjoy learning' gerundiy, 'but' qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi - 'I'm not good at it' iborasida 'at' predlogi soha ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I am good at drawing.
examples.grammar: 'be good at + gerundiy' - Present Simple - 'at' predlogidan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida keladi.

defEn: to feel that something is not interesting
defUz: biror narsa qiziq emasdek tuyulib, zerikkan his qilmoq

examples.en: I feel bored when I watch a film and it's bad.
examples.uz: Kino ko'rganimda va u yomon bo'lganda, men
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'feel bored' holatni bildiradi - 'when' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi, 'it's bad' qisqa baho beradi.

examples.en: I feel bored at home today.
examples.grammar: 'feel + sifat' - Present Simple - 'feel' fe'lidan keyin 'bored' sifat kelib holatni bildiradi.

defEn: to visit the cinema or theatre
defUz: kinoga yoki teatrga bormoq

examples.en: Lexi often goes to the cinema to watch films with her friends.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'goes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s oladi - 'often' ravishi chastotani, 'to watch' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: We go to the cinema every month.
examples.grammar: 'go to the + ot' - Present Simple - borishni bildiradi - 'every month' chastotani ko'rsatadi.

uz: ko'ngilchog'lik qilmoq, xursandchilik qilmoq, mazza qilmoq
defEn: to enjoy yourself
defUz: yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq, xursandchilik qilmoq

examples.en: We usually have fun in our lessons. They aren't boring!
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'usually' ravishi chastotani bildiradi - 'They aren't boring' inkor gap, 'aren't' qisqargan shakl (are not).

examples.en: We have fun at the party.
examples.grammar: 'have fun' iborasi - Present Simple - 'at the party' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to have enough time for something
defUz: biror ishni qilishga vaqti bo'lmoq

examples.en: I don't have time to eat breakfast before school.
examples.uz: Maktab oldidan nonushta qilgani vaqtim yo'q.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'don't have time' inkor shakli - 'to eat' infinitiv maqsadni, 'before school' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I have time to read a book today.
examples.grammar: 'have time to + fe'l' - Present Simple - 'to read' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to organise a party
defUz: bazm uyushtirmoq

examples.en: We throw a big party every summer. All our friends come to our house.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'throw a party' iborasi bazm o'tkazishni bildiradi - 'every summer' chastotani, 'come to our house' yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We have a party on my birthday.
examples.grammar: 'have a party' iborasi - Present Simple - 'on my birthday' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to hear music for pleasure
defUz: musiqa tinglamoq

examples.en: I listen to music on my phone in my room.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'listen to' fe'li 'to' predlogini talab qiladi - 'on my phone' va 'in my room' predlogli iboralar vosita va joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I listen to music in the car.
examples.grammar: 'listen to + ot' - Present Simple - tinglashni bildiradi - 'in the car' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to take part in a game
defUz: o'yin o'ynamoq

examples.en: Let's play a game of basketball!
examples.grammar: buyruq gap - 'Let's + fe'l' taklifni bildiradi - 'play a game of basketball' iborasida 'of' predlogi o'yin turini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Let's play a game of chess.
examples.grammar: 'Let's play a game of + ot' - buyruq gap taklifni bildiradi - 'of chess' o'yin turini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to look at words in a book to understand them
defUz: kitob o'qimoq

examples.en: I go to bed and read a book at about 10 pm.
examples.uz: Men soat taxminan 10 larda yotoqqa yotaman va
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go to bed' va 'read a book' fe'llari 'and' bilan bog'langan - 'at about 10 pm' taxminiy vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: I read a book before bed.
examples.grammar: 'read a + ot' - Present Simple - o'qishni bildiradi - 'before bed' predlogli ibora vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to use a camera to make a photo
defUz: suratga olmoq

examples.en: I haven't taken a photo with my new camera yet.
examples.uz: Men yangi kameram bilan hali rasm olib
examples.grammar: Present Perfect inkor - 'haven't taken' tugallangan harakat yo'qligini bildiradi - 'with my new camera' vositani, 'yet' tugamaganlikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I take a photo of my dog.
examples.grammar: 'take a photo of + ot' - Present Simple - suratga olishni bildiradi - 'of my dog' predlogli ibora suratning mavzusini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a picture made with a pen or pencil
defUz: qalam yoki ruchkada chizilgan rasm

examples.en: I did a drawing in my Art lesson.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'did a drawing' tugallangan o'tgan zamon harakati - 'in my Art lesson' predlogli ibora joy va vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: This drawing is very nice.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'very' ravishi 'nice' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

defEn: nice and giving pleasure
defUz: yoqimli, zavq beradigan, maroqli

examples.en: The trip was very enjoyable and I had a great time.
examples.uz: Sayohat juda yoqimli bo'ldi va men
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' o'tgan zamon bog'lovchi fe'l - 'enjoyable' sifat kesim, 'had a great time' tugallangan harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The film was very enjoyable.
examples.grammar: 'A was + sifat' - Past Simple - 'was' o'tgan zamon bog'lovchi fe'l, 'enjoyable' sifat kesim vazifasida keladi.

defEn: enjoyment and a good time
defUz: xursandchilik, zavq, maroq

examples.en: We had a lot of fun at Sarah's party.
examples.uz: Saraning bazmida juda mazza qildik (= rosa xursandchilik
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'had a lot of fun' tugallangan o'tgan zamon harakati - 'at Sarah's party' joyni, 'Sarah's' egalikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We have fun at school.
examples.grammar: 'have fun' iborasi - Present Simple - 'at school' predlogli ibora joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I like our Art lessons. They are fun!
examples.uz: Menga tasviriy san'at darslarimiz yoqadi. Ular juda maroqli!
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'had a lot of fun' tugallangan o'tgan zamon harakati - 'at Sarah's party' joyni, 'Sarah's' egalikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: good things that happen by chance
defUz: tasodifan ro'y beradigan yaxshi narsalar, omad

examples.en: I never had much luck with women.
examples.uz: Ayollar borasida hech qachon omadim chopmagan.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'never had' o'tgan zamon inkori - 'much luck' sanalmaydigan ot bilan miqdorni, 'with women' predlogli ibora sohani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Good luck with your test!
examples.grammar: 'luck' sanalmaydigan ot - 'with your test' predlogli ibora nimaga taalluqliligini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: having good luck
defUz: omadi bor, omadli

examples.en: You were very lucky to find a good smartphone for that price.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'were' o'tgan zamon bog'lovchi fe'l - 'very lucky' sifat kesim, 'to find' infinitiv sababni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I am very lucky today.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravishi 'lucky' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

defEn: sounds that are nice to listen to
defUz: tinglash uchun yoqimli bo'lgan tovushlar, musiqa

examples.en: The music was coming from next door.
examples.grammar: Past Continuous - 'was coming' o'tgan zamonda davom etgan harakatni bildiradi - 'from next door' predlogli ibora manbani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I love music a lot.
examples.grammar: 'love + ot' - Present Simple - yoqtirishni bildiradi - 'a lot' ravishi darajani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Music is my favourite subject
examples.uz: I love to sing and play the piano. – Musiqa mening sevimli fanim–
examples.grammar: Past Continuous - 'was coming' o'tgan zamonda davom etgan harakatni bildiradi - 'from next door' predlogli ibora manbani ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a person who plays music
defUz: musiqa ijro etadigan kishi, musiqachi

examples.en: He's a great musician
examples.uz: he can play the guitar, violin and piano. – U ajoyib musiqachi–u gitara,
examples.grammar: 'A is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'He's' qisqargan shakli (He is) - 'a great musician' ega-kesimni bildiradi.

examples.en: My uncle is a musician.
examples.grammar: 'A is a + ot' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'a' artikli kasbni bildiradi.

defEn: good at or interested in music
defUz: musiqaga moyil yoki uni yaxshi tushunadigan

examples.en: I'm not very musical. I can't play the drums or the piano.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'I'm not very musical' inkor shakli - 'can't play' qobiliyat yo'qligini, 'or' bog'lovchisi tanlovni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My sister is very musical.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravishi 'musical' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

defEn: a person who paints pictures
defUz: rasm chizadigan kishi, rassom

examples.en: Marc Chagall was a famous Russian painter.
examples.uz: Mark Chagal mashhur rus rassomi bo'lgan.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' o'tgan zamon bog'lovchi fe'l - 'a famous Russian painter' ega-kesim, sifatlar otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: My mum is a good painter.
examples.grammar: 'A is a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'good' sifat 'painter' otini aniqlaydi.

uz: rasm, surat (qalamda chizilgani, kamerada olingani emas)
defEn: a picture made with paint
defUz: bo'yoqlarda chizilgan rasm, surat

examples.en: She didn't want to show the painting until it was finished.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'didn't want' o'tgan zamon inkori - 'to show' infinitiv, 'until' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: This painting is beautiful.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'beautiful' sifat kesim vazifasida keladi.

defEn: a person who plays a game or instrument
defUz: o'yin yoki musiqa asbobi chaladigan kishi, o'yinchi

examples.en: Brandon is a great guitar player. I love listening to him.
examples.grammar: 'A is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'a great guitar player' ega-kesim - 'I love listening' Present Simple, 'listening' gerundiy.

examples.en: He is a good football player.
examples.grammar: 'A is a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'good' sifat 'player' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: to take part in a game or make music on an instrument
defUz: o'ynamoq yoki musiqa asbobi chalmoq

examples.en: I'm learning to play sax.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'I'm learning' qisqargan shakli (I am) hozirgi harakat - 'to play sax' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I play the guitar.
examples.grammar: 'play the + ot' - Present Simple - asbob chalishni bildiradi - 'the guitar' asbob oldidan 'the' artikli keladi.

examples.en: What part are you going to play in the performance?
examples.grammar: 'What + ot + are you going to + infinitiv ...?' - 'going to' kelasi zamon so'roq gap, rejani bildiradi.

examples.en: The children play in the park.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot (ko'plik) + fe'l + in + the + ot' - Present Simple, ko'plikdagi egaga fe'l asl shaklida qoladi.

defEn: a person who reads
defUz: o'qiydigan kishi, kitobxon

examples.en: Does your blog have a lot of readers?
examples.grammar: so'roq gap - Present Simple - 'Does your blog have' yordamchi 'does' bilan savol yasaladi - 'a lot of readers' ko'plikdagi to'ldiruvchi.

examples.en: My sister is a fast reader.
examples.grammar: 'A is a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'fast' sifat 'reader' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: the activity of looking at and understanding words
defUz: so'zlarni o'qib tushunish faoliyati, o'qish

examples.en: Reading books is a great hobby.
examples.grammar: 'A is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'Reading books' gerundiy ega vazifasida - 'a great hobby' kesimni bildiradi.

examples.en: Reading is fun for me.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'Reading' gerundiy ega - 'for me' predlogli ibora kim uchunligini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to look at words and understand them
defUz: so'zlarni ko'rib tushunmoq, o'qimoq

examples.en: I didn't have time to read the novel.
examples.grammar: Past Simple inkor - 'didn't have time' o'tgan zamon inkori - 'to read' infinitiv maqsadni, 'the novel' aniq otni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I read a book every night.
examples.grammar: 'read a + ot' - Present Simple - odatiy harakatni bildiradi - 'every night' chastotani ko'rsatadi.

defEn: helping you to rest and feel calm
defUz: dam olishga va xotirjam bo'lishga yordam beradigan, orombaxsh

examples.en: We didn't have school today, so we had a relaxing afternoon in the sun.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'didn't have' o'tgan zamon inkori - 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani, 'a relaxing afternoon' sifat+ot iborasini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Music is very relaxing.
examples.grammar: 'A is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravishi 'relaxing' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

defEn: a person who sings
defUz: qo'shiq kuylaydigan kishi, qo'shiqchi

examples.en: Adele is my favourite singer.
examples.grammar: 'A is + egalik + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'my favourite' egalik va sifat 'singer' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: She is a famous singer.
examples.grammar: 'A is a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple - 'famous' sifat 'singer' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: She wants to be a singer in a rap band.
examples.uz: U rep guruhida qo'shiqchi bo'lishni xohlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + wants to + infinitiv + in + a + ot' - Present Simple, 'wants to' dan keyin fe'l infinitivi ('be') keladi.

examples.en: The singer has a nice voice.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + has + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'has' egalikni bildiradi (birlik).

defEn: a big board on the wall that a teacher writes on
defUz: o'qituvchi yozadigan, devordagi katta doska

examples.en: The teacher writes things on the whiteboard.
examples.grammar: 'writes' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda (he/she/it) fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 'on the whiteboard' - 'on' predlogi narsa yuzasini bildiradi.

examples.en: The new whiteboard is white and clean.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining Present Simple birlik shakli. 'white' va 'clean' - sifatlar.

defEn: a group of students who learn together
defUz: birga o'qiydigan o'quvchilar guruhi

examples.en: There are 20 students in our class.
examples.grammar: 'There are + son + ot ko'plikda' - ko'p narsa borligini bildiradi. 'in our class' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi, 'our' egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: My class is very big.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining Present Simple birlik shakli. 'My' - egalik olmoshi, 'big' - sifat.

defEn: a room where students have lessons
defUz: o'quvchilar dars qiladigan xona

examples.en: The pupils are not allowed to use their phones in the classroom.
examples.grammar: 'are not allowed to + fe'l' - passiv shaklda ruxsat yo'qligini bildiradi. 'in the classroom' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: Our classroom is on the second floor.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining Present Simple birlik shakli. 'on' - predlog, joyni bildiradi.

defEn: a student in the same class as you
defUz: siz bilan bir sinfda o'qiydigan o'quvchi

examples.en: I often laugh with my classmates.
examples.uz: Men tez-tez sinfdoshlarim bilan hazillashib-kulishib turaman.
examples.grammar: 'laugh' - Present Simple fe'l. 'often' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ravish, odatda fe'ldan oldin keladi. 'with my classmates' - 'with' predlogi va ko'plik shakli.

examples.en: My classmate is my best friend.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining Present Simple birlik shakli. 'best' - 'good' sifatining ustun darajasi.

defEn: work that a teacher gives you to do at home
defUz: o'qituvchi uyda bajarish uchun beradigan ish

examples.en: Do you get a lot of homework at your school?
examples.grammar: 'Do you get ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'li bilan tuziladi. 'a lot of' - ko'p miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: I do my homework every evening.
examples.uz: Men har kuni kechqurun uy vazifamni bajaraman.
examples.grammar: 'do' - Present Simple fe'l. 'every evening' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: a time when you learn something at school
defUz: maktabda biror narsa o'rganadigan vaqt

examples.en: What time is your Maths lesson today?
examples.grammar: 'What time is ...?' - so'roq gap, vaqtni so'rashda ishlatiladi. 'is' - 'to be' fe'li. 'your' - egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: The English lesson is fun.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'fun' - bu yerda sifat vazifasida.

defEn: a child who goes to school
defUz: maktabga qatnaydigan bola

examples.en: There are 23 teachers and 450 pupils in my school.
examples.grammar: 'There are + son + ot ko'plikda' - ko'p odam yoki narsa borligini bildiradi. 'in my school' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: Every pupil has a book.
examples.grammar: 'has' - 'have' fe'lining uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli. 'Every + ot birlikda' qoidasiga amal qiladi.

defEn: a thing you use to carry your books
defUz: kitoblaringizni olib yurish uchun ishlatiladigan narsa

examples.en: I carry my books in my school bag.
examples.grammar: 'carry' - Present Simple fe'l. 'in my school bag' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi, 'my' egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: My bag is very heavy today.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'heavy' - sifat, 'very' - kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a book with empty pages for writing
defUz: yozish uchun bo'sh varaqli daftar

examples.en: I write things in this notebook.
examples.uz: Men narsalarni ushbu daftarga yozib olaman.
examples.grammar: 'write' - Present Simple fe'l. 'in this notebook' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi, 'this' - ko'rsatish olmoshi.

examples.en: I have a new notebook for Maths.
examples.grammar: 'have' - Present Simple fe'l. 'for' - predlog, maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: a small bag for pens and pencils
defUz: ruchka va qalamlar uchun kichik xalta

examples.en: I always have my pencil case with me in the lesson.
examples.uz: Darsda penalim doimo men bilan bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'have' - Present Simple fe'l. 'always' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ravish. 'with me' - 'with' predlogi.

examples.en: My pencil case is red.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'red' - rangni bildiruvchi sifat.

defEn: a small tool that makes a pencil sharp
defUz: qalamni o'tkir qiladigan kichik asbob

examples.en: You need a pencil sharpener when your pencil breaks.
examples.grammar: 'You need + ot' - Present Simple. 'when + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi. 'breaks' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

examples.en: I use a pencil sharpener at school.
examples.grammar: 'use' - Present Simple fe'l. 'a' - noaniq artikl, birlikdagi otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: a small thing you use to remove pencil marks
defUz: qalam izlarini o'chirish uchun ishlatiladigan kichik narsa

examples.en: When I draw, I use a pencil but I never use a rubber.
examples.grammar: 'When + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi. 'never' - inkorni bildiruvchi ravish, fe'ldan oldin keladi. 'a pencil', 'a rubber' - 'a' noaniq artikli bilan.

examples.en: Can I use your rubber, please?
examples.grammar: 'Can I ...?' - ruxsat so'rashda ishlatiladigan modal fe'l bilan so'roq gap.

defEn: a straight tool for measuring and drawing lines
defUz: chiziq o'lchash va chizish uchun to'g'ri asbob

examples.en: I have a ruler in my pencil case.
examples.grammar: 'I have + ot' - Present Simple. 'in my pencil case' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi, 'my' egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: I draw a line with my ruler.
examples.grammar: 'draw' - Present Simple fe'l. 'with' - predlog, vositani bildiradi.

defEn: a school subject where you draw and paint
defUz: rasm chizish va bo'yash o'rgatiladigan maktab fani

examples.en: I love Art because we draw and paint in our lessons.
examples.uz: Menga tasviriy san'at yoqadi chunki biz
examples.grammar: 'love' - Present Simple fe'l. 'because + ergash gap' - sabab ergash gapi, 'because' bog'lovchisi bilan. 'draw and paint' - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki fe'lni bog'laydi.

examples.en: I like Art very much.
examples.grammar: 'like' - Present Simple fe'l. 'very much' - darajani bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: a school subject about countries and places
defUz: mamlakatlar va joylar haqidagi maktab fani

examples.en: We are learning about Africa in Geography at the moment.
examples.grammar: 'are learning' - Present Continuous (to be + fe'l-ing), hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi. 'about' - predlog, mavzuni bildiradi. 'at the moment' - hozirgi vaqt ifodasi.

examples.en: We study Geography on Mondays.
examples.grammar: 'study' - Present Simple fe'l. 'on Mondays' - 'on' predlogi kunlar bilan ishlatiladi.

defEn: a school subject where you make things with your hands
defUz: qo'l bilan narsa yasash o'rgatiladigan maktab fani

examples.en: Handicraft is my favourite subject.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'my favourite subject' - 'my' egalik olmoshi, 'favourite' sifat.

examples.en: In Handicraft we make small toys.
examples.uz: Mehnat darsida biz kichik o'yinchoqlar yasaymiz.
examples.grammar: 'make' - Present Simple fe'l. 'In Handicraft' - 'in' predlogi bilan boshlangan ibora gap boshida.

defEn: a school subject about the past
defUz: o'tmish haqidagi maktab fani

examples.en: Today we are learning about the 1800s in History.
examples.grammar: 'are learning' - Present Continuous (to be + fe'l-ing), hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi. 'about' - predlog, mavzuni bildiradi. 'Today' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: I like History because I love old stories.
examples.uz: Menga tarix yoqadi, chunki eski hikoyalarni yaxshi ko'raman.
examples.grammar: 'because' - sabab ergash gapini bog'lovchi. 'like' va 'love' - Present Simple fe'llar.

defEn: a school subject about computers
defUz: kompyuterlar haqidagi maktab fani

examples.en: I have IT once a week. I use a computer in those lessons.
examples.grammar: 'I have + ot' - Present Simple. 'once a week' - takrorlanish chastotasini bildiruvchi ibora. 'in those lessons' - 'in' predlogi, 'those' ko'rsatish olmoshi.

examples.en: In IT we learn to use computers.
examples.uz: Informatika darsida biz kompyuterdan foydalanishni o'rganamiz.
examples.grammar: 'learn to + fe'l' - infinitiv bilan ishlatiladi. 'In IT' - 'in' predlogi bilan ibora.

defEn: a school subject about books and stories
defUz: kitoblar va hikoyalar haqidagi maktab fani

examples.en: My brother is reading Tolstoy in Literature this week.
examples.grammar: 'is reading' - Present Continuous (to be + fe'l-ing), hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi. 'this week' - hozirgi vaqtni bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: We read poems in Literature.
examples.grammar: 'read' - Present Simple fe'l. 'in Literature' - 'in' predlogi bilan ibora.

defEn: a school subject about numbers
defUz: raqamlar haqidagi maktab fani

examples.en: I'm not good with numbers, so Maths is hard for me.
examples.grammar: 'I'm not good' - 'to be' fe'lining inkor shakli (am not). 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi. 'for me' - 'for' predlogi.

examples.en: I have Maths every day.
examples.grammar: 'have' - Present Simple fe'l. 'every day' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: a school subject where you do sport and exercise
defUz: sport va mashqlar bilan shug'ullaniladigan maktab fani

examples.en: In PE we sometimes play basketball.
examples.uz: Jismoniy tarbiya darsida biz ba'zan basketbol o'ynaymiz.
examples.grammar: 'In PE' - 'in' predlogi bilan boshlangan ibora gap boshida. 'sometimes' - chastotani bildiruvchi ravish. 'play' - Present Simple fe'l.

examples.en: We run and jump in PE.
examples.uz: Jismoniy tarbiya darsida biz yuguramiz va sakraymiz.
examples.grammar: 'run and jump' - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki fe'lni bog'laydi, Present Simple.

uz: aniq fanlar jamlanmasi: fizika + kimyo + matematika + biologiya (rivojlangan mamlakatlarda alohida shunday fan mavjud)
defEn: a school subject about nature, plants and the world
defUz: tabiat, o'simliklar va dunyo haqidagi maktab fani

examples.en: I love Science. We learn some interesting things in our lessons.
examples.grammar: 'love' - Present Simple fe'l. 'We learn + ot' - Present Simple. 'interesting' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi. 'in our lessons' - 'in' predlogi.

examples.en: In Science we learn about plants.
examples.uz: Tabiiy fanlar darsida biz o'simliklar haqida o'rganamiz.
examples.grammar: 'learn about' - 'about' predlogi mavzuni bildiradi. 'In Science' - gap boshidagi ibora.

defEn: one of the parts of the school year
defUz: o'quv yilining bir qismi (chorak)

examples.en: There are three terms in the school year.
examples.uz: Maktab o'quv yilida uchta chorak bor.
examples.grammar: 'There are + son + ot ko'plikda' - ko'p narsa borligini bildiradi. 'in the school year' - 'in' predlogi, 'the' aniq artikl.

examples.en: The new term begins in September.
examples.grammar: 'begins' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 'in September' - 'in' predlogi oylar bilan ishlatiladi.

defEn: a set of questions to show what you know
defUz: bilimingizni ko'rsatadigan savollar to'plami

examples.en: Our teacher often gives us tests.
examples.uz: O'qituvchimiz bizga tez-tez test berib turadilar.
examples.grammar: 'gives' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi, Present Simple. 'often' - chastotani bildiruvchi ravish, fe'ldan oldin keladi.

examples.en: We have a test on Friday.
examples.grammar: 'have' - Present Simple fe'l. 'on Friday' - 'on' predlogi kunlar bilan ishlatiladi.

defEn: a list that shows the times of lessons
defUz: darslar vaqtini ko'rsatadigan ro'yxat

examples.en: According to the timetable, Maths is on Friday.
examples.uz: O'quv jadvaliga ko'ra, matematika juma kuni
examples.grammar: 'According to' - manbaga ishora qiluvchi ibora. 'is' - 'to be' fe'li. 'on Friday' - 'on' predlogi kun bilan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: I look at my timetable every morning.
examples.uz: Men har kuni ertalab o'quv jadvalimga qarayman.
examples.grammar: 'look at' - fe'l, 'at' predlogi bilan. 'every morning' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: to look at something to see if it is right
defUz: biror narsa to'g'rimi yo'qmi ko'rib chiqmoq

examples.en: I always check that my books are in my bag.
examples.grammar: 'check that + ergash gap' - to'ldiruvchi ergash gap, 'that' bog'lovchisi bilan. 'always' - chastotani bildiruvchi ravish, fe'ldan oldin.

examples.en: Please check your answers.
examples.grammar: 'check' - buyruq gap (imperative), fe'l gap boshida turadi. 'Please' - xushmuomalalik so'zi.

defEn: to pick one thing from many
defUz: ko'p narsadan bittasini olmoq

examples.en: What did you choose to wear to the party?
examples.grammar: 'What did you choose ...?' - Past Simple so'roq gap, 'did' yordamchi fe'li bilan, asosiy fe'l asl shaklda. 'to wear' - infinitiv.

examples.en: I choose the red pen.
examples.grammar: 'choose' - Present Simple fe'l. 'the' - aniq artikl, ma'lum narsani bildiradi.

defEn: to not pass a test or exam
defUz: test yoki imtihondan o'ta olmaslik

examples.en: Jamie didn't study, so he failed his English test.
examples.uz: Jeymi o'qigani yo'q, shuning uchun u ingliz tili
examples.grammar: 'didn't study' - Past Simple inkor shakli (did not + fe'l asl shaklda). 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi. 'failed' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi.

examples.en: I do not want to fail the test.
examples.grammar: 'do not want to + fe'l' - Present Simple inkor, undan keyin infinitiv keladi.

defEn: to have information in your mind
defUz: ongingizda ma'lumotga ega bo'lmoq

examples.en: Do you know the answer? I don't.
examples.grammar: 'Do you know ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'li bilan. 'I don't' - qisqa inkor javob (do not).

examples.en: I know your name.
examples.grammar: 'know' - Present Simple fe'l. 'your' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to get new knowledge or a new skill
defUz: yangi bilim yoki ko'nikma olmoq

examples.en: Is it hard to learn Russian?
examples.grammar: 'Is it hard to + fe'l?' - 'to be' fe'li bilan so'roq gap. 'to learn' - infinitiv. 'hard' - sifat.

examples.en: I learn new words every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni yangi so'zlar o'rganaman.
examples.grammar: 'learn' - Present Simple fe'l. 'every day' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to not go to a class or a place
defUz: darsga yoki biror joyga bormaslik

examples.en: I never miss school. I go there every day.
examples.uz: Men hech qachon maktabni qoldirmayman. Men u
examples.grammar: 'never' - inkorni bildiruvchi ravish, fe'ldan oldin keladi va gapni inkorga aylantiradi. 'go' - Present Simple fe'l. 'every day' - chastotani bildiradi.

examples.en: I do not want to miss the lesson.
examples.grammar: 'do not want to + fe'l' - Present Simple inkor, undan keyin infinitiv keladi.

defEn: to be successful in a test or exam
defUz: test yoki imtihondan muvaffaqiyatli o'tmoq

examples.en: I'm really happy because I passed all my exams!
