examples.grammar: 'I'm really happy' - 'to be' fe'li (am) va sifat. 'because + ergash gap' - sabab ergash gapi. 'passed' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi.

examples.en: I want to pass my English exam.
examples.uz: Men ingliz tili imtihonidan o'tishni xohlayman.
examples.grammar: 'want to + fe'l' - Present Simple, undan keyin infinitiv keladi. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to keep something in your mind
defUz: biror narsani yodda saqlamoq

examples.en: Do you remember the name of the film we watched last month?
examples.grammar: 'Do you remember ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'li bilan. 'we watched' - Past Simple ergash gap. 'last month' - o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: I remember my first teacher.
examples.grammar: 'remember' - Present Simple fe'l. 'first' - tartib son, 'my' egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to learn about something, often by reading
defUz: biror narsani, ko'pincha o'qib, o'rganmoq

examples.en: On Sunday evening, I usually study and do my homework.
examples.grammar: 'On Sunday evening' - 'on' predlogi bilan vaqt ifodasi gap boshida. 'usually' - chastotani bildiruvchi ravish. 'study and do' - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki fe'lni bog'laydi.

examples.en: I study every evening.
examples.grammar: 'study' - Present Simple fe'l. 'every evening' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to help someone learn something
defUz: birovga biror narsani o'rganishda yordam bermoq

examples.en: Mr Brown teaches us Maths.
examples.uz: Janob Braun bizga matematikadan dars beradi.
examples.grammar: 'teaches' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda (he/she) fe'lga -es qo'shiladi, Present Simple. 'us' - to'ldiruvchi olmosh.

examples.en: She teaches English at our school.
examples.uz: U bizning maktabda ingliz tilidan dars beradi.
examples.grammar: 'teaches' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -es qo'shiladi. 'at' - predlog, joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: I think I want to teach English one day.
examples.uz: Menimcha men bir kun kelib ingliz tilini o'rgatishni
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'I think' + 'want to teach' xohish; 'English' - til oti bosh harf bilan, 'one day' - kelajakdagi noaniq vaqt iborasi.

examples.en: My mother teaches young children.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'teaches' ga '-es' qo'shimchasi; 'young children' - sifat + ot ko'plik.

defEn: right; with no mistakes
defUz: to'g'ri; xatosiz

examples.en: Yes, that is the correct answer. Well done!
examples.grammar: 'that is the correct answer' - 'to be' fe'li va sifat. 'the' - aniq artikl. 'Well done!' - maqtov iborasi.

examples.en: Your answer is correct.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'correct' - sifat, kesim vazifasida.

defEn: not difficult; simple to do
defUz: qiyin emas; bajarish oddiy

examples.en: My homework is easy. I usually spend an hour doing it.
examples.uz: Mening uy vazifam oson. Odatda men
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli, sifat bilan. 'usually' - chastotani bildiruvchi ravish. 'spend ... doing' - fe'l-ing shakli bilan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: This test is easy.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'easy' - sifat, kesim vazifasida.

defEn: difficult; not easy to do
defUz: qiyin; bajarish oson emas

examples.en: This is a really hard subject. I don't understand it.
examples.uz: Bu juda qiyin fan. Men uni tushunmayman.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli, 'a really hard subject' sifat + ot. 'don't understand' - Present Simple inkor (do not).

examples.en: This question is hard.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'hard' - sifat, kesim vazifasida.

defEn: making you want to learn or know more
defUz: ko'proq bilishni xohlatadigan; qiziqarli

examples.en: I think Maths is really interesting but Misha thinks it's boring.
examples.grammar: 'I think + ergash gap' - to'ldiruvchi ergash gap. 'but' - zid bog'lovchisi. 'it's boring' - 'to be' (is) va sifat.

examples.en: This book is very interesting.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'interesting' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: correct; with no mistakes
defUz: to'g'ri; xatosiz

examples.en: Is this the right answer?
examples.grammar: 'Is this ...?' - 'to be' fe'li bilan so'roq gap. 'the right answer' - 'the' aniq artikl, 'right' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: Your answer is right.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'right' - sifat, kesim vazifasida.

defEn: not correct; with a mistake
defUz: to'g'ri emas; xato

examples.en: I'm sorry
examples.uz: that is the wrong answer. – Afsusdaman–lekin bu xato javob.
examples.grammar: 'that is the wrong answer' - 'to be' fe'li va sifat. 'the' - aniq artikl. 'wrong' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: This answer is wrong.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'wrong' - sifat, kesim vazifasida.

defEn: to want to know more about something
defUz: biror narsa haqida ko'proq bilishni xohlamoq

examples.en: I'm very interested in music.
examples.grammar: 'I'm very interested in' - 'to be' fe'li (am) + sifat + 'in' predlogi. 'in' predlogidan keyin ot keladi.

examples.en: I am interested in history.
examples.grammar: 'am interested in' - 'to be' + sifat + 'in' predlogi qurilishi, undan keyin ot keladi.

defEn: to do something dishonest in a test
defUz: testda halol bo'lmagan ish qilmoq

examples.en: Students who cheat in an exam will fail.
examples.grammar: 'Students who cheat ...' - 'who' bilan sifatlovchi ergash gap. 'will fail' - Future ('will' + fe'l). 'in an exam' - 'in' predlogi, 'an' artikl.

examples.en: Do not cheat in a test.
examples.grammar: 'Do not + fe'l' - inkor buyruq gap (imperative). 'in a test' - 'in' predlogi, 'a' artikl.

defEn: to finish the work the teacher gives you
defUz: o'qituvchi bergan vazifani bajarmoq

examples.en: I do my homework between 6 pm and 7 pm.
examples.uz: Men uyga vazifamni kechki soat 6 va 7 orasida
examples.grammar: 'do' - Present Simple fe'l. 'between ... and ...' - vaqt oralig'ini bildiruvchi predloglar. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: I do my homework after school.
examples.uz: Men maktabdan keyin uy vazifamni bajaraman.
examples.grammar: 'do' - Present Simple fe'l. 'after school' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to not pass a test or exam
defUz: test yoki imtihondan o'ta olmaslik

examples.en: Failing one exam is not the end of the world.
examples.uz: Bittagina imtihondan yiqilish hayot tugadi degani
examples.grammar: 'Failing one exam' - fe'l-ing shakli (gerund) ega vazifasida. 'is' - 'to be' fe'li. 'not the end of the world' - ibora.

examples.en: She failed her Maths exam.
examples.grammar: 'failed' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi. 'her' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to be successful in a test or exam
defUz: test yoki imtihondan muvaffaqiyatli o'tmoq

examples.en: I'm really happy when I pass a test at school.
examples.grammar: 'I'm really happy' - 'to be' (am) va sifat. 'when + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi. 'pass' - Present Simple fe'l.

examples.en: She passed her Maths exam.
examples.grammar: 'passed' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi. 'her' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to think that something is hard or easy
defUz: biror narsani qiyin yoki oson deb hisoblamoq

examples.en: I find Geography easy. It's my favourite subject.
examples.uz: Men geografiyani oson deb hisoblayman. U
examples.grammar: 'find + ot + sifat' - biror narsani qanday deb hisoblashni bildiradi. 'It's my favourite subject' - 'to be' (is) va egalik.

examples.en: I find Maths easy.
examples.grammar: 'find + ot + sifat' qurilishi, fikrni bildiradi. 'find' - Present Simple fe'l.

defEn: to receive a good or bad score for your work
defUz: ishingiz uchun yaxshi yoki yomon baho olmoq

examples.en: When we get a bad mark at school, our teachers call our parents.
examples.grammar: 'When + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi. 'get' - Present Simple fe'l. 'a bad mark' - 'a' artikl, 'bad' sifat. 'call' - Present Simple fe'l.

examples.en: I want to get a good mark.
examples.grammar: 'want to + fe'l' - Present Simple, undan keyin infinitiv keladi. 'a good mark' - 'a' artikl, 'good' sifat.

defEn: to attend school as a student
defUz: o'quvchi sifatida maktabga qatnamoq

examples.en: My sister is only four. She doesn't go to school.
examples.uz: Singlim bor yo'g'i to'rt yoshda. U maktabga
examples.grammar: 'is only four' - 'to be' fe'li (is) va son. 'doesn't go' - Present Simple inkor (does not + fe'l asl shaklda), uchinchi shaxs birlik uchun.

examples.en: I go to school every day.
examples.grammar: 'go' - Present Simple fe'l. 'every day' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to take part in a test or exam
defUz: test yoki imtihon topshirmoq

examples.en: Go to bed
examples.uz: you have a test in English tomorrow. – Uyquga yoting–ertaga ingliz tilidan
examples.grammar: 'Go to bed' - buyruq gap (imperative). 'you have a test' - Present Simple. 'tomorrow' - kelasi vaqtni bildiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: We take a test tomorrow.
examples.grammar: 'take' - Present Simple fe'l, rejalashtirilgan kelajak uchun. 'tomorrow' - kelasi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to do something in a wrong way
defUz: biror narsani noto'g'ri qilmoq

examples.en: I made a mistake in the test but I passed it.
examples.uz: Testda bitta xato qildim, lekin muvaffaqiyatli
examples.grammar: 'made' - 'make' fe'lining Past Simple shakli (noto'g'ri fe'l). 'but' - zid bog'lovchisi. 'passed' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi.

examples.en: I sometimes make a mistake.
examples.grammar: 'make' - Present Simple fe'l. 'sometimes' - chastotani bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: to listen or watch carefully
defUz: diqqat bilan tinglamoq yoki qaramoq

examples.en: Please pay attention to me. What I'm saying is important.
examples.grammar: 'Please pay attention' - buyruq gap (imperative), 'Please' xushmuomalalik so'zi bilan. 'to me' - 'to' predlogi. 'What I'm saying' - ergash gap.

examples.en: Please pay attention to the teacher.
examples.grammar: 'pay attention to' - 'to' predlogi bilan ibora. Buyruq gap (imperative).

defEn: to start to do or happen
defUz: boshlanmoq yoki boshlamoq

examples.en: When does the concert begin?
examples.grammar: 'When does ... begin?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'does' yordamchi fe'li bilan, asosiy fe'l asl shaklda.

examples.en: The lesson begins at nine.
examples.grammar: 'begins' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 'at nine' - 'at' predlogi vaqt bilan ishlatiladi.

uz: biror narsani o'rganishni endigina boshlagan odam
defEn: a person who is starting to learn something
defUz: biror narsani o'rganishni endigina boshlagan odam

examples.en: I can't play the violin very well
examples.uz: I'm a beginner. – Skripkani juda yaxshi chala olmayman–men
examples.grammar: 'I can't play' - modal fe'l 'can' inkor shakli (cannot). 'very well' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish. 'I'm a beginner' - 'to be' (am) va 'a' artikl.

examples.en: I am a beginner in English.
examples.grammar: 'am' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'a beginner' - 'a' noaniq artikl bilan ot.

defEn: the first part of something
defUz: biror narsaning birinchi qismi

examples.en: In the beginning, I didn't like my new school.
examples.grammar: 'In the beginning' - 'in' predlogi va 'the' artikl bilan vaqt ifodasi gap boshida. 'didn't like' - Past Simple inkor (did not + fe'l asl shaklda).

examples.en: The beginning of the story is sad.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'of' - predlog, egalikni bildiradi.

defEn: the act of choosing between things
defUz: narsalar orasidan tanlash harakati

examples.en: You have a choice for dinner
examples.uz: vegetables or pasta. – Kechki ovqat uchun tanlov bor–sabzavotlar
examples.grammar: 'You have a choice' - Present Simple, 'a' noaniq artikl bilan ot. 'for dinner' - 'for' predlogi.

examples.en: It is a good choice.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'a good choice' - 'a' artikl, 'good' sifat.

defEn: to teach someone over a long time
defUz: kishiga uzoq vaqt davomida ta'lim bermoq

examples.en: The Ormerod School educates handicapped children.
examples.grammar: 'educates' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi, Present Simple. 'handicapped children' - sifat + ot ko'plikda.

examples.en: Schools educate children.
examples.grammar: 'educate' - Present Simple fe'l, ega ko'plikda. 'children' - 'child' otining ko'plik shakli.

defEn: the process of learning at school
defUz: maktabda o'rganish jarayoni

examples.en: You go to school to get an education. It's important to learn things.
examples.grammar: 'to get an education' - infinitiv (maqsad), 'an' noaniq artikl bilan ot. 'It's important to + fe'l' - 'to be' va infinitiv qurilishi.

examples.en: Education is very important.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'important' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: the things a person knows
defUz: kishi biladigan narsalar

examples.en: I'm amazed by my dad's knowledge. He knows lots of things!
examples.grammar: 'I'm amazed by' - passiv qurilish, 'to be' (am) + sifat + 'by' predlogi. 'knows' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

examples.en: Books give us knowledge.
examples.grammar: 'give' - Present Simple fe'l, ega ko'plikda. 'us' - to'ldiruvchi olmosh.

defEn: to say or write the letters of a word
defUz: so'zning harflarini aytmoq yoki yozmoq

examples.en: How do you spell your surname?
examples.grammar: 'How do you spell ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'li va 'How' so'roq so'zi bilan. 'your surname' - egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: Can you spell your name?
examples.grammar: 'Can you ...?' - modal fe'l 'can' bilan so'roq gap, asosiy fe'l asl shaklda.

defEn: the way letters are put together in a word
defUz: so'zdagi harflarning to'g'ri tartibi (imlo)

examples.en: Spelling is important. You won't get good marks in the test if you spell words wrong.
examples.grammar: 'Spelling is important' - 'to be' fe'li (is) va sifat. 'You won't get' - Future inkor (will not). 'if + ergash gap' - shart mayli.

examples.en: Her spelling is very good.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'good' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

uz: o'quvchi: maktab o'quvchisi, universitet o'quvchi, o'quv markazida biror narsa o'rganadigan o'quvchi, istalgan turdagi o'quvchi
defEn: a person who studies at a school or college
defUz: maktab yoki kollejda o'qiydigan odam

examples.en: Matthew is an Art student. He wants to become a painter.
examples.grammar: 'is an Art student' - 'to be' (is) va 'an' noaniq artikl (unli tovushdan oldin). 'wants to + fe'l' - Present Simple va infinitiv.

examples.en: She is a good student.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'a good student' - 'a' artikl, 'good' sifat.

defEn: a person whose job is to teach
defUz: ishi dars berish bo'lgan odam

examples.en: Pay attention to what your teachers tell you to do.
examples.grammar: 'Pay attention to' - buyruq gap (imperative), 'to' predlogi bilan. 'what your teachers tell you' - ergash gap. 'tell' - Present Simple fe'l.

examples.en: My teacher is very kind.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'kind' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: A teacher usually has to work after school too.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has to + infinitiv' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'after school' - vaqt predlogli ibora, 'too' - ravish 'ham' ma'nosida.

examples.en: My teacher is very nice.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot' - egalik; 'is' - 'to be' fe'li, 'very nice' - ravish + sifat.

defEn: a person who is fully grown, not a child
defUz: voyaga yetgan, katta yoshdagi odam
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: There were 20 children and 5 adults at the party.
examples.uz: Bazmda 20 nafar bolalar va 5 nafar kattalar
examples.grammar: 'There were + son + ot (ko'plik)' - Past Simple ('to be' o'tgan zamoni) orqali o'tmishda nechta odam borligini bildiradi.

examples.en: My father is an adult.
examples.grammar: 'is + a/an + ot' - Present Simple, birlikda kimnidir tasvirlaydi; 'an' unli tovush oldidan ishlatiladi.

defEn: a young person who is not yet an adult
defUz: hali voyaga yetmagan yosh inson, bola
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: When I was a child, I loved watching cartoons on TV.
examples.grammar: 'When + I was + a + ot' - Past Simple, 'when' ergash gap orqali o'tmishdagi davrni bildiradi.

examples.en: The child is playing in the garden.
examples.grammar: 'is + fe'l-ing' - Present Continuous, hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: the sister of your mother or father
defUz: ota yoki onaning singlisi yoki opasi (xola, amma)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: That's my aunt. She's my mum's sister.
examples.uz: Bu mening xolam. U oyimning opasi/singlisi.
examples.grammar: 'That is + egalik + ot' - Present Simple, 'that' ko'rsatish olmoshi orqali kishini tanishtiradi.

examples.en: My aunt has two children.
examples.grammar: 'has + son + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple, birinchi shaxs egasida egalik (bor) ma'nosini bildiradi.

defEn: a boy or man who has the same parents as you
defUz: siz bilan bir ota-onadan bo'lgan o'g'il (aka yoki uka)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: My brother is 15 and my sister is 12.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + son + yoshda' - Present Simple, 'and' bog'lovchi orqali ikki gap birlashtirilgan.

examples.en: My brother likes football.
examples.grammar: 'ot + likes + ot' - Present Simple, birlik uchinchi shaxsda fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

defEn: a male parent
defUz: erkak ota-ona, ota (dada)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: My father met my mother in Vladivostok in 1996.
examples.grammar: 'egalik + ot + met + ...' - Past Simple, 'meet' fe'lining noto'g'ri shakli 'met' o'tmishdagi uchrashuvni bildiradi.

examples.en: My father is at work.
examples.grammar: 'is + at + joy' - Present Simple, 'at' predlogi aniq joyni bildiradi.

defEn: the mother or father of one of your parents
defUz: ota yoki onaning onasi (buvi) yoki otasi (bobo)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: My grandmother sometimes helps me to do my homework.
examples.grammar: 'ot + sometimes + helps + me + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'sometimes' takrorlanish ravishi, 'to do' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: My grandfather tells funny stories.
examples.grammar: 'ot + tells + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple, birlik uchinchi shaxsda fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

defEn: a female parent
defUz: ayol ota-ona, ona (oyi)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: My mother works as a dentist.
examples.grammar: 'ot + works + as + a + ot' - Present Simple, 'work as' kasbni bildiradi, 'a' artikli bilan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: My mother makes good food.
examples.grammar: 'ot + makes + ot' - Present Simple, birlik uchinchi shaxsda fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

defEn: the son of your brother or sister
defUz: aka, uka, opa yoki singilning o'g'il farzandi (o'g'il jiyan)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: That's my nephew. He's my brother's son.
examples.uz: Bu mening jiyanim. U akamning o'g'li.
examples.grammar: 'That is + egalik + ot. He is + egalik + ot' - Present Simple, qarindoshlik aloqasini ikki gap orqali tushuntiradi.

examples.en: My nephew is five years old.
examples.grammar: 'is + son + years old' - Present Simple, yoshni bildiruvchi turg'un ibora.

defEn: the daughter of your brother or sister
defUz: aka, uka, opa yoki singilning qiz farzandi (qiz jiyan)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: That's my niece. She's my brother's daughter.
examples.uz: Bu mening jiyanim. U akamning qizi.
examples.grammar: 'That is + egalik + ot. She is + egalik + ot' - Present Simple, qarindoshlik aloqasini ko'rsatish olmoshi bilan tushuntiradi.

examples.en: My niece is a happy child.
examples.grammar: 'is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'a' artikli bilan birlikdagi otni tasvirlaydi.

defEn: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you
defUz: siz bilan bir ota-onadan bo'lgan qiz (opa yoki singil)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: I am from a big family. I have two brothers and three sisters.
examples.grammar: 'I have + son + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple, 'have' egalik (bor) ma'nosini bildiradi, otlar ko'plikda.

examples.en: My sister is very kind.
examples.grammar: 'is + very + sifat' - Present Simple, 'very' ravishi sifatni kuchaytiradi.

defEn: the brother of your mother or father
defUz: ota yoki onaning akasi yoki ukasi (tog'a, amaki)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: That's my uncle. He's my mum's brother.
examples.uz: Bu mening tog'am. U oyimning ukasi/akasi.
examples.grammar: 'That is + egalik + ot. He is + egalik + ot' - Present Simple, 'that' va 'he' olmoshlari orqali kishini tanishtiradi.

examples.en: My uncle lives near us.
examples.grammar: 'ot + lives + near + olmosh' - Present Simple, birlik uchinchi shaxsda fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

defEn: a man or boy (informal)
defUz: erkak yoki yigit (so'zlashuvda ishlatiladi)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: I like my brother. He's a good guy.
examples.uz: Akam menga yoqadi. U yaxshi bola.
examples.grammar: 'He is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'a' artikli bilan kishi haqida fikr bildiradi.

examples.en: He is a nice guy.
examples.grammar: 'is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'a' artikli birlikdagi otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: a group of people (informal)
defUz: bir guruh odamlar (so'zlashuvda yigit-qizlarga murojaat)
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: How are you doing, guys?
examples.grammar: 'How are you doing, ...?' - Present Continuous so'roq gap, ahvol so'rash uchun ishlatiladigan turg'un ibora.

examples.en: Come here, guys!
examples.grammar: 'fe'l (asos shakl) + ...' - buyruq gap, ko'plikdagi odamlarga murojaat qiladi.

defEn: a person who lives near you
defUz: yaqin atrofda yashaydigan odam, qo'shni
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: My neighbour lives on the first floor and I live on the second.
examples.grammar: 'ot + lives + on + the + tartib son + floor' - Present Simple, 'on the floor' qavatni bildiruvchi predlogli ibora.

examples.en: My neighbour is very friendly.
examples.grammar: 'is + very + sifat' - Present Simple, 'very' ravishi sifatni kuchaytiradi.

defEn: a member of your family
defUz: oilangizga mansub odam, qarindosh
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: Sometimes we have a big party and invite all our relatives.
examples.grammar: 'we + have + ... + and + invite + ...' - Present Simple, 'and' bog'lovchi ikki fe'lni bog'laydi, 'all our' egalik bilan ko'plikni bildiradi.

examples.en: All my relatives live in one town.
examples.grammar: 'all + egalik + ot (ko'plik) + live' - Present Simple, ko'plikdagi ega bilan fe'l asos shaklda.

defEn: a person between 13 and 19 years old
defUz: 13 va 19 yosh oralig'idagi odam, o'smir
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: I'm 13 today
examples.uz: I'm a teenager now! – Men bugun 13 yoshga to'ldim–endi men o'smir
examples.grammar: 'I am + son' - Present Simple ('to be'), yoshni bildiradi; gap qisqa va sodda.

examples.en: My sister is a teenager.
examples.grammar: 'is + a + ot' - Present Simple, 'a' artikli bilan birlikdagi otni bildiradi.

defEn: to start to be something
defUz: biror narsa yoki kasb egasiga aylanmoq, bo'lmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: My aunt is studying to become a doctor.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + studying + to + become' - Present Continuous, 'to become' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I want to become a teacher.
examples.grammar: 'want + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'to become' kelajakdagi maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I think I want to become a dentist when I finish studying.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'I think' + 'want to become' xohish; 'a dentist' - artikl + ot; 'when I finish studying' - vaqt ergash gapi, 'studying' - gerund.

examples.en: I want to become a doctor.
examples.grammar: 'want to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; 'a doctor' - artikl + ot.

defEn: to talk in a friendly way
defUz: do'stona suhbatlashmoq, gaplashmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: I like chatting to people on the computer.
examples.grammar: 'I like + fe'l-ing' - Present Simple, 'like' fe'lidan keyin fe'lning '-ing' shakli (gerundiy) keladi.

examples.en: We chat after school.
examples.grammar: 'ot/olmosh + chat + after + ot' - Present Simple, ko'plikdagi ega bilan fe'l asos shaklda.

examples.en: We had a nice chat over a cup of tea.
examples.uz: Biz bir finjon choy ustida ajoyib suhbat qurdik.
examples.grammar: 'We had + a + sifat + ot + over + a + ot' - Past Simpleda 'had' o'tgan ish; 'over' predlogi (biror narsa ustida) ma'nosini bildiradi.

examples.en: We had a long chat on the phone.
examples.grammar: 'had + a + sifat + ot' - Past Simpleda o'tgan ish; 'long' sifat 'chat' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: to argue and stop being friends with someone
defUz: biror kim bilan janjallashib, xafalashib qolmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: Phoebe said some really bad things to me and I fell out with her.
examples.grammar: '... and I + fell out with + olmosh' - Past Simple, 'fall out' phrasal fe'lining o'tmish shakli 'fell out'.

examples.en: I fell out with my friend yesterday.
examples.uz: Men kecha do'stim bilan janjallashib qoldim.
examples.grammar: 'fell out with + ot' - Past Simple, 'fall out' phrasal fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tmish shakli.

defEn: to have a good relationship with someone
defUz: biror kim bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmoq, chiqishmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: I get on with all my classmates. We're a great class!
examples.grammar: 'I get on with + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple, 'get on with' phrasal fe'l yaxshi munosabatni bildiradi.

examples.en: I get on well with my sister.
examples.grammar: 'get on well with + ot' - Present Simple, 'well' ravishi munosabat darajasini bildiradi.

defEn: to spend time with someone (informal)
defUz: biror kim bilan vaqt o'tkazmoq, birga yurmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: I usually hang out with my friends at the weekend.
examples.uz: Men odatda hafta oxirini do'stlarim bilan
examples.grammar: 'I usually + hang out with + ot' - Present Simple, 'usually' takrorlanish ravishi, 'at the weekend' vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: I hang out with my friends on Sunday.
examples.uz: Men yakshanba kuni do'stlarim bilan vaqt o'tkazaman.
examples.grammar: 'hang out with + ot + on + kun' - Present Simple, 'on' predlogi kun bilan ishlatiladi.

defEn: to take place or occur
defUz: sodir bo'lmoq, ro'y bermoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: Hi, Ethan. What happened at school today?
examples.uz: Salom, Isen. Bugun maktabda nima bo'ldi?
examples.grammar: 'What + happened + ...?' - Past Simple so'roq gap, 'happen' fe'liga '-ed' qo'shilib o'tmish shakli yasaladi.

examples.en: What happens next?
examples.grammar: 'What + happens + next?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, birlik uchinchi shaxsda fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

defEn: to ask someone to come to an event
defUz: biror kimni biror joyga yoki tadbirga taklif qilmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: My best friend invited me to her pyjama party this weekend.
examples.grammar: 'ot + invited + me + to + ot' - Past Simple, 'invite' fe'liga '-d' qo'shilib o'tmish shakli yasaladi.

examples.en: I invite you to my party.
examples.grammar: 'invite + ot + to + ot' - Present Simple, 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: to seem or appear a certain way
defUz: biror holatda ko'rinmoq, tuyulmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: You look happy. Did you pass your test?
examples.grammar: 'You + look + sifat' - Present Simple, 'look' fe'li sifat bilan tashqi ko'rinishni bildiradi.

examples.en: You look tired today.
examples.grammar: 'look + sifat' - Present Simple, 'look' fe'li sifat bilan holatni tasvirlaydi.

defEn: to come together with someone
defUz: biror kim bilan uchrashmoq, ko'rishmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: Let's meet outside the cinema at 7 pm.
examples.uz: Keling kechki soat 7 da kinoteatr tashqarisida
examples.grammar: 'Let us + meet + outside + ot + at + soat' - buyruq gap, 'let us' taklifni, 'at' predlogi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: I meet my friends every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni do'stlarim bilan uchrashaman.
examples.grammar: 'meet + ot + every day' - Present Simple, 'every day' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: to go to live in a new place
defUz: yangi joyga ko'chmoq; bir joydan harakatlanmoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: I don't want to move to a new school. I'm happy here.
examples.grammar: 'I do not + want + to + move' - Present Simple inkor gap, 'do not' inkorni, 'to move' infinitivni bildiradi.

examples.en: We move to a new house next week.
examples.uz: Biz keyingi hafta yangi uyga ko'chamiz.
examples.grammar: 'move + to + ot' - Present Simple, kelajak ma'noda 'next week' vaqt bilan ishlatiladi.

defEn: to seem good when you hear about it
defUz: eshitilishidan yaxshi tuyulmoq, yoqimli jaranglamoq
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: A fancy dress party sounds like a great idea!
examples.grammar: 'ot + sounds like + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'sound like' fikr yoki taassurotni bildiradi.

examples.en: That sounds good!
examples.grammar: 'sounds + sifat' - Present Simple, birlik uchinchi shaxsda fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

defEn: very good or fashionable (informal)
defUz: ajoyib, zo'r, urfdagi
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: My parents gave me a cool new phone!
examples.uz: Ota-onam menga zo'r yap-yangi telefon berishdi!
examples.grammar: 'ot + gave + me + a + sifat + ot' - Past Simple, 'give' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tmish shakli 'gave'.

examples.en: Your bike is really cool!
examples.grammar: 'is + really + sifat' - Present Simple, 'really' ravishi sifatni kuchaytiradi.

defEn: not the same as something else
defUz: boshqasidan farq qiladigan, har xil, turli
topic: Making Friends and Getting to Know People

examples.en: Do you like learning different things in Science class?
examples.uz: Aniq fanlar darsida har xil narsalarni
examples.grammar: 'Do you like + fe'l-ing + ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'like' dan keyin fe'l '-ing' shaklida keladi.

examples.en: We have different hobbies.
examples.grammar: 'have + sifat + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple, sifat otdan oldin keladi va o'zgarmaydi.

defEn: older (used about people in a family)
defUz: yoshi kattaroq (oila a'zolariga nisbatan ishlatiladi)
