examples.en: Have you ever eaten Chinese food?
examples.uz: Hayotingiz davomida hech xitoy taomi yeb ko'rganmisiz?
examples.grammar: 'Have you ever + sifatdosh (eaten) + sifat + ot' - Present Perfect so'roq gap, 'ever' hayot davomidagi tajribani so'raydi.

examples.en: I like Chinese food.
examples.grammar: 'fe'l (like) + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'Chinese' sifati otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: A country in Europe.
defUz: Yevropadagi davlat.

examples.en: ‘How are you going to France?’ ‘We're going by boat.’
examples.grammar: 'How + be + you + going to + ot' - Future ('going to') so'roq gap, 'how' vositani so'raydi; javobda 'by boat' transportni bildiradi.

examples.en: Paris is the capital of France.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + the + ot + of + ot' - Present Simple, 'is the capital of' qurilishi poytaxtni bildiradi.

defEn: From France.
defUz: Fransiyaga oid, fransuz.

examples.en: Jean-Pierre is a student at my school. He's French and he was born in Paris.
examples.grammar: 'be + sifat + and + be + sifatdosh (born) + in + ot' - Present va Past Simple, 'was born' tug'ilishni bildiradigan passiv qurilish.

examples.en: I like French food.
examples.grammar: 'fe'l (like) + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'French' sifati otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: A country in Europe.
defUz: Yevropadagi davlat.

examples.en: Last month I went on a school trip to Germany.
examples.grammar: 'Last month + fe'l (went) + on + a + ot + to + ot' - Past Simple, 'last month' o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: Berlin is the capital of Germany.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + the + ot + of + ot' - Present Simple, 'is the capital of' qurilishi poytaxtni bildiradi.

defEn: From Germany.
defUz: Germaniyaga oid, nemis.

examples.en: Hans is from Germany and he's looking for a shop where they sell German food.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + from + ot + and + be + ravishdosh (looking) + for + a + ot' - Present Continuous, 'looking for' qidirayotganini bildiradi.

examples.en: I want to learn German.
examples.grammar: 'want + infinitiv (to learn) + ot' - Present Simple, 'German' bu yerda til nomi sifatida keladi.

defEn: A country in Asia.
defUz: Osiyodagi davlat.

examples.en: We went to Japan last April.
examples.uz: Biz o'tgan aprel oyida Yaponiyaga bordik.
examples.grammar: 'fe'l (went) + to + ot + last + ot' - Past Simple, 'last April' o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + the + ot + of + ot' - Present Simple, 'is the capital of' qurilishi poytaxtni bildiradi.

defEn: From Japan.
defUz: Yaponiyaga oid, yapon.

examples.en: We went to Tokyo and had Japanese food. It was very good.
examples.grammar: 'fe'l (went) + to + ot + and + had + sifat + ot' - Past Simple, 'Japanese' sifati otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: I like Japanese food.
examples.grammar: 'fe'l (like) + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'Japanese' sifati otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: A very large country in Europe and Asia.
defUz: Yevropa va Osiyodagi juda katta davlat.

examples.en: He worked as a British spy in Russia.
examples.uz: U Rossiyada ingliz josusi bo'lib ishlagan.
examples.grammar: 'fe'l (worked) + as + a + sifat + ot + in + ot' - Past Simple, 'as a' qanday lavozimda ishlaganini bildiradi.

examples.en: Moscow is the capital of Russia.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + the + ot + of + ot' - Present Simple, 'is the capital of' qurilishi poytaxtni bildiradi.

defEn: From Russia.
defUz: Rossiyaga oid, rus.

examples.en: What is your favourite Russian food?
examples.grammar: 'What is + egalik (your) + sifat + sifat + ot' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'Russian' sifati otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: He is a Russian writer.
examples.grammar: 'be + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'Russian' sifati otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: A country in Europe.
defUz: Yevropadagi davlat.

examples.en: I've never been to Spain.
examples.grammar: 'have never + sifatdosh (been) + to + ot' - Present Perfect, 'never' hech qachon ro'y bermagan harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: Madrid is the capital of Spain.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + the + ot + of + ot' - Present Simple, 'is the capital of' qurilishi poytaxtni bildiradi.

defEn: From Spain.
defUz: Ispaniyaga oid, ispan.

examples.en: Real Madrid and Barcelona are Spanish football teams.
examples.uz: Real Madrid va Barselona ispan futbol
examples.grammar: 'ot + and + ot + be + sifat + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple, 'Spanish' sifati otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: I want to learn Spanish.
examples.grammar: 'want + infinitiv (to learn) + ot' - Present Simple, 'Spanish' bu yerda til nomi sifatida keladi.

defEn: A person who is good at sport and trains a lot.
defUz: Sport bilan jiddiy shug'ullanadigan va mashq qiladigan odam, sportchi.

examples.en: William loves running. He's going to become an athlete.
examples.grammar: Birinchi gap Present Simple - 'loves + V-ing' (gerund) yoqtirishni bildiradi. Ikkinchi gap 'be going to' kelasi zamon - 'an athlete' oldidan unli tovush uchun 'an' artikli ishlatilgan.

examples.en: She is a fast athlete.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + artikl 'a' + sifat 'fast' + ot 'athlete' - birlikda shaxsni ta'riflaydi.

defEn: Sports like running and jumping.
defUz: Yugurish va sakrash kabi yengil atletika sportlari.

examples.en: I love watching all kinds of sport and athletics on TV.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'love + V-ing' (watching) yoqtirishni bildiradi. 'all kinds of' iborasi turlarini, 'on TV' predlogli ibora joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: I like athletics very much.
examples.uz: Men yengil atletikani juda yaxshi ko'raman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'I like + ot' tartibi; 'very much' ravish iborasi darajani kuchaytiradi.

defEn: Activity you do to make your body strong and healthy.
defUz: Tanani sog'lom va kuchli qilish uchun bajariladigan jismoniy harakat, mashq.

examples.en: Do you do a lot of exercise in PE?
examples.uz: Jismoniy tarbiya darsida juda ko'p mashq qilasizmi?
examples.grammar: Present Simple so'roq gap - yordamchi fe'l 'Do' bilan boshlangan; 'a lot of' iborasi ko'plikni, 'in PE' predlogli ibora joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: I do exercise every day.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'I do + ot' tartibi; 'every day' ibora odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: A game of football or basketball between two teams.
defUz: Ikki jamoa o'rtasidagi futbol yoki basketbol o'yini, musobaqa.

examples.en: Have you ever been to a football match?
examples.uz: Hayotingiz davomida hech bir futbol musobaqasiga
examples.grammar: Present Perfect so'roq gap - 'Have you ever been to ...?' tuzilishi hayot tajribasini so'raydi; 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: We watched a football match on Sunday.
examples.uz: Biz yakshanba kuni futbol o'yinini tomosha qildik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'watched' fe'li o'tgan zamonda; 'on Sunday' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A person who plays football or basketball.
defUz: Futbol yoki basketbol o'ynaydigan odam, futbolchi yoki basketbolchi.

examples.en: My friend wants to become a basketball player.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'wants to + infinitiv' (to become) istakni bildiradi; 'a basketball player' oldida 'a' artikli birlikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: He is a good football player.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + artikl 'a' + sifat 'good' + ot - birlikda shaxsni ta'riflaydi.

defEn: One match of football or basketball.
defUz: Bitta futbol yoki basketbol o'yini, uchrashuv.

examples.en: Let's play a game of football!
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Let's + fe'l' (play) taklif bildiradi; 'a game of football' birikmasida 'of' predlogi turini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We played a game of basketball after school.
examples.uz: Biz darsdan keyin bitta basketbol o'yini o'ynadik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'played' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'after school' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A point you get in football when the ball goes in the net.
defUz: Futbolda to'p darvozaga kirganda olinadigan ochko, go'l.

examples.en: We played a game of football and I scored two goals.
examples.uz: Biz futbol o'ynadik va men ikkita go'l
examples.grammar: Ikki sodda gap 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan; ikkalasi Past Simple - 'played' va 'scored' o'tgan zamonda; 'two goals' ko'plik shaklida.

examples.en: He scored a goal in the last minute.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'scored' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'in the last minute' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A place where you go to exercise.
defUz: Mashq qilish uchun boriladigan joy, sport zali.

examples.en: Sometimes I go to the gym to exercise.
examples.uz: Ba'zan men mashq qilish uchun sport zaliga boraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go to + joy' harakatni bildiradi; 'to exercise' infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi; 'Sometimes' ravish takrorlanish chastotasini bildiradi.

examples.en: There is a new gym near my house.
examples.uz: Mening uyim yonida yangi sport zali bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is + ot' tuzilishi birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi; 'near' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

uz: sog'liqqa foydali ovqat/tez tayyor bo'ladigan fast food
defEn: Food that is good or bad for your body.
defUz: Sog'liq uchun foydali yoki zararli ovqat.

examples.en: I try to eat healthy food.
examples.uz: Men sog'liqqa foydali ovqat yeyishga harakat qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'try to + infinitiv' (to eat) harakatga urinishni bildiradi; 'healthy food' sifat+ot birikmasi.

examples.en: Fruit is healthy food.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + sifat+ot birikmasi 'healthy food' - narsani ta'riflaydi.

defEn: A competition to see who is the fastest.
defUz: Kim eng tez ekanini aniqlash uchun o'tkaziladigan musobaqa, poyga.

examples.en: My favourite athletics event is the 100-metre race.
examples.uz: Mening sevimli yengil atletika sportim bu
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'My favourite athletics event is ...' tuzilishida 'be' fe'li (is) predikat vazifasini bajaradi; 'the 100-metre race' aniq artikl 'the' bilan.

examples.en: I won the race today.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'won' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'the race' aniq artikl bilan; 'today' ravish vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A big place where people watch sport.
defUz: Odamlar sportni tomosha qiladigan katta joy, stadion.

examples.en: People are walking to the stadium to watch the big match.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are walking' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi; 'to watch' infinitiv maqsadni; 'the big match' aniq artikl bilan.

examples.en: The stadium is very big.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + ravish 'very' + sifat 'big' - narsaning belgisini bildiradi.

defEn: A group of people who play sport together.
defUz: Birgalikda sport o'ynaydigan odamlar guruhi, jamoa.

examples.en: My favourite football team lost the match today.
examples.uz: Mening sevimli futbol jamoam bugun o'yinni
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'lost' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'My favourite football team' egalik bilan boshlangan ega; 'today' ravish vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: My team won the game.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'won' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'My team' egalik olmoshi bilan ega vazifasida.

defEn: To ride a bicycle.
defUz: Velosipedda yurmoq, velosiped uchmoq.

examples.en: My dad wants to be fit, so he cycles to work in the morning.
examples.grammar: Ikki gap 'so' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan (sabab-natija); Present Simple - 'cycles' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi; 'to work' predlogli ibora yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: I cycle to school every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni maktabga velosipedda boraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'cycle' fe'li; 'to school' predlogli ibora yo'nalishni, 'every day' ibora odatni bildiradi.

defEn: To not win a game or match.
defUz: O'yinda yutqazmoq, mag'lub bo'lmoq.

examples.en: I want to score a goal
examples.uz: I don't want to lose this match! – Men go'l urishni istayman–bu o'yinni
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want to + infinitiv' (to score) istakni bildiradi; ikkinchi qism 'I don't want to lose' inkor shaklda yordamchi fe'l 'do not' bilan.

examples.en: We do not want to lose the game.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'do not want to + infinitiv' (to lose) tuzilishi istakning yo'qligini bildiradi.

defEn: To move on shoes with wheels.
defUz: G'ildirakli konkida uchmoq, to'rt g'ildirakli konkida yurmoq.

examples.en: How did you learn to roller-skate? I always fall!
examples.grammar: Past Simple so'roq gap - 'How did you learn to ...?' tuzilishi 'did' yordamchi fe'li bilan; 'to roller-skate' infinitiv; ikkinchi gap Present Simple - 'I always fall' odatni bildiradi.

examples.en: I like to roller-skate in the park.
examples.uz: Men bog'da g'ildirakli konkida uchishni yaxshi ko'raman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'like to + infinitiv' (to roller-skate); 'in the park' predlogli ibora joyni bildiradi.

defEn: To move on ice with special shoes.
defUz: Maxsus poyabzal bilan muz ustida uchmoq, konkida uchmoq.

examples.en: I learned to skate on ice in Canada.
examples.uz: Men muz ustida konkida uchishni Kanadada
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'learned' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'to skate' infinitiv; 'on ice' va 'in Canada' predlogli iboralar joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: Children skate on the lake in winter.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'skate' fe'li; 'on the lake' va 'in winter' predlogli iboralar joy va vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To ride on a board on snow or on the ground.
defUz: Taxta ustida qor yoki yer ustida uchmoq, skeytbordda yoki snovbordda uchmoq.

examples.en: When you know how to skateboard, it's easy to snowboard.
examples.grammar: Ergash gap 'When ...' bilan boshlangan (shart-payt); 'know how to + infinitiv' tuzilishi bilim yoki qobiliyatni bildiradi; bosh gapda 'it's easy to + infinitiv' tuzilishi.

examples.en: I want to learn to snowboard this winter.
examples.uz: Men bu qishda snovbordda uchishni o'rganmoqchiman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want to learn to + infinitiv' ketma-ket infinitivlar istakni bildiradi; 'this winter' ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To move on snow with long thin boards on your feet.
defUz: Oyoqqa kiyilgan uzun taxtalar bilan qor ustida uchmoq, chang'ida uchmoq.

examples.en: We learned to ski in the mountains of Austria.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'learned' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'to ski' infinitiv; 'in the mountains of Austria' predlogli ibora joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: We ski in the mountains every winter.
examples.uz: Biz har qish tog'larda chang'i uchamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'ski' fe'li; 'in the mountains' predlogli ibora joyni, 'every winter' ibora odatni bildiradi.

defEn: To move through water with your body.
defUz: Tana bilan suvda harakatlanmoq, suzmoq.

examples.en: I love to swim in the sea in the summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'love to + infinitiv' (to swim) yoqtirishni bildiradi; 'in the sea' va 'in the summer' predlogli iboralar joy va vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: I swim in the pool every week.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'swim' fe'li; 'in the pool' predlogli ibora joyni, 'every week' ibora odatni bildiradi.

defEn: To start doing a new sport or hobby.
defUz: Yangi sport yoki mashg'ulot bilan shug'ullanishni boshlamoq.

examples.en: I think I'm going to take up a new sport.
examples.uz: Menimcha men yangi bir sport bilan shug'ullanishni
examples.grammar: 'be going to + fe'l' (take up) kelasi zamonda reja yoki niyatni bildiradi; 'take up' phrasal fe'l biror ish bilan shug'ullanishni boshlashni anglatadi.

examples.en: I want to take up swimming.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want to + phrasal fe'l' (take up); 'take up' biror ishni boshlashni bildiradi.

defEn: To come first in a game or race.
defUz: O'yinda yoki poygada birinchi bo'lmoq, yutmoq, g'alaba qozonmoq.

examples.en: It's very exciting when you win a race.
examples.grammar: 'It's + sifat + when ...' tuzilishi; ergash gap 'when you win a race' Present Simple shaklida shartni bildiradi; 'very exciting' ravish+sifat birikmasi.

examples.en: I hope we win the match today.
examples.uz: Men bugun o'yinda yutishimizni umid qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'hope (that) + gap'; ergash gapda 'win' fe'li; 'today' ravish vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: Very strong, hard or dangerous.
defUz: Juda kuchli, qattiq yoki xavfli, ekstremal.

examples.en: I don't think extreme sports are safe. I don't like them.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'I don't think (that) ...' tuzilishi; ergash gapda 'are safe' Present Simple; ikkinchi gap 'I don't like them' inkor shaklda.

examples.en: Extreme sports can be dangerous.
examples.grammar: Modal fe'l 'can' + 'be' + sifat 'dangerous' imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'extreme' sifat 'sports' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: Coming before all others.
defUz: Hammadan oldin keladigan, birinchi.

examples.en: My first lesson in the morning is English.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'My first lesson ... is English' tuzilishida 'be' fe'li (is) predikat vazifasida; 'first' tartib son sifat sifatida 'lesson' otini aniqlaydi; 'in the morning' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: This is my first day at school.
examples.grammar: 'This is + egalik + ot' tuzilishi; 'first' tartib son sifat sifatida 'day' otini aniqlaydi.

uz: jismonan sog'lom va baquvvat, tetik · o'lchami mos tushmoq
defEn: Healthy and strong because you do sport.
defUz: Sport bilan shug'ullangani uchun sog'lom va baquvvat, tetik.

examples.en: Playing a sport is a great way to get fit.
examples.uz: Biror sport bilan shug'ullanish jismonan sog'lom va
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'be' fe'li (is) predikat vazifasida; 'a great way to + infinitiv' (to get fit) tuzilishi; 'Playing a sport' gerund ega vazifasida.

examples.en: She is very fit and healthy.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + ravish 'very' + sifatlar 'fit and healthy' 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan.

examples.en: This shirt is too big. It doesn't fit me.
examples.uz: Bu ko'ylak haddan tashqari katta. U menga mos emas.
examples.grammar: 'This shirt is too big' - to be fe'li, 'too' ortiqcha darajani bildiradi; 'It doesn't fit me' - Present Simple inkor 'doesn't' bilan, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'fit' - asosiy fe'l.

examples.en: These shoes fit me well.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'These' - ko'rsatish olmoshi ko'plikda; 'well' - ravish fe'ldan keyin keladi.

defEn: Good for your body or not ill.
defUz: Sog'lom yoki sog'liqqa foydali.

examples.en: It isn't healthy to sit in front of the computer all day.
examples.grammar: 'It isn't + sifat + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi (to sit) inkor shaklda; 'in front of' predlogli ibora joyni, 'all day' ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: Apples are a healthy food.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (are) + artikl 'a' + sifat 'healthy' + ot 'food' - narsani ta'riflaydi.

defEn: Done inside a building.
defUz: Bino ichida qilinadigan.

examples.en: Playing board games is my favourite indoor activity.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'be' fe'li (is) predikat vazifasida; 'my favourite indoor activity' egalik+sifatlar birikmasi; 'Playing board games' gerund ega vazifasida.

examples.en: We have an indoor pool at school.
examples.uz: Bizning maktabda bino ichidagi hovuz bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have' fe'li egalikni bildiradi; 'indoor' sifat 'pool' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: Coming after all others.
defUz: Hammadan keyin keladigan, oxirgi, so'nggi.

examples.en: Did you eat the last piece of pizza?
examples.grammar: Past Simple so'roq gap - 'Did you eat ...?' tuzilishi 'did' yordamchi fe'li bilan; 'the last piece of pizza' aniq artikl 'the' va 'of' predlogi bilan; 'last' sifat 'piece' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: This is the last day of school.
examples.grammar: 'This is + the + sifat + ot' tuzilishi; 'last' sifat 'day' otini aniqlaydi; 'of school' predlogli ibora.

defEn: Done outside in the open air.
defUz: Ochiq havoda, tashqarida qilinadigan.

examples.en: Skiing is a great outdoor activity in the winter.
examples.uz: Chang'i uchish qish faslida ajoyib ochiq havoda
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'be' fe'li (is) predikat vazifasida; 'a great outdoor activity' artikl+sifatlar birikmasi; 'in the winter' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: Football is an outdoor sport.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + artikl 'an' + sifat 'outdoor' + ot 'sport' - narsani ta'riflaydi.

defEn: Having a lot of power in your body.
defUz: Tanasida ko'p kuchga ega, kuchli.

examples.en: Football players have to be fit and strong.
examples.uz: Futbolchilar jismonan tetik va kuchli bo'lishlari shart.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have to + be' (modal majburiyat) zarurlikni bildiradi; 'fit and strong' ikki sifat 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: He is very strong.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + ravish 'very' + sifat 'strong' - shaxsning belgisini bildiradi.

defEn: Inside a building.
defUz: Bino ichida, ichkarida.

examples.en: You play squash indoors but you usually play tennis outdoors.
examples.grammar: Ikki gap 'but' bog'lovchisi bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yilgan; ikkalasi Present Simple; 'indoors' va 'outdoors' ravishlar harakat joyini bildiradi; 'usually' ravish chastotani bildiradi.

examples.en: We play indoors when it rains.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'play' fe'li; 'indoors' ravish joyni bildiradi; ergash gap 'when it rains' shart-paytni bildiradi.

defEn: Outside in the open air.
defUz: Ochiq havoda, tashqarida.

examples.en: When the weather is good, we have a lesson outdoors.
examples.uz: Havo yaxshi bo'lgan vaqtda, biz ochiq
examples.grammar: Ergash gap 'When the weather is good' (shart-payt) bilan boshlangan; bosh gap Present Simple - 'we have a lesson'; 'outdoors' ravish harakat joyini bildiradi.

examples.en: We eat outdoors in summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'eat' fe'li; 'outdoors' ravish joyni, 'in summer' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To take part in gymnastics, karate, sport or yoga.
defUz: Gimnastika, karate, sport yoki yoga bilan shug'ullanmoq.

examples.en: My mum always does yoga after work.
examples.uz: Oyim har doim ishdan keyin yoga bilan shug'ullanadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'does' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -es qo'shimchasini oladi; 'always' ravish chastotani, 'after work' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: I do yoga in the morning.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'do yoga' iborasi; 'in the morning' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To do some activity to keep your body active.
defUz: Tanani harakatda saqlash uchun biroz jismoniy mashq qilmoq.

examples.en: When you have studied for an hour, it's a good idea to get some exercise.
examples.grammar: Ergash gap Present Perfect - 'When you have studied for an hour'; bosh gapda 'it's a good idea to + infinitiv' (to get) tuzilishi; 'some exercise' sanasiz ot bilan 'some' aniqlovchisi.

examples.en: I get some exercise after school.
examples.uz: Men darsdan keyin biroz jismoniy mashq qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'get some exercise' iborasi; 'after school' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: jismonan sog'lom va baquvvat holatga erishmoq/holatini saqlab qolmoq
defEn: To become or stay healthy and strong.
defUz: Jismonan sog'lom va baquvvat holatga erishmoq yoki shu holatni saqlab qolmoq.

examples.en: Playing a sport is a good way to keep fit.
examples.uz: Biror sport bilan shug'ullanish jismonan sog'lom va
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'be' fe'li (is) predikat vazifasida; 'a good way to + infinitiv' (to keep fit) tuzilishi; 'Playing a sport' gerund ega vazifasida.

examples.en: I run every day to keep fit.
examples.uz: Men tetik bo'lib qolish uchun har kuni yuguraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'run' fe'li; 'to keep fit' infinitiv maqsadni, 'every day' ibora odatni bildiradi.

defEn: To go outside to jog, run or walk.
defUz: Yugurishga, sekin yugurishga yoki piyoda sayrga chiqmoq.

examples.en: When I want to get some exercise, I usually go for a jog.
examples.grammar: Ergash gap 'When I want to get some exercise' (shart-payt) bilan boshlangan; bosh gap Present Simple - 'I usually go for a jog'; 'usually' ravish chastotani bildiradi.

examples.en: I go for a walk every evening.
examples.uz: Men har kuni kechqurun piyoda sayrga chiqaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go for a walk' iborasi; 'every evening' ibora odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: To take part in a game of football or basketball.
defUz: Futbol yoki basketbol o'ynamoq.

examples.en: My brother plays football every Saturday.
examples.uz: Akam har shanba kuni futbol o'ynaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'plays' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi; 'every Saturday' ibora odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: We play basketball after school.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'play basketball' iborasi; 'after school' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To sit on and control a bike, horse or scooter.
defUz: Velosiped uchmoq, ot minmoq yoki skuter uchmoq.

examples.en: Do you know how to ride a horse?
examples.grammar: Present Simple so'roq gap - 'Do you know how to + infinitiv?' (to ride) tuzilishi qobiliyatni so'raydi; 'a horse' oldida 'a' artikli birlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: I ride a bike to school.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'ride a bike' iborasi; 'to school' predlogli ibora yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: To get a point in football by putting the ball in the net.
defUz: To'pni darvozaga kiritib futbolda ochko olmoq, go'l urmoq.

examples.en: I scored a goal in the football match at school.
examples.uz: Men maktabda futbol musobaqasida bitta go'l
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'scored' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'in the football match' va 'at school' predlogli iboralar joyni bildiradi; 'a goal' birlikda.

examples.en: I want to score a goal today.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want to + infinitiv' (to score a goal); 'today' ravish vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To try to win in a game or race.
defUz: O'yin yoki poygada g'olib bo'lishga harakat qilmoq, musobaqalashmoq.

examples.en: He regularly competes in races.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'competes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi; 'regularly' ravish chastotani, 'in races' predlogli ibora joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: I compete in the school race.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'compete' fe'li; 'in the school race' predlogli ibora joyni bildiradi.

defEn: An event where people try to win.
defUz: Odamlar g'olib bo'lishga harakat qiladigan tadbir, musobaqa.

examples.en: Did you win the chess competition?
examples.grammar: Past Simple so'roq gap - 'Did you win ...?' tuzilishi 'did' yordamchi fe'li bilan; 'the chess competition' aniq artikl 'the' bilan.

examples.en: We have a singing competition today.
examples.uz: Bugun bizda qo'shiq aytish musobaqasi bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have' fe'li mavjudlikni bildiradi; 'a competition' artikl 'a' bilan birlikda.

defEn: The activity of riding a bicycle.
defUz: Velosiped uchish mashg'uloti.

examples.en: Cycling is a good way to get fit.
examples.uz: Velosiped uchish jismonan sog'lom va baquvvat holatga
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'be' fe'li (is) predikat vazifasida; 'a good way to + infinitiv' (to get fit) tuzilishi; 'Cycling' gerund ega vazifasida.

examples.en: Cycling is fun and healthy.
examples.uz: Velosiped uchish qiziqarli va sog'liqqa foydali.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + sifatlar 'fun and healthy' 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan; 'Cycling' ot ega vazifasida.

defEn: A person who rides a bicycle.
defUz: Velosiped uchadigan odam, velosipedchi.

examples.en: Drivers need to be careful of cyclists on the road.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'need to + infinitiv' (to be careful) zarurlikni bildiradi; 'of cyclists' predlogli ibora; 'on the road' predlogli ibora joyni; 'cyclists' ko'plik shaklida.

examples.en: The cyclist rides very fast.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'rides' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi; 'very fast' ravish iborasi tezlikni bildiradi.

defEn: The state of being healthy and strong.
defUz: Sog'lom va baquvvat bo'lish holati, jismoniy tetiklik.

examples.en: Walking is good for health and fitness.
examples.uz: Piyoda yurish sog'liq uchun va jismoniy tetiklik uchun
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'be' fe'li (is) predikat vazifasida; 'good for ...' sifat+predlog birikmasi; 'health and fitness' ikki ot 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan; 'Walking' gerund ega vazifasida.

examples.en: Sport is good for your fitness.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + sifat 'good' + predlog 'for'; 'fitness' ot 'your' egalik olmoshi bilan.

defEn: How well your body is.
defUz: Tananing sog'lik holati, sog'liq.

examples.en: Smoking can seriously damage your health.
examples.uz: Chekish sog'liqqa jiddiy zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - modal fe'l 'can' + 'damage' imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'seriously' ravish darajani; 'your health' egalik olmoshi bilan; 'Smoking' gerund ega vazifasida.

examples.en: Good food is important for your health.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + sifat 'important' + predlog 'for'; 'health' ot 'your' egalik olmoshi bilan.

defEn: Bad for your body.
defUz: Sog'liqqa zararli, nosog'lom.

examples.en: Tia has a very unhealthy life
examples.uz: she eats all the wrong things and she never exercises. – Tiya juda
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' uchinchi shaxs birlikda egalikni bildiradi; 'a very unhealthy life' artikl+ravish+sifat birikmasi; 'unhealthy' sifat 'life' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: Junk food is unhealthy.
examples.uz: Tez tayyor bo'ladigan ovqat sog'liqqa zararli.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + sifat 'unhealthy' - narsaning belgisini bildiradi.

defEn: In a way that is good for your body.
defUz: Sog'liqqa foydali tarzda.

examples.en: Leah is always unwell because she doesn't eat healthily.
examples.uz: Liya qachon qarasangiz kasal, chunki u
examples.grammar: Ikki gap 'because' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan (sabab); ikkalasi Present Simple; 'always' ravish chastotani; 'doesn't eat healthily' inkor shaklda; 'healthily' ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi.

examples.en: I try to eat healthily every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni sog'liqqa foydali tarzda ovqatlanishga harakat qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'try to eat' infinitiv bilan; 'healthily' ravish harakat tarzini, 'every day' ibora odatni bildiradi.

uz: mag'lub bo'lgan, o'yinni boy bergan odam
defEn: A person who does not win.
defUz: G'olib bo'lmagan, o'yinni boy bergan odam, mag'lub.

examples.en: It's great when you win a game but someone is always the loser.
examples.grammar: 'It's + sifat + when ...' tuzilishi; ergash gap 'when you win a game' Present Simple; ikkinchi qism 'someone is always the loser' Present Simple, 'always' ravish bilan.

examples.en: Nobody likes to be a loser.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'like to be + ot' tuzilishi; 'Nobody' inkor ma'noli olmosh ega vazifasida.

defEn: The power to do hard things with your body.
defUz: Tana bilan og'ir ishlarni qilish quvvati, kuch.

examples.en: I haven't got the strength to pick up that sofa.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect inkor - 'haven't got' tuzilishi egalikning yo'qligini bildiradi; 'the strength to + infinitiv' (to pick up) tuzilishi; 'pick up' phrasal fe'l.

examples.en: Sport gives you strength.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'gives' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi; 'you' bavosita to'ldiruvchi, 'strength' vositasiz to'ldiruvchi.

defEn: In a very firm or powerful way.
defUz: Qattiq, kuchli tarzda, juda.

examples.en: I strongly believe that competition is a good thing.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'believe (that) ...' tuzilishi; ergash gap 'that competition is a good thing'; 'strongly' ravish 'believe' fe'lini kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: I strongly agree with you.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'agree' fe'li; 'strongly' ravish fe'lni kuchaytiradi; 'with you' predlogli ibora.

defEn: To practise a sport to get better.
defUz: Yaxshilanish uchun sport bilan mashq qilmoq, shug'ullanmoq.

examples.en: I train in the gym for two hours a day.
examples.uz: Men kuniga 2 soat sport zalida shug'ullanaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'train' fe'li odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'in the gym' predlogli ibora joyni; 'for two hours a day' ibora davomiylikni bildiradi.

examples.en: We train every morning.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'train' fe'li; 'every morning' ibora odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

uz: krasovka: jismoniy mashq qilish jarayonida kiyiladigan oyoq kiyimi · (bir juft) krossovka 57                                                                    @destination_vocabulary
defEn: Soft shoes you wear for sport.
defUz: Sport uchun kiyiladigan yumshoq oyoq kiyimi, krasovka.

examples.en: I wear trainers to school because my feet feel more comfortable in them.
examples.grammar: Ikki gap 'because' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan (sabab); Present Simple - 'wear' va 'feel' fe'llari; 'trainers' ko'plik shaklida; 'in them' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: I have new trainers for running.
examples.uz: Mening yugurish uchun yangi krasovkalarim bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have' fe'li egalikni bildiradi; 'trainers' ko'plik shaklida; 'for running' predlog+gerund maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I need new trainers so I can play tennis at the weekend.
examples.uz: Dam olish kunida tennis o'ynay olishim
examples.grammar: 'I need new trainers' - Present Simple; 'so' - maqsad bog'lovchisi; 'I can play tennis' - 'can' modal fe'li (qobiliyat); 'at the weekend' - 'at' predlogi vaqt bilan.

examples.en: My trainers are new.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot (ko'plik) + are + sifat' - egalik va to be fe'li; 'trainers' - ko'plikda; 'are' - ko'plik shakli.

defEn: Healthy and not ill.
defUz: Sog'lom, betob emas, yaxshi.

examples.en: I don't feel very well.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'don't feel' tuzilishi; 'very' ravish darajani kuchaytiradi; 'well' bu yerda sog'lik holatini bildiradi.

examples.en: I feel well today.
examples.uz: Men bugun o'zimni yaxshi his qilyapman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'feel + well' tuzilishi holatni bildiradi; 'today' ravish vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: Ill or not feeling good.
defUz: Kasal yoki o'zini yaxshi his qilmayotgan, betob.

examples.en: If you are feeling unwell, go and see the school nurse.
examples.grammar: Shart mayli - 'If you are feeling unwell, ...' shart gap Present Continuous shaklida; bosh gap buyruq gap - 'go and see' ikki fe'l 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: She is unwell and stays at home.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'be' fe'li (is) + sifat 'unwell'; ikkinchi fe'l 'stays' 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan.

defEn: A person who wins.
defUz: G'olib bo'lgan odam, g'olib.

examples.en: I'm the winner! I came first in the competition!
examples.grammar: Ikki gap; 'I'm the winner' Present Simple, 'the' aniq artikl bilan; 'I came first' Past Simple - 'came' o'tgan zamon fe'li; 'in the competition' predlogli ibora joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: She is the winner of the race.
examples.grammar: 'be' fe'li (is) + the + ot 'winner'; 'of the race' predlogli ibora egalik ma'nosini bildiradi.

uz: kaska: velosiped yoki mototsikl minganda kiyiladigan himoya bosh kiyimi
defEn: a hard hat that keeps your head safe
defUz: boshni himoya qiladigan qattiq bosh kiyim

examples.en: You have to wear a helmet when you ride your bike.
examples.grammar: 'have to + infinitiv' - majburiyatni bildiradi - 'when' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: You must wear a helmet on a bike.
examples.grammar: 'must + infinitiv' - modal fe'l majburiyatni bildiradi - 'on a bike' predlogli ibora.

defEn: rings and other pretty things you wear
defUz: uzuk va boshqa chiroyli taqiladigan narsalar

examples.en: Bethany has some really nice jewellery but she can't wear it to school.
examples.grammar: 'has + some + ot' - egalik bildiradi - 'can't' modal fe'li ruxsat yo'qligini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I like her jewellery.
examples.grammar: 'like + ot' - yoqtirishni bildiradi - 'her' egalik olmoshi.

defEn: a rule that everyone in a country must follow
defUz: mamlakatdagi hamma amal qilishi shart bo'lgan qoida

examples.en: The police will arrest you if you break the law.
examples.uz: Agar qonunni buzsangiz, politsiya sizni hibsga
examples.grammar: 'will + infinitiv' - kelasi zamonni bildiradi - 'if' shart mayli ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: We must follow the law.
examples.grammar: 'must + infinitiv' - modal fe'l majburiyatni bildiradi - 'the law' aniq artikl bilan ot.

examples.en: In Sweden it is against the law to hit a child.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'it is against the law' iborasi qonunga ziddikni bildiradi; 'In Sweden' - joy predlogli ibora, 'to hit a child' - infinitiv egadosh.

defEn: rubbish people leave on the ground
defUz: odamlar yerga tashlab ketadigan axlat

examples.en: You mustn't drop litter in the street.
examples.grammar: 'mustn't + infinitiv' - modal fe'l taqiqni bildiradi - 'in the street' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Please put your litter in the bin.
examples.grammar: 'Please + buyruq gap' - muloyim iltimos - 'in the bin' predlogli ibora.

defEn: colour you put on your face to look nice
defUz: chiroyli ko'rinish uchun yuzga suriladigan pardoz

examples.en: Do your teachers let you wear make-up at school?
examples.grammar: 'Do + ega + let + obyekt + infinitiv' - so'roq gap - 'let' modal ma'noli fe'l ruxsatni bildiradi.

examples.en: My sister wears a lot of make-up.
examples.grammar: 'wears' Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' qo'shimchasi - 'a lot of' miqdor bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: a sign that tells people something
defUz: odamlarga biror narsani bildiradigan e'lon yoki belgi

examples.en: Can't you see that notice? It says you mustn't enter here!
examples.grammar: 'Can't + ega + see' - so'roq gap - 'It says' Present Simple - 'mustn't' modal fe'l taqiqni bildiradi.

examples.en: There is a notice on the door.
examples.grammar: 'There is + ot' - birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi - 'on the door' predlogli ibora.

defEn: a person whose job is to keep people safe and stop crime
defUz: odamlarni himoya qilish va jinoyatni to'xtatish vazifasini bajaruvchi shaxs

examples.en: The police officer arrested the man for fighting in the street.
examples.grammar: 'arrested' Past Simple, fe'l '-ed' qo'shimchasi bilan - 'for + ot' sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: The police officer helped the old man.
examples.uz: Politsiya ofitseri keksa kishiga yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: 'helped' Past Simple, fe'l '-ed' qo'shimchasi bilan - 'the old man' aniq artikl bilan ot.

examples.en: You need to be fit and healthy to be a police officer. It's a hard job.
examples.grammar: 'need to be + sifat' - zaruriyatni bildiradi; 'to be a police officer' - maqsad infinitivi; 'It's a hard job' - 'It is' qisqartmasi + artikl + sifat + ot.

examples.en: The police officer helps people in the street.
examples.uz: Politsiya ofitseri ko'chada odamlarga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'helps'; 'in the street' - joy predlogli ibora.

defEn: a way that cars go on
defUz: mashinalar yuradigan yo'l

examples.en: The children have to cross a busy road to get to school.
examples.grammar: 'have to + infinitiv' - majburiyatni bildiradi - 'to get to school' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
examples.uz: Yo'ldan o'tishdan oldin ikki tomonga qarang.
examples.grammar: 'Look' buyruq gap - 'before' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi - 'the road' aniq artikl bilan ot.

defEn: things you must do to stay safe or behave well
defUz: xavfsiz bo'lish yoki yaxshi xulq uchun bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan qoidalar

examples.en: Safety rules were disregarded.
examples.grammar: 'were disregarded' Past Simple passiv - 'be + sifatdosh' ish-harakat narsaga qaratilganini bildiradi.

examples.en: We follow the safety rules at school.
examples.uz: Biz maktabda xavfsizlik qoidalariga amal qilamiz.
examples.grammar: 'follow' Present Simple, ko'plikda - 'at school' predlogli ibora.

defEn: special clothes that all students wear at school
defUz: barcha o'quvchilar maktabda kiyadigan maxsus kiyim

examples.en: We don't have to wear school uniform.
examples.uz: Biz maktab formasi kiyishimiz shart emas.
examples.grammar: 'don't have to + infinitiv' - majburiyat yo'qligini bildiradi (shart emas).

examples.en: I wear my school uniform every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni maktab formamni kiyaman.
examples.grammar: 'wear' Present Simple - 'every day' takror-takror bo'ladigan ish-harakatni bildiradi - 'my' egalik olmoshi.

defEn: a strap that keeps you safe in a car or bus
defUz: mashina yoki avtobusda sizni xavfsiz saqlaydigan kamar

examples.en: You have to wear a seatbelt on the bus.
examples.grammar: 'have to + infinitiv' - majburiyatni bildiradi - 'on the bus' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Put on your seat belt in the car.
examples.grammar: 'Put on' buyruq gap - 'your' egalik olmoshi - 'in the car' predlogli ibora.

defEn: red, yellow and green lights that tell cars to stop or go
defUz: mashinalarga to'xtash yoki yurishni bildiruvchi qizil, sariq va yashil chiroqlar

examples.en: At the next traffic lights, turn right.
examples.grammar: 'At the next traffic lights' predlogli ibora gap boshida - 'turn right' buyruq gap.

examples.en: Stop at the red traffic lights.
examples.grammar: 'Stop' buyruq gap - 'at the red traffic lights' predlogli ibora.

defEn: to say yes, somebody can do something
defUz: biror kishining biror ishni qilishiga rozilik bermoq

examples.en: Do your parents allow you to go to pyjama parties?
examples.grammar: 'Do + ega + allow + obyekt + to + infinitiv' - so'roq gap - 'allow somebody to do' tuzilmasi ruxsatni bildiradi.

examples.en: My teacher allows us to use a pen.
examples.uz: O'qituvchim bizga ruchka ishlatishga ruxsat beradi.
examples.grammar: 'allows' Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' - 'allow somebody to do' tuzilmasi.

defEn: to take somebody to the police because they broke the law
defUz: qonunni buzgani uchun biror kishini politsiyaga olib ketmoq

examples.en: The police arrested a man for taking things from a shop.
examples.grammar: 'arrested' Past Simple, fe'l '-ed' qo'shimchasi bilan - 'for + ot' sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: The police arrest bad people.
examples.grammar: 'arrest' Present Simple - 'bad people' sifat va ot birikmasi obyekt vazifasida.

defEn: to make a car go where you want
defUz: mashinani xohlagan tomonga boshqarmoq

examples.en: I'm going to learn to drive a car when I'm 17.
examples.grammar: 'going to + infinitiv' - rejalashtirilgan kelasi zamonni bildiradi - 'when' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: My dad drives to work every morning.
examples.uz: Dadam har kuni ertalab ishga mashinada boradi.
examples.grammar: 'drives' Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' - 'every morning' takroriy ish-harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: to let something fall down
defUz: biror narsani tushirib yubormoq

examples.en: Don't drop litter in the street!
examples.grammar: 'Don't + infinitiv' - inkor buyruq gap (taqiq) - 'in the street' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Be careful! Don't drop the glass.
examples.grammar: 'Don't + infinitiv' - inkor buyruq gap - 'the glass' aniq artikl bilan ot.

defEn: to go into a place
defUz: biror joyga kirmoq

examples.en: You can't enter the building. It's not open now.
examples.uz: Binoga kira olmaysiz. Hozir ochiq emas.
examples.grammar: 'can't + infinitiv' - modal fe'l imkoniyat yo'qligini bildiradi - 'It's' qisqartma Present Simple.

examples.en: You can't enter this room.
examples.grammar: 'can't + infinitiv' - modal fe'l imkoniyat yo'qligini bildiradi - 'this room' ko'rsatish olmoshi bilan ot.

defEn: to hit somebody when you are angry
defUz: jahl bilan birovni urmoq, mushtlashmoq

examples.en: You can't fight at school. The teachers will get very angry.
examples.grammar: 'can't + infinitiv' - modal fe'l ruxsat yo'qligini bildiradi - 'will get' Future kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

examples.en: Please don't fight with your brother.
examples.grammar: 'Please don't + infinitiv' - muloyim inkor buyruq gap - 'with your brother' predlogli ibora.

uz: biror narsa qilishiga qo'yib bermoq, yo'l qo'ymoq, ruxsat bermoq
defEn: to say yes, somebody can do something
defUz: biror kishiga biror ishni qilishga ruxsat bermoq

examples.en: Sometimes my mum lets me sleep at a friend's house.
examples.grammar: 'Sometimes' ravish gap boshida - 'lets' Present Simple uchinchi shaxs birlikda - 'let somebody do' tuzilmasi ruxsatni bildiradi.

examples.en: My mum lets me watch TV.
examples.uz: Oyim menga televizor ko'rishga ruxsat beradi.
examples.grammar: 'lets' Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' - 'let somebody do' tuzilmasi infinitivsiz.

defEn: to leave a car in a place for a time
defUz: mashinani biror joyga to'xtatib qo'ymoq

examples.en: You mustn't park your car in front of the hospital.
examples.grammar: 'mustn't + infinitiv' - modal fe'l taqiqni bildiradi - 'in front of the hospital' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: You can park your car here.
examples.grammar: 'can + infinitiv' - modal fe'l ruxsatni bildiradi - 'your car' egalik olmoshi bilan ot.

defEn: to put something in the rubbish
defUz: biror narsani axlatga tashlamoq

examples.en: Don't throw that away! I want it.
examples.uz: Uni axlatga tashlab yubormang! U menga kerak.
examples.grammar: 'Don't + infinitiv' - inkor buyruq gap - 'throw away' frazaviy fe'l (axlatga tashlamoq).

examples.en: Please throw away the old box.
examples.grammar: 'Please + buyruq gap' - muloyim iltimos - 'throw away' frazaviy fe'l - 'the old box' aniq artikl bilan ot.

defEn: to have clothes on your body
defUz: kiyimni egnga kiymoq

examples.en: Cyclists must wear a helmet.
examples.grammar: 'must + infinitiv' - modal fe'l majburiyatni bildiradi - 'Cyclists' ko'plikdagi ega.

examples.en: I wear a warm coat in winter.
examples.grammar: 'wear' Present Simple - 'in winter' predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: diqqatli, e'tiborli, ehtiyotkor · ehtiyotkor, e'tiborli, diqqatli
defEn: thinking about what you do so you do not hurt yourself
defUz: zarar yetkazmaslik uchun ish-harakatga e'tiborli bo'lish

examples.en: Be careful when you go out at night.
examples.grammar: 'Be + sifat' - buyruq gap - 'when' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: Be careful with the hot tea.
examples.grammar: 'Be + sifat' - buyruq gap - 'with the hot tea' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Be careful when you walk near the road.
examples.uz: Mashina yo'li yaqinida yurganda ehtiyotkor bo'ling.
examples.grammar: 'Be careful' - buyruq gap (imperative), 'to be' fe'li bilan. 'when you walk' - vaqt ergash gapi. 'near the road' - 'near' predlogi, 'the' artikl.

defEn: able to hurt you
defUz: sizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan

examples.en: I don't like walking in the park at night. It's dangerous.
examples.grammar: 'It's + sifat' - Present Simple - 'don't like + -ing' yoqtirmaslikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Fire is very dangerous.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravish sifatni kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: The pollution in cities is dangerous for your health.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l holatni bildiradi - 'dangerous for your health' sifatdan keyin 'for' predlogi keladi.

examples.en: It is dangerous to swim in this river.
examples.grammar: 'It is + sifat + to + infinitiv' tuzilmasi harakat haqida fikr bildiradi - 'in this river' joy predlogi.

defEn: needed; something you must have or do
defUz: kerakli; ega bo'lish yoki bajarish shart bo'lgan

examples.en: It isn't necessary to wear special clothes to my party.
examples.grammar: 'It isn't + sifat + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple inkor - 'to wear' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: Water is necessary for life.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'for life' predlogli ibora.

defEn: making a lot of sound
defUz: ko'p ovoz chiqaradigan

examples.en: The cars in the city are very noisy!
examples.grammar: 'ega + are + sifat' - Present Simple, ko'plikda - 'very' ravish sifatni kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: The children are very noisy today.
examples.grammar: 'ega + are + sifat' - Present Simple, ko'plikda - 'today' vaqtni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: kind and saying nice words to people
defUz: odamlarga muloyim va xushmuomala bo'lgan

examples.en: I'm always polite
examples.uz: I always say "please" and "thank you". – Men doimo xushmuomalaman–har
examples.grammar: 'ega + am + always + sifat' - Present Simple - 'always' takror-takror bo'ladigan holatni bildiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: She is always polite to her teachers.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is + always + sifat' - Present Simple - 'to her teachers' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: When you have a nice personality, you are always polite to people.
examples.grammar: 'When + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi. 'you are always polite' - 'to be' (are), 'always' chastota ravishi va sifat. 'to people' - 'to' predlogi.

examples.en: She is always polite to her teacher.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'always' - chastotani bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: with little or no sound
defUz: ozgina yoki umuman ovozsiz, jimjit

examples.en: It's quiet in my town. When I lived in the city, it was very noisy.
examples.grammar: 'It's + sifat' Present Simple - ikkinchi gap 'was' bilan Past Simple, joy o'zgarganini bildiradi.

examples.en: Please be quiet in the library.
examples.grammar: 'Please be + sifat' - muloyim buyruq gap - 'in the library' predlogli ibora.

defEn: every time; all the time
defUz: har doim; doimo

examples.en: I am always careful when I walk in the street.
examples.grammar: 'am always careful' - 'always' takrorlik ravishi 'to be' fe'lidan keyin keladi - 'when' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: I always wash my hands before I eat.
examples.uz: Men ovqatdan oldin doimo qo'limni yuvaman.
examples.grammar: 'always' takrorlik ravishi asosiy fe'ldan oldin keladi - 'before' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: not allowed by the rules or the law
defUz: qoidalar yoki qonun tomonidan ruxsat etilmagan

examples.en: You can't use mobile phones in the classroom
examples.uz: it's against the rules. – Sinfda uyali telefondan
examples.grammar: 'can't + infinitiv' - modal fe'l ruxsat yo'qligini bildiradi - 'against the rules' qoidaga zidlikni bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: It is against the law to steal.
examples.grammar: 'It is against the law + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - taqiqni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to come after the right time or just in time for something
defUz: kerakli vaqtdan keyin kelmoq yoki o'z vaqtida ulgurmoq

examples.en: I'm never late for school.
examples.grammar: 'ega + am + never + late' - Present Simple - 'never' inkor takrorlik ravishi - 'for school' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Don't be late for the bus.
examples.grammar: 'Don't be + sifat' - inkor buyruq gap - 'for the bus' predlogli ibora.

defEn: to not follow the rules or the law
defUz: qoidalarga yoki qonunga amal qilmaslik

examples.en: When we break the rules at our school, the teachers call our parents.
examples.grammar: 'When' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi - 'break the rules' ibora - 'call' Present Simple asosiy gapda.

examples.en: If you break the rules, the teacher gets angry.
examples.uz: Agar qoidalarni buzsangiz, o'qituvchi jahli chiqadi.
examples.grammar: 'If' shart mayli ergash gapini boshlaydi - 'break the rules' ibora - 'gets' Present Simple asosiy gapda.

defEn: words on a sign that say you must not run or talk
defUz: yugurmaslik yoki gaplashmaslik kerakligini bildiruvchi belgi yozuvi

examples.en: No talking! This is an exam!
examples.grammar: 'No + -ing' - taqiqni bildiruvchi qisqa ibora - 'This is + ot' Present Simple.

examples.en: No running in the classroom!
examples.grammar: 'No + -ing' - taqiqni bildiruvchi qisqa ibora - 'in the classroom' predlogli ibora.

uz: biror narsa qilishga ruxsat beril(ma)gan, biror narsa qilish mumkin (emas)
defEn: to have or not have permission to do something
defUz: biror ishni qilishga ruxsat berilgan yoki berilmagan bo'lmoq

examples.en: We're not allowed to run in the school buildings.
examples.grammar: 'be not allowed to + infinitiv' - passiv tuzilma ruxsat yo'qligini bildiradi - 'in the school buildings' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: We are not allowed to use phones in class.
examples.uz: Bizga darsda telefon ishlatishga ruxsat berilmagan.
examples.grammar: 'be not allowed to + infinitiv' - passiv tuzilma ruxsat yo'qligini bildiradi - 'in class' predlogli ibora.

defEn: to say something that is not true
defUz: haqiqat bo'lmagan narsani aytmoq, yolg'on so'zlamoq

examples.en: I can't tell a lie. I broke the window, not Josh.
examples.grammar: 'can't + infinitiv' - modal fe'l imkoniyat yo'qligini bildiradi - 'tell a lie' ibora - 'broke' Past Simple ikkinchi gapda.

examples.en: It is bad to tell a lie.
examples.grammar: 'It is + sifat + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'tell a lie' ibora.

defEn: to say what is real and true
defUz: haqiqiy va rost narsani aytmoq

examples.en: I want you to tell the truth now. Did you cheat in the test?
examples.grammar: 'want + obyekt + to + infinitiv' - tuzilma istakni bildiradi - 'tell the truth' ibora - 'Did you cheat' Past Simple so'roq gap.

examples.en: Always tell the truth to your parents.
examples.grammar: 'Always + buyruq gap' - 'tell the truth' ibora - 'to your parents' predlogli ibora.

defEn: to go to the left or right side
defUz: chap yoki o'ng tomonga burilmoq

examples.en: When you come out of the school, turn left and I'll meet you there.
examples.grammar: 'When' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi - 'turn left' buyruq gap - 'I'll meet' Future kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

examples.en: Turn left at the shop.
examples.grammar: 'Turn left' buyruq gap - 'at the shop' predlogli ibora.

defEn: words you say when you are sorry for something
defUz: biror narsa uchun afsuslanganingizda aytadigan kechirim so'zlari

examples.en: We received a letter of apology.
examples.grammar: 'received' Past Simple, fe'l '-ed' qo'shimchasi bilan - 'a letter of apology' artikl va 'of' predlogi bilan ot birikmasi.

examples.en: I want an apology from you.
examples.grammar: 'want + ot' - istakni bildiradi - 'an apology' noaniq artikl bilan ot - 'from you' predlogli ibora.

defEn: to say sorry to somebody
defUz: birovdan kechirim so'ramoq

examples.en: I apologise for what I said. I'm really sorry.
examples.uz: Men aytgan gapim uchun kechirim so'rayman. Juda
examples.grammar: 'apologise for + ot' - tuzilma sababni bildiradi - 'I'm sorry' Present Simple holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: I want to apologise for being late.
examples.grammar: 'want to + infinitiv' - istakni bildiradi - 'apologise for + -ing' tuzilmasi sababni bildiradi.

defEn: the act of looking after somebody or something
defUz: kimnidir yoki nimanidir parvarish qilish, e'tibor berish

examples.en: With proper care, the plants may last for fifty years.
examples.uz: To'g'ri parvarish bilan, bu o'simliklar 50 yil
examples.grammar: 'With proper care' predlogli ibora gap boshida - 'may + infinitiv' modal fe'l ehtimolni bildiradi.

examples.en: Plants need a lot of care.
examples.grammar: 'need + ot' - ehtiyojni bildiradi - 'a lot of' miqdor bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: Some people were badly injured and needed medical care.
examples.grammar: 'were badly injured' - Past Simple passiv (were + sifatdosh). 'needed' - Past Simple, -ed qo'shiladi. 'medical care' - sifat + ot.

examples.en: Sick people need care.
examples.grammar: 'need' - Present Simple fe'l, ega ko'plikda. 'Sick' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: not thinking about what you do
defUz: ish-harakatga e'tibor bermaydigan, ehtiyotsiz

examples.en: Don't be careless at work.
examples.grammar: 'Don't be + sifat' - inkor buyruq gap (taqiq) - 'at work' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: He is careless with his books.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'with his books' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Do not be careless with your money.
examples.grammar: 'Do not be' - inkor buyruq gap (imperative). 'with' - predlog, nimaga nisbatanligini bildiradi.

defEn: in a way that shows you are careful
defUz: ehtiyotkorlik bilan, e'tibor bilan

examples.en: Hold that knife carefully. Don't cut your hand.
examples.grammar: 'Hold + ot + carefully' - buyruq gap - 'carefully' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi - 'Don't cut' inkor buyruq gap.

examples.en: She writes carefully in her book.
examples.grammar: 'writes' Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' - 'carefully' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi.

examples.en: She writes carefully.
examples.grammar: 'writes' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 'carefully' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish, fe'ldan keyin keladi.

uz: ehtiyotsizlik bilan · bee'tiborlik bilan, beparvolik bilan
defEn: in a way that shows you are not careful
defUz: ehtiyotsizlik bilan, e'tiborsizlik bilan

examples.en: I was playing carelessly and I broke the window.
examples.grammar: 'was playing' Past Continuous davom etgan ish-harakatni bildiradi - 'carelessly' ravish - 'broke' Past Simple.

examples.en: He ran carelessly and fell down.
examples.uz: U ehtiyotsizlik bilan yugurib yiqilib tushdi.
examples.grammar: 'ran' Past Simple, noto'g'ri fe'l - 'carelessly' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi - 'and' bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: He drove carelessly.
examples.grammar: 'drove' - 'drive' fe'lining Past Simple shakli. 'carelessly' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: the chance that something bad will happen
defUz: biror yomon narsa yuz berish ehtimoli, xavf

examples.en: We weren't in any danger.
examples.uz: Biz hech qanday xavf ostida emasdik.
examples.grammar: 'weren't in any danger' - Past Simple inkor - 'any' inkor gapda noaniq miqdorni bildiradi - 'in danger' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: There is danger near the river.
examples.grammar: 'There is + ot' - birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi - 'near the river' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Fire is a danger to the forest.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'a danger to' xavf yo'naltirilganini 'to' predlogi bilan bildiradi.

defEn: in a way that can hurt you
defUz: zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan tarzda, xavfli

examples.en: Dad never drives dangerously.
examples.uz: Dadam hech qachon xavfli tarzda mashina haydamaydi.
examples.grammar: 'never drives' - Present Simple - 'never' inkor takrorlik ravishi - 'dangerously' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi.

examples.en: He drives too dangerously.
examples.grammar: 'drives' Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' - 'too' ravish darajani kuchaytiradi - 'dangerously' ravish.

examples.en: He drives dangerously in the rain.
examples.uz: U yomg'irda xavfli tarzda mashina haydaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'drives' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s bilan - 'dangerously' ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi - 'in the rain' vaqt predlogi.

defEn: a person who drives a car
defUz: mashina haydaydigan shaxs

examples.en: The driver of the car wasn't looking at the road.
examples.grammar: 'wasn't looking' - Past Continuous inkor - 'at the road' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: The bus driver is very kind.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'very' ravish sifatni kuchaytiradi.

defEn: to go into a place
defUz: biror joyga kirmoq

examples.en: Knock before you enter.
examples.grammar: 'Knock' buyruq gap - 'before' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi - 'you enter' Present Simple.

examples.en: Please enter the room quietly.
examples.grammar: 'Please + buyruq gap' - muloyim iltimos - 'quietly' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: the door or way you go into a place
defUz: biror joyga kiriladigan eshik yoki yo'l

examples.en: This is the entrance to the school
examples.uz: this is where we go in every day. – Bu maktabga kirish joyi–biz
examples.grammar: 'This is + the entrance' - Present Simple - 'to the school' predlogli ibora kirish joyini bildiradi.

examples.en: Wait for me at the entrance.
examples.grammar: 'Wait for + obyekt' - buyruq gap - 'at the entrance' predlogli ibora.

defEn: to say something that is not true
defUz: haqiqat bo'lmagan narsani aytmoq, aldamoq

examples.en: Don't lie to me!
examples.grammar: 'Don't + infinitiv' - inkor buyruq gap (taqiq) - 'to me' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: It is wrong to lie to your friends.
examples.grammar: 'It is + sifat + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'to your friends' predlogli ibora.

defEn: a person who does not tell the truth
defUz: haqiqatni aytmaydigan shaxs, yolg'onchi

examples.en: I know Kira is a liar because she said some things that were untrue.
examples.grammar: 'know' Present Simple asosiy gapda - 'because' bog'lovchisi sabab ergash gapini boshlaydi - 'were' Past Simple.

examples.en: Nobody likes a liar.
examples.grammar: 'Nobody' inkor olmosh ega - 'likes' Present Simple uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' - 'a liar' noaniq artikl bilan ot.

defEn: a loud or unpleasant sound
defUz: baland yoki yoqimsiz ovoz, shovqin

examples.en: Don't make a noise.
examples.grammar: 'Don't + infinitiv' - inkor buyruq gap - 'make a noise' ibora ovoz chiqarishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The cars make a lot of noise.
examples.grammar: 'make' Present Simple, ko'plikda - 'a lot of' miqdor bildiruvchi ibora - 'noise' sanalmaydigan ot.

defEn: in a way that makes a lot of sound
defUz: ko'p ovoz chiqarib, shovqin bilan

examples.en: My sister walked in the room noisily and woke me up.
examples.grammar: 'walked' Past Simple, fe'l '-ed' qo'shimchasi bilan - 'noisily' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi - 'and woke me up' frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: The dog barked noisily all night.
examples.uz: It tun bo'yi shovqin bilan vovulladi.
examples.grammar: 'barked' Past Simple, fe'l '-ed' qo'shimchasi bilan - 'noisily' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi - 'all night' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: not kind or polite to people
defUz: odamlarga nisbatan muloyim emas, qo'pol

examples.en: If you don't speak, people will think you are being impolite.
examples.grammar: 'If' shart mayli ergash gapini boshlaydi - 'will think' Future kelasi zamonni bildiradi - 'are being + sifat' vaqtinchalik holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: It is impolite to talk with your mouth full.
examples.grammar: 'It is + sifat + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'with your mouth full' predlogli ibora.

examples.en: It is impolite to shout.
examples.grammar: 'It is + sifat + to + fe'l' - 'to be' va infinitiv qurilishi. 'impolite' - sifat.

defEn: in a way that makes little or no sound
defUz: ozgina yoki umuman ovoz chiqarmay, jimgina

examples.en: Mum's sleeping, so talk quietly.
examples.uz: Oyim uxlayaptilar, shuning uchun shovqin chiqarmay gapiring.
examples.grammar: 'is sleeping' Present Continuous davom etgan ish-harakatni bildiradi - 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani bildiradi - 'talk quietly' buyruq gapda 'quietly' ravish.

examples.en: The baby is sleeping, so walk quietly.
examples.uz: Chaqaloq uxlayapti, shuning uchun jimgina yuring.
examples.grammar: 'is sleeping' Present Continuous - 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani bildiradi - 'quietly' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: real and not false
defUz: haqiqiy va yolg'on bo'lmagan, rost

examples.en: Stop telling lies! I want to hear what's true!
examples.grammar: 'Stop + -ing' tuzilma to'xtatishni bildiradi - 'I want to hear' Present Simple - 'what's true' ergash gap.

examples.en: Her story is true.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'her' egalik olmoshi.

defEn: not true; false
defUz: rost emas; yolg'on, noto'g'ri

examples.en: What you said was untrue. It was a lie.
examples.uz: Aytgan gapingiz noto'g'ri edi. U yolg'on edi.
examples.grammar: 'What you said' ergash gap ega vazifasida - 'was untrue' Past Simple - 'It was a lie' Past Simple ikkinchi gapda.

examples.en: That story is untrue.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is + sifat' - Present Simple - 'that' ko'rsatish olmoshi.

defEn: the real facts; what is true
defUz: haqiqiy faktlar; rost bo'lgan narsa, haqiqat

examples.en: Do you think she's telling the truth?
examples.grammar: 'Do + ega + think' so'roq gap - 'she's telling' Present Continuous davom etgan ish-harakatni bildiradi - 'the truth' aniq artikl bilan ot.

examples.en: Please tell me the truth.
examples.grammar: 'Please tell + obyekt + ot' - muloyim buyruq gap - 'the truth' aniq artikl bilan ot.

defEn: A meal cooked outdoors over a fire.
defUz: Ochiq havoda olov ustida pishirilgan ovqat.

examples.en: Barbecues are great! I love eating outdoors.
examples.uz: Barbekyular juda ajoyib! Men ochiq havoda
examples.grammar: 'Barbecues are great' - 'ot (ko'plik) + are + sifat' tuzilishi, Present Simple, 'to be' fe'lining ko'plik shakli 'are' ishlatilgan.

examples.en: We have a barbecue in the garden every summer.
examples.uz: Biz har yozda bog'da barbekyu qilamiz.
examples.grammar: 'have + a + barbecue' - Present Simple, 'every summer' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: A plastic card or money used to pay for things.

examples.en: Do you want to pay by credit card or in cash?
examples.uz: Plastik kartochkasi orqali to'lashni  istaysizmi yoki
examples.grammar: 'Do you want to pay by ...?' - 'Do + you + want + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi, so'roq gap, 'by' predlogi to'lov usulini bildiradi.

examples.en: I want to pay by credit card, not cash.
examples.uz: Men naqd pul bilan emas, plastik karta orqali to'lamoqchiman.
examples.grammar: 'want + to + pay' - infinitiv, 'by credit card' predlogli birikma to'lov vositasini bildiradi.

defEn: A hot brown drink made from coffee beans.
defUz: Qahva donalaridan tayyorlanadigan issiq jigarrang ichimlik.

examples.en: It's a bad idea to drink coffee in the evening
examples.uz: you won't sleep. – Oqshomda qahva ichish yomon
examples.grammar: 'It is a bad idea to drink coffee' - 'It is + sifat + ot + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi, 'it' bog'liqligi bilan harakat baholanadi.

examples.en: I drink coffee every morning.
examples.grammar: 'drink + coffee' - Present Simple, 'every morning' odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: A drink made from fruit.

defEn: A person who helps someone in their work.
defUz: Kishiga ishida yordam beradigan shaxs.

examples.en: My mum works as an assistant to the manager.
examples.grammar: 'My mum works as an assistant to the manager' - Present Simple, 'works as' kasbni bildiradi, 'an' artikli unli bilan boshlangan ot oldida ishlatiladi.

examples.en: She is an assistant in the shop.
examples.grammar: 'is + an + assistant' - Present Simple, 'an' artikli kasbni bildiruvchi ot oldida ishlatiladi.

examples.en: Mum works as an assistant to the manager.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works as' kasbni bildiradi; 'an assistant' - 'an' artikli unli tovush oldidan, 'to the manager' - yo'nalish predlogi.

examples.en: The assistant helps the manager every day.
examples.uz: Yordamchi har kuni ish boshqaruvchiga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'helps'; 'every day' - vaqt ravishi.

defEn: The activity of making food.
defUz: Ovqat tayyorlash faoliyati.

examples.en: I love cooking
examples.uz: I always make dinner in my house. – Menga ovqat pishirish yoqadi–uyda doim
examples.grammar: 'I love cooking' - 'love + -ing' gerund tuzilishi, 'cooking' harakat nomini bildiradi.

examples.en: Cooking is fun for me.
examples.grammar: 'Cooking is + sifat' - Present Simple, 'cooking' gerund ega vazifasini bajaradi.

defEn: To shut something.
defUz: Biror narsani yopmoq.

examples.en: It's dark now—let's close the curtains.
examples.grammar: 'let's close the curtains' - 'let's + infinitiv' taklif shakli, 'the' artikli aniq narsani bildiradi.

examples.en: Please close the door.
examples.grammar: 'close + the + door' - buyruq gap, 'please' iltimosni yumshatadi.

defEn: Cooked in hot oil.
defUz: Qaynoq yog'da pishirilgan.

examples.en: We're having fried chicken for dinner.
examples.grammar: 'We're having fried chicken for dinner' - Present Continuous ('are having'), 'fried' sifati otni aniqlaydi, 'for' predlogi maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I like fried fish.
examples.grammar: 'fried + ot' - 'fried' sifati 'fish' otini aniqlaydi, Present Simple.

defEn: The feeling of needing to eat.
defUz: Ovqat yeyish kerakligi hissi.

examples.en: Thousands of people have died of hunger.
examples.grammar: 'Thousands of people have died of hunger' - Present Perfect ('have died'), 'of' predlogi sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: Hunger is a big problem in some countries.
examples.grammar: 'Hunger is + ot' - Present Simple, 'hunger' sanalmaydigan ot ega vazifasini bajaradi.

defEn: A white thing we put on food to give it taste.
defUz: Ovqatga ta'm berish uchun qo'shiladigan oq narsa.

examples.en: Pass the salt, please.
examples.grammar: 'Pass the salt, please' - buyruq gap, 'pass' fe'li, 'the' artikli aniq narsani bildiradi, 'please' iltimosni yumshatadi.

examples.en: I put salt on my food.
examples.grammar: 'put + salt + on' - Present Simple, 'on' predlogi yuzani bildiradi.

defEn: To buy things in shops.
defUz: Do'konlardan narsa sotib olmoq.

examples.en: He likes to shop at the local market.
examples.uz: U mahalliy bozorda xarid qilishni yoqtiradi.
examples.grammar: 'He likes to shop at the local market' - 'like + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi, 'at' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: We shop at the supermarket.
examples.grammar: 'shop + at' - Present Simple, 'at the supermarket' predlogli birikma joyni bildiradi.

defEn: The activity of buying things in shops.
defUz: Do'konlardan narsa sotib olish faoliyati.

examples.en: My favourite activity is shopping
examples.uz: I love buying things. – Mening sevimli mashg'ulotim bu xarid
examples.grammar: 'My favourite activity is shopping' - Present Simple, 'is' ta'rif beradi, 'shopping' gerund ot vazifasini bajaradi.

examples.en: I like shopping with my friends.
examples.uz: Menga do'stlarim bilan xarid qilish yoqadi.
examples.grammar: 'like + shopping' - Present Simple, 'shopping' gerund toldiruvchi vazifasini bajaradi.

defEn: A person who is buying things in shops.
defUz: Do'konlardan narsa sotib olayotgan kishi.

examples.en: There are a lot of shoppers in the town centre today.
examples.grammar: 'There are a lot of shoppers in the town centre today' - 'There are' ko'plik shakli, 'a lot of' ko'p miqdorni bildiradi, 'in' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The shop is full of shoppers today.
examples.grammar: 'full of + shoppers' - Present Simple, 'of' predlogi to'lalik mazmunini bildiradi.

defEn: The feeling of needing to drink.
defUz: Ichish kerakligi hissi.

examples.en: Thousands are dying of thirst.
examples.uz: Minglab odamlar suvga tashnalikdan halok bo'lyapti.
examples.grammar: 'Thousands are dying of thirst' - Present Continuous ('are dying'), 'of' predlogi sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: I drink water for my thirst.
examples.grammar: 'drink water for + thirst' - Present Simple, 'for' predlogi sababni bildiradi.

defEn: the way a person or thing looks
defUz: odam yoki narsaning tashqi qiyofasi

examples.en: Owen doesn't care about his appearance. His clothes are often dirty.
examples.grammar: 'doesn't care about' - Present Simple inkor, uchinchi shaxs birlik (does not + fe'l). 'about' - predlog, mavzuni bildiradi. 'his' - egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: She has a tidy appearance.
examples.grammar: 'has' - 'have' fe'lining uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli. 'a tidy appearance' - 'a' artikl, 'tidy' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: the shape and size of a person's body
defUz: odam tanasining shakli va o'lchami (qomati)

examples.en: I haven't got the right height or build to become a police officer.
examples.grammar: 'haven't got' - Present Perfect inkor, egalikni bildiradi (have not got). 'to become' - infinitiv, maqsadni bildiradi. 'the right' - 'the' aniq artikl.

examples.en: My brother has a strong build.
examples.grammar: 'has' - 'have' fe'lining uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli. 'strong' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: I wonder if it's hard to build a house.
examples.grammar: 'I wonder if + it's + sifat + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'if' bilvosita so'roqni qo'shadi, 'to build' infinitiv shakli.

examples.en: They build new houses here.
examples.uz: Ular bu yerda yangi uylar quradi.
examples.grammar: 'They + fe'l + sifat + ot + here' - Present Simple, ko'plikdagi egaga fe'l asl shaklida qoladi.

defEn: the kind of person someone is inside
defUz: insonning ichki fe'l-atvori, xulqi

examples.en: A person's character is important. I can't be friends with someone rude.
examples.grammar: 'is important' - 'to be' fe'li (is) va sifat. 'can't be' - modal fe'l 'can' inkor (cannot). 'someone rude' - olmosh va sifat.

examples.en: He has a kind character.
examples.grammar: 'has' - 'have' fe'lining uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli. 'kind' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: the front part of a person's head
defUz: odam boshining old qismi (yuz)

examples.en: The first thing I look at is a person's face.
examples.uz: Men nazar tashlaydigan birinchi narsa bu insonning
examples.grammar: 'The first thing' - 'the' aniq artikl, 'first' tartib son. 'I look at' - Present Simple, 'at' predlogi bilan. 'a person's' - egalik shakli (-'s).

examples.en: She has a happy face.
examples.grammar: 'has' - 'have' fe'lining uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli. 'happy' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: how tall a person or thing is
defUz: odam yoki narsaning balandligi (bo'yi)

examples.en: My height is 1 metre 67 cm.
examples.grammar: 'My height is' - 'to be' fe'li (is) va egalik olmoshi. '1 metre 67 cm' - o'lchovni bildiruvchi son birikmasi.

examples.en: What is your height?
examples.grammar: 'What is ...?' - 'to be' fe'li bilan so'roq gap. 'your' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: the way a person thinks, feels and behaves
defUz: odamning fikrlash, his qilish va o'zini tutish tarzi

examples.en: I choose my friends because of their personality.
examples.uz: Men do'stlarimni o'ziga xos fe'l-atvori uchun
examples.grammar: 'I choose' - Present Simple fe'l. 'because of + ot' - sabab predlog iborasi. 'their' - egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: She has a nice personality.
examples.grammar: 'has' - 'have' fe'lining uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli. 'nice' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: a small animal that people keep as a pet
defUz: odamlar uyda boqadigan kichik hayvon (mushuk)

examples.en: My pet cat Jason has got a long tail.
examples.uz: Mening xonaki mushugim Jeysnning uzun dumi bor.
examples.grammar: 'has got' - Present Perfect shaklida egalikni bildiradi (has got). 'a long tail' - 'a' artikl, 'long' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: My cat sleeps all day.
examples.grammar: 'sleeps' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi, Present Simple. 'all day' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: an animal that many people keep as a pet
defUz: ko'p odamlar uyda boqadigan hayvon (it, kuchuk)

examples.en: I take my dog for his daily walk after school.
examples.uz: Men maktabdan keyin kuchugimni har kunlik
examples.grammar: 'take ... for a walk' - sayrga olib chiqmoqni bildiruvchi ibora. 'his daily walk' - egalik olmoshi va sifat. 'after school' - 'after' predlogi.

examples.en: My dog likes to run in the park.
examples.grammar: 'likes' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 'to run' - infinitiv. 'in the park' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

defEn: a small furry animal kept as a pet
defUz: uyda boqiladigan kichik junli hayvon (uy sichqoni)

examples.en: Liam feeds his pet hamster when he gets up in the morning.
examples.grammar: 'feeds' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi, Present Simple. 'when + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi. 'in the morning' - 'in' predlogi.

examples.en: My hamster is very small.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'small' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a colourful bird that can copy words
defUz: so'zlarni takrorlay oladigan rang-barang qush (to'ti)

examples.en: You can teach your pet parrot to talk.
examples.grammar: 'can teach' - modal fe'l 'can' va asosiy fe'l asl shaklda. 'to talk' - infinitiv. 'your pet parrot' - egalik olmoshi va ot.

examples.en: My parrot can say my name.
examples.grammar: 'can say' - modal fe'l 'can' bilan, asosiy fe'l asl shaklda. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: a small animal with long ears
defUz: uzun quloqli kichik hayvon (quyon)

examples.en: We have a pet rabbit. It lives in the garden.
examples.uz: Uyimizda quyonimiz bor. U bog'da yashaydi.
examples.grammar: 'We have' - Present Simple, egalikni bildiradi. 'It lives' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 'in the garden' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: The rabbit eats fresh grass.
examples.grammar: 'eats' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi, Present Simple. 'fresh' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: a slow animal with a hard shell
defUz: qattiq qobiqli sekin hayvon (toshbaqa)

examples.en: I'd like to keep a tortoise as a pet.
examples.uz: Men uy hayvoni sifatida toshbaqa boqishni xohlardim.
examples.grammar: 'I'd like to + fe'l' - 'would like' qisqargan shakli, xohishni bildiradi, undan keyin infinitiv keladi. 'as a pet' - 'as' predlogi.

examples.en: The tortoise walks very slowly.
examples.grammar: 'walks' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. 'slowly' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a happy look on the face
defUz: yuzdagi xursand ifoda (tabassum)

examples.en: My mum always has a smile on her face. She never frowns.
examples.grammar: 'always has' - Present Simple, 'always' chastotani bildiruvchi ravish fe'ldan oldin keladi. 'never frowns' - 'never' inkor ravishi, fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

examples.en: She has a beautiful smile.
examples.grammar: 'has' - 'have' fe'lining uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli. 'beautiful' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: how heavy a person or thing is
defUz: odam yoki narsaning og'irligi

examples.en: The doctor wrote down my age, height and weight.
examples.grammar: 'wrote down' - Past Simple frazaviy fe'l (write down). 'my age, height and weight' - 'and' bog'lovchisi sanab o'tishda ishlatiladi.

examples.en: The box has a heavy weight.
examples.grammar: 'has' - 'have' fe'lining uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli. 'heavy' - sifat, otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: to like and respect someone very much
defUz: kishini juda yaxshi ko'rmoq va hurmat qilmoq

examples.en: I admire my mum because she's very good at her job.
examples.uz: Men oyimga qoyil qolaman chunki u o'z
examples.grammar: 'I admire' - Present Simple fe'l. 'because + ergash gap' - sabab ergash gapi. 'is good at' - 'to be' va 'at' predlogi bilan ibora.

examples.en: I admire my teacher.
examples.grammar: 'admire' - Present Simple fe'l. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to make an angry or sad face
defUz: qovog'ini solmoq, xo'mraymoq

examples.en: Why are you frowning? You look sad.
examples.grammar: 'Why are you frowning?' - Present Continuous so'roq gap (to be + fe'l-ing), 'Why' so'roq so'zi bilan. 'look sad' - 'look' fe'li va sifat.

examples.en: Do not frown at me.
examples.grammar: 'Do not + fe'l' - inkor buyruq gap (imperative). 'at me' - 'at' predlogi bilan.

defEn: to have a good relationship with someone
defUz: kimdir bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmoq

examples.en: Do you get on with your relatives or do you fight?
examples.grammar: 'Do you get on with ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'li bilan. 'or' - tanlov bog'lovchisi. 'get on with' - frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: I get on with my classmates.
examples.grammar: 'get on with' - frazaviy fe'l, Present Simple. 'with' - predlog, hamrohlikni bildiradi.

uz: vaqtinchalik qarab turmoq, g'amxo'rlik qilmoq, boqmoq
defEn: to take care of someone or something
defUz: kimgadir yoki nimagadir g'amxo'rlik qilmoq

examples.en: I'm looking after my best friend's dog while she's on holiday.
