examples.grammar: 'I'm looking after' - Present Continuous (to be + fe'l-ing), 'look after' frazaviy fe'l. 'while + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi.

examples.en: I look after my little sister.
examples.grammar: 'look after' - frazaviy fe'l, Present Simple. 'my little sister' - egalik olmoshi va sifat.

defEn: to like someone or something very much
defUz: kimnidir yoki nimanidir juda yaxshi ko'rmoq

examples.en: I love my pets very much.
examples.uz: Men uy hayvonlarimni juda yaxshi ko'raman.
examples.grammar: 'I love' - Present Simple fe'l. 'very much' - darajani bildiruvchi ibora. 'my pets' - egalik olmoshi va ko'plik.

examples.en: I love my family.
examples.grammar: 'love' - Present Simple fe'l. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to like one thing more than another
defUz: bir narsani boshqasidan ko'ra afzal ko'rmoq

examples.en: I prefer cats to dogs. I don't like dogs very much.
examples.grammar: 'I prefer X to Y' - Present Simple, afzal ko'rishni bildiradi, 'to' predlogi bilan. 'don't like' - Present Simple inkor (do not).

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
examples.uz: Men qahvadan ko'ra choyni afzal ko'raman.
examples.grammar: 'prefer X to Y' - Present Simple, 'to' predlogi solishtirishda ishlatiladi.

defEn: to think highly of someone or their feelings
defUz: kishini yoki uning his-tuyg'ularini qadrlamoq, hurmat qilmoq

examples.en: You must respect how other people feel. We are not all the same.
examples.grammar: 'must respect' - modal fe'l 'must' va asosiy fe'l asl shaklda. 'how + ergash gap' - to'ldiruvchi ergash gap. 'not all the same' - inkor ibora.

examples.en: I respect my parents.
examples.grammar: 'respect' - Present Simple fe'l. 'my parents' - egalik olmoshi va ko'plik.

defEn: to look or behave like an older relative
defUz: kattaroq qarindoshga o'xshamoq yoki tortmoq

examples.en: I take after my dad. We have the same hair and eyes.
examples.grammar: 'I take after' - Present Simple frazaviy fe'l, o'xshashlikni bildiradi. 'the same hair and eyes' - 'the' artikl, 'and' bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: I take after my mother.
examples.grammar: 'take after' - frazaviy fe'l, Present Simple. 'my mother' - egalik olmoshi va ot.

defEn: to believe that someone is honest and good
defUz: kishining halol va yaxshi ekaniga ishonmoq

examples.en: I can trust my friends. They're all very reliable and loyal.
examples.grammar: 'can trust' - modal fe'l 'can' va asosiy fe'l asl shaklda. 'They're all' - 'to be' (are) va 'all' so'zi. 'reliable and loyal' - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: I trust my best friend.
examples.grammar: 'trust' - Present Simple fe'l. 'best' - 'good' sifatining ustun darajasi.

defEn: pretty and nice to look at
defUz: chiroyli va yoqimtoy

examples.en: My pet hamster is really cute.
examples.grammar: 'is really cute' - 'to be' fe'li (is) va sifat, 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish. 'My pet hamster' - egalik olmoshi va ot.

examples.en: The little cat is very cute.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'cute' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: having a nice or attractive face
defUz: chiroyli yuzga ega, ko'rkam

examples.en: George is really good-looking. He's got fair hair and blue eyes.
examples.grammar: 'is really good-looking' - 'to be' fe'li (is) va sifat. 'has got' - egalikni bildiradi (has got). 'fair hair and blue eyes' - 'and' bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: Her brother is very good-looking.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'good-looking' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: always supporting your friends or family
defUz: do'stlari yoki oilasini doimo qo'llaydigan (sodiq)

examples.en: It's important that my friends are loyal and reliable.
examples.grammar: 'It's important that + ergash gap' - to'ldiruvchi ergash gap, 'that' bog'lovchisi bilan. 'loyal and reliable' - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: A dog is a loyal animal.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'a loyal animal' - 'a' artikl, 'loyal' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: able to be trusted to do something well
defUz: biror ishni yaxshi bajarishiga ishonsa bo'ladigan

examples.en: Reliable people are never late.
examples.uz: Ishonsa bo'ladigan odamlar hech qachon kechikishmaydi.
examples.grammar: 'Reliable people' - sifat + ot ko'plikda, ega vazifasida. 'never' - inkorni bildiruvchi ravish, fe'ldan oldin keladi. 'are late' - 'to be' (are) va sifat.

examples.en: My friend is very reliable.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'reliable' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: not tall; small in height
defUz: novcha emas; bo'yi past

examples.en: My pet dog's got very short legs.
examples.uz: Mening kuchugimning juda kalta oyoqlari bor.
examples.grammar: 'has got' - egalikni bildiradi (has got). 'very short legs' - 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish, 'short' sifat ko'plik otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: My little brother is short.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'short' - sifat, kesim vazifasida.

defEn: thin in a nice and healthy way
defUz: chiroyli va sog'lom ko'rinishda ozg'in (xushbichim)

examples.en: Peter is slim because he gets a lot of exercise and he doesn't eat much.
examples.grammar: 'is slim' - 'to be' fe'li (is) va sifat. 'because + ergash gap' - sabab ergash gapi. 'doesn't eat much' - Present Simple inkor (does not).

examples.en: She is tall and slim.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'tall and slim' - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

defEn: having more than the usual height
defUz: odatdagidan balandroq bo'yga ega (novcha)

examples.en: Toby is very tall. That helps him when he plays basketball.
examples.grammar: 'is very tall' - 'to be' fe'li (is) va sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish. 'helps him when + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi, 'helps' fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

examples.en: My father is very tall.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'tall' - sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: to think something is important to you
defUz: biror narsani o'zingiz uchun muhim deb bilmoq

examples.en: Charlotte doesn't care about sport
examples.uz: she's not interested in it. – Sharlet sport haqida
examples.grammar: 'doesn't care about' - Present Simple inkor, uchinchi shaxs birlik (does not + fe'l). 'about' - predlog, mavzuni bildiradi.

examples.en: I care about my friends.
examples.grammar: 'care about' - 'about' predlogi bilan ibora, Present Simple. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to seem different, great or the same in looks
defUz: tashqi ko'rinishda boshqacha, ajoyib yoki bir xil ko'rinmoq

examples.en: They are sisters but they look very different.
examples.grammar: 'They are sisters' - 'to be' (are) va ot ko'plikda. 'but' - zid bog'lovchisi. 'look very different' - 'look' fe'li va sifat, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: The twins look the same.
examples.grammar: 'look' - Present Simple fe'l. 'the same' - 'the' aniq artikl bilan ibora.

defEn: to do or say something that makes a person laugh
defUz: biror kishini kuldiradigan ish qilmoq yoki gap aytmoq

examples.en: Harrison makes me laugh
examples.uz: he's a funny guy. – Harisen meni kuldiradi–u kulgili bola.
examples.grammar: 'makes me laugh' - 'make + someone + fe'l asl shaklda' qurilishi. 'makes' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shiladi. 'a funny guy' - 'a' artikl, 'funny' sifat.

examples.en: My friend makes me laugh.
examples.grammar: 'make + someone + fe'l' qurilishi. 'makes' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shiladi.

defEn: to look after someone or something
defUz: kimgadir yoki nimagadir g'amxo'rlik qilmoq, qarab turmoq

examples.en: My friend, Connor, takes care of my dog for me when I'm on holiday.
examples.grammar: 'takes care of' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shiladi, 'of' predlogi bilan ibora. 'when + ergash gap' - vaqt ergash gapi.

examples.en: I take care of my pets.
examples.grammar: 'take care of' - 'of' predlogi bilan ibora, Present Simple. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to feel nervous or afraid about something
defUz: biror narsa haqida tashvishlanmoq, xavotirlanmoq

examples.en: Please stay safe when you're travelling. You know I worry about you.
examples.grammar: 'Please stay safe' - buyruq gap (imperative), 'Please' xushmuomalalik so'zi. 'when you're travelling' - Present Continuous ergash gap. 'I worry about you' - Present Simple, 'about' predlogi.

examples.en: I worry about my exam.
examples.grammar: 'worry about' - 'about' predlogi bilan ibora, Present Simple. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: a feeling of liking and respecting someone
defUz: kishini yoqtirish va hurmat qilish hissi (havas)

examples.en: I have a lot of admiration for people who help others. It's a great thing to do.
examples.grammar: 'have a lot of admiration for' - Present Simple, 'a lot of' ko'p miqdorni bildiradi, 'for' predlogi bilan. 'who help others' - 'who' bilan sifatlovchi ergash gap.

examples.en: I have great admiration for my teacher.
examples.grammar: 'have' - Present Simple fe'l. 'for' - predlog, kimga qaratilganini bildiradi.

defEn: to come into sight; to be seen
defUz: ko'rinmoq, paydo bo'lmoq

examples.en: Her dead mother appeared to her in a dream.
examples.uz: Uning vafot etgan onasi tushida unga ko'rindi.
examples.grammar: 'appeared to her' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi, 'to' predlogi bilan. 'in a dream' - 'in' predlogi, 'a' artikl. 'Her dead mother' - egalik olmoshi va sifat.

examples.en: The sun appears in the morning.
examples.grammar: 'appears' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi, Present Simple. 'in the morning' - 'in' predlogi.

defEn: kind and helpful to other people
defUz: boshqalarga mehribon va yordamchi (g'amxo'r)

examples.en: Mum's a very caring person.
examples.grammar: 'is a very caring person' - 'to be' (is), 'a' artikl, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish va 'caring' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: My mother is a caring person.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'a caring person' - 'a' artikl, 'caring' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

uz: mehribonlik bilan, iltifot bilan, marhamat bilan
defEn: in a kind and gentle way
defUz: mehribonlik va muloyimlik bilan

examples.en: She very kindly invited me to lunch.
examples.uz: U iltifot bilan meni tushlikka taklif qildi.
examples.grammar: 'very kindly invited' - Past Simple, 'kindly' tarzni bildiruvchi ravish fe'ldan oldin keladi, 'very' kuchaytiradi. 'to lunch' - 'to' predlogi.

examples.en: She kindly helped me.
examples.uz: U mehribonlik bilan menga yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: 'helped' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi. 'kindly' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish, fe'ldan oldin keladi.

defEn: the sound of people laughing
defUz: odamlarning kulish ovozi (kulgi)

examples.en: I could hear laughter so I knew the children were happy.
examples.grammar: 'could hear' - modal fe'l 'can' Past Simple shakli (could) va asosiy fe'l asl shaklda. 'so + ergash gap' - natija ergash gapi. 'were happy' - Past Simple 'to be' (were).

examples.en: I heard laughter in the room.
examples.grammar: 'heard' - 'hear' fe'lining Past Simple shakli. 'in the room' - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

defEn: a man, woman or child
defUz: erkak, ayol yoki bola (shaxs, odam)

examples.en: He's a fascinating person.
examples.grammar: 'He's a fascinating person' - 'to be' (is) qisqargan shakl, 'a' artikl va 'fascinating' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: She is a kind person.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'a kind person' - 'a' artikl, 'kind' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: in a polite and respectful way
defUz: muloyimlik va hurmat bilan

examples.en: The receptionist smiled politely.
examples.grammar: 'smiled politely' - Past Simple, fe'lga -ed qo'shiladi, 'politely' tarzni bildiruvchi ravish fe'ldan keyin keladi. 'The receptionist' - 'the' aniq artikl.

examples.en: He spoke politely to the guest.
examples.grammar: 'spoke' - 'speak' fe'lining Past Simple shakli. 'politely' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: the thing you like more than another
defUz: boshqasidan ko'ra ko'proq yoqtiradigan narsa (afzallik)

examples.en: We can eat Indian or Chinese food tonight. Do you have a preference?
examples.grammar: 'can eat' - modal fe'l 'can' va asosiy fe'l asl shaklda. 'or' - tanlov bog'lovchisi. 'Do you have a preference?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'a' artikl bilan ot.

examples.en: My preference is tea.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'My' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: to trust or depend on someone or something
defUz: kimgadir yoki nimagadir ishonmoq, suyanmoq

examples.en: You can rely on me to keep your secret.
examples.grammar: 'can rely on me' - modal fe'l 'can' va 'rely on' frazaviy fe'l, 'on' predlogi bilan. 'to keep your secret' - infinitiv (maqsad).

examples.en: I rely on my best friend.
examples.grammar: 'rely on' - frazaviy fe'l, 'on' predlogi bilan, Present Simple. 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

defEn: not able to be trusted to do something
defUz: biror ishni bajarishiga ishonib bo'lmaydigan (ishonchsiz)

examples.en: Logan's really unreliable. He says things and then he doesn't do them.
examples.grammar: 'is really unreliable' - 'to be' (is) va sifat, 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish. 'says ... and then' - Present Simple, 'and' bog'lovchisi. 'doesn't do' - inkor (does not).

examples.en: His old car is unreliable.
examples.grammar: 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli. 'unreliable' - sifat, kesim vazifasida.

defEn: a large area with many trees
defUz: ko'p daraxtlari bor katta yer, o'rmon
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The forest has got thousands of trees.
examples.grammar: 'has got' - Present Simple da egalik, ya'ni biror narsa borligini bildiradi - 'thousands of' ot oldidan ko'plikni ifodalaydi.

examples.en: We walk in the forest every weekend.
examples.uz: Biz har dam olish kunida o'rmonda sayr qilamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'walk' fe'li odat ish-harakatini bildiradi - 'in the forest' joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: a small mountain
defUz: kichik tog', tepalik
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: We live in a house on a hill. We can see the town from here.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'live' fe'li - 'on a hill' joy predlogi 'on' va 'a' artikli bilan birlikdagi otni bildiradi.

examples.en: There is a big tree on the hill.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + ot' - birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi - 'on the hill' joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: a large area of water with land around it
defUz: atrofi quruqlik bilan o'ralgan katta suv havzasi, ko'l
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: There are a lot of fish in the lake.
examples.uz: Bu ko'lda juda ko'p baliq bor.
examples.grammar: 'There are + a lot of + ko'plik ot' - ko'p narsa borligini bildiradi - 'in the lake' joy predlogi.

examples.en: We can swim in the lake in summer.
examples.grammar: 'can + infinitiv' modal fe'l qobiliyat yoki imkoniyatni bildiradi - 'in the lake' joy predlogi.

defEn: a very high hill
defUz: juda baland tog'
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Have you ever climbed a high mountain?
examples.uz: Hayotingiz davomida hech bir baland tog'ga
examples.grammar: 'Have you ever + sifatdosh (climbed)' - Present Perfect so'roq gap, hayot davomidagi tajribani so'raydi - 'a high mountain' birlikda ot.

examples.en: There is snow on the mountain in winter.
examples.grammar: 'There is + ot' borligini bildiradi - 'on the mountain' joy predlogi.

defEn: a sudden strong shaking of the ground
defUz: yerning to'satdan kuchli silkinishi, zilzila
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: There was an earthquake and some houses fell down.
examples.uz: Zilzila bo'ldi va ba'zi uylar qulab tushdi.
examples.grammar: 'There was + an + ot' - Past Simple da o'tmishda narsa borligini bildiradi - 'an' artikli unli tovushdan oldin keladi - 'fell down' Past Simple ibora.

examples.en: The earthquake was very strong.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' bog'lovchi fe'l o'tmishdagi holatni bildiradi - 'very strong' sifatni kuchaytiradi.

defEn: when a lot of water covers the land
defUz: yerni ko'p suv bosishi, suv toshqini
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: After the rain, we were worried that there would be flooding.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('were worried') - 'that' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi - 'there would be' kelajak haqida o'tmishdan qaralganda taxminni bildiradi.

examples.en: There was a lot of flooding after the storm.
examples.uz: Bo'rondan keyin katta suv toshqini bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'There was + a lot of + ot' - o'tmishda ko'p narsa borligini bildiradi - 'after the storm' vaqtni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: a very strong and dangerous storm with fast wind
defUz: tez shamolli juda kuchli va xavfli bo'ron, dovul
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Hurricanes don't happen very often but they can be dangerous.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor ('don't happen') - 'but' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi - 'can be' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: A hurricane can break houses.
examples.grammar: 'can + infinitiv' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi - 'a hurricane' birlikda ot ega vazifasida.

defEn: things you do not want and throw away
defUz: kerak bo'lmagan va tashlab yuboriladigan narsalar, axlat
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Put your rubbish in the right place. Don't drop litter.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap ('Put') - fe'l boshda keladi - 'in the right place' joy predlogi - 'Don't drop' buyruq gapning inkori.

examples.en: Please put the rubbish in the bin.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'put' fe'l boshda keladi - 'in the bin' joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: the season after winter when it gets warm
defUz: qishdan keyingi, havo isiydigan fasl, bahor
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: I like the spring
examples.uz: it's when all the flowers start growing. – Menga bahor yoqadi–u barcha gullar
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'like' fe'li yoqtirishni bildiradi - 'the spring' fasl oldidan 'the' artikli.

examples.en: Many flowers grow in spring.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'grow' fe'li - 'in spring' fasl uchun ishlatiladigan predlog iborasi.

defEn: the warmest season of the year
defUz: yilning eng issiq fasli, yoz
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The summer is my favourite season because I love sunny days.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'because' bog'lovchisi sabab ergash gapni boshlaydi - 'my favourite season' egalik bilan ot iborasi.

examples.en: We go to the sea in summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go' fe'li - 'to the sea' yo'nalishni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi - 'in summer' fasl predlogi.

defEn: the season after summer when leaves fall
defUz: yozdan keyingi, barglar to'kiladigan fasl, kuz
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: In autumn, the weather starts to get cold.
examples.grammar: 'In autumn' fasl predlog iborasi gap boshida - Present Simple ('starts') - 'to get cold' infinitiv holat o'zgarishini bildiradi.

examples.en: The leaves are yellow in autumn.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'are' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'in autumn' fasl uchun predlog iborasi.

defEn: the coldest season of the year
defUz: yilning eng sovuq fasli, qish
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Winter is cold here. It snows a lot.
examples.uz: Bu yerda qish sovuq bo'ladi. Qor ko'p yog'adi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l holatni bildiradi - 'It snows' shaxssiz ega 'it' bilan ob-havoni ifodalaydi.

examples.en: We wear warm coats in winter.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'wear' fe'li odat ish-harakatini bildiradi - 'in winter' fasl predlogi.

defEn: the sun, rain, wind and temperature outside
defUz: tashqarida quyosh, yomg'ir, shamol va haroratning holati, ob-havo
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: What's the weather like where you live? Is it very hot?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap ('What is the weather like?') - ob-havo haqida so'rashning keng tarqalgan shakli - 'Is it hot?' so'roq gap ko'makchi fe'l bilan boshlanadi.

examples.en: The weather is nice today.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l holatni bildiradi - 'today' vaqtni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: to make air move, like wind
defUz: havoni harakatga keltirmoq, shamol esmoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The wind blew my hat off!
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'blew' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli - 'off' ravish harakatning yo'nalishini bildiradi.

examples.en: The wind blows hard in winter.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'blows' fe'liga uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi - 'hard' ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: to take air into your body and let it out
defUz: havoni tanaga olib, qaytarib chiqarmoq, nafas olmoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: I like to breathe the fresh air in the forest.
examples.uz: Menga o'rmonda toza havodan nafas olish yoqadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'like to breathe' yoqtirishni infinitiv bilan bildiradi - 'in the forest' joy predlogi.

examples.en: It is hard to breathe in the smoke.
examples.grammar: 'It is + sifat + to + infinitiv' tuzilmasi harakat haqida fikr bildiradi - 'in the smoke' joy predlogi.

defEn: to make a tree fall by cutting it
defUz: daraxtni kesib yiqitmoq, kesib tashlamoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: They mustn't cut down all the trees in the forest.
examples.grammar: 'mustn't + infinitiv' modal fe'l qat'iy taqiqni bildiradi - 'cut down' ikki so'zli fe'l (phrasal verb) - 'in the forest' joy predlogi.

examples.en: Please do not cut down this old tree.
examples.uz: Iltimos, bu keksa daraxtni kesib tashlamang.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gapning inkori ('do not cut down') - 'cut down' phrasal verb - 'this old tree' ko'rsatish olmoshi bilan ot iborasi.

defEn: to lift something up from the ground with your hands
defUz: biror narsani yerdan qo'l bilan ko'tarib olmoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: You must pick up your litter. Don't drop it in the street.
examples.grammar: 'must + infinitiv' modal fe'l zaruratni bildiradi - 'pick up' phrasal verb - 'Don't drop' buyruq gapning inkori.

examples.en: Pick up the paper and put it in the bin.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'pick up' phrasal verb fe'l boshda keladi - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki harakatni bog'laydi.

defEn: to put a seed or tree in the ground to grow
defUz: urug' yoki daraxtni o'sishi uchun yerga qo'ymoq, ekmoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Sometimes pupils from my school go to plant trees.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go to plant' harakat maqsadini infinitiv bilan bildiradi - 'Sometimes' vaqt ravishi gap boshida - 'trees' ko'plikda ot.

examples.en: We plant flowers in the garden in spring.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'plant' fe'li - 'in the garden' joy predlogi - 'in spring' fasl predlogi.

defEn: to make air, water or land dirty
defUz: havo, suv yoki yerni iflos qilmoq, ifloslantirmoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Cars and buses pollute the air that we breathe.
examples.uz: Mashina va avtobuslar biz nafas oladigan
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'pollute' fe'li ko'plik ega bilan - 'that we breathe' 'that' bog'lovchisi bilan ergash gap 'air' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: Cars pollute the air in the city.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'pollute' fe'li ko'plik ega ('cars') bilan - 'in the city' joy predlogi.

defEn: when water falls from the sky
defUz: osmondan suv tushishi, yomg'ir yog'ishi
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: When it rains, there is sometimes flooding.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ganda, ba'zan suv toshqini bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'When it rains' - 'when' bog'lovchisi bilan vaqt ergash gap - 'it' shaxssiz ega ob-havoni bildiradi - 'there is' borligini ifodalaydi.

examples.en: It often rains in spring.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'it' shaxssiz ega ob-havoni bildiradi - 'often' takror ravishi - 'in spring' fasl predlogi.

uz: ishlatilgan narsani qayta ishlamoq, masalan: metal mahsulotlarni eritib qaytadan metal mahsulot yasash mumkin
defEn: to use something again instead of throwing it away
defUz: biror narsani tashlamasdan qaytadan ishlatmoq, qayta ishlamoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: We can recycle glass and plastic bottles. Don't throw them away.
examples.grammar: 'can + infinitiv' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi - 'glass and plastic bottles' 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan - 'Don't throw away' buyruq gapning inkori.

examples.en: We recycle paper at school.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'recycle' fe'li odat ish-harakatini bildiradi - 'at school' joy predlogi.

defEn: to give bright light, like the sun
defUz: quyosh kabi yorqin nur sochmoq, charaqlamoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The sun was shining, so we went for a walk.
examples.grammar: Past Continuous ('was shining') - o'tmishda davom etgan harakatni bildiradi - 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani ifodalaydi.

examples.en: The sun shines all day in summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'shines' fe'liga uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shiladi - 'all day' vaqt iborasi.

defEn: when soft white pieces of ice fall from the sky
defUz: osmondan yumshoq oq muz parchalari tushishi, qor yog'ishi
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Does it often snow here in winter?
examples.uz: Bu yerda tez-tez qor yog'ib turadimi qishda?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap ('Does it snow?') - 'does' ko'makchi fe'l Present Simple so'roq gapni boshlaydi - 'it' shaxssiz ega - 'often' takror ravishi.

examples.en: It snows a lot in winter here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda qishda ko'p qor yog'adi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'it' shaxssiz ega ob-havoni bildiradi - 'a lot' miqdorni - 'in winter' fasl predlogi.

defEn: with many clouds in the sky
defUz: osmonda ko'p bulut bilan, bulutli
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: I feel unhappy on cloudy days. I love the sun!
examples.uz: Bulutli kunlarda men o'zimni tushkun his qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'feel' fe'li holatni bildiradi - 'on cloudy days' vaqtni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi - 'cloudy' sifat 'days' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: It is cloudy today, so we stay at home.
examples.uz: Bugun havo bulutli, shuning uchun biz uyda qolamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'cloudy' sifat ob-havoni bildiradi - 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani ifodalaydi.

defEn: having a low temperature, not warm
defUz: past haroratli, issiq emas, sovuq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: It's really cold today. Put on your jacket.
examples.uz: Bugun havo juda sovuq. Kurtkangizni kiyib oling.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l ob-havo holatini bildiradi - 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish - 'Put on' buyruq gap phrasal verb bilan.

examples.en: The water in the lake is very cold.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'cold' sifat holatni bildiradi - 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: with a lot of fog, hard to see
defUz: ko'p tumanli, ko'rish qiyin bo'lgan, tumanli
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: It was a foggy day and we couldn't see where we were driving.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' o'tmish holatini bildiradi - 'a foggy day' birlikda ot iborasi - 'couldn't see' modal fe'l 'can' ning o'tgan zamon inkori.

examples.en: It is foggy in the morning here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda ertalab havo tumanli bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'foggy' sifat ob-havoni bildiradi - 'in the morning' vaqt predlogi.

defEn: clean and new, not old or dirty
defUz: toza va yangi, eski yoki iflos emas, toza
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The air is usually really fresh after the rain.
examples.uz: Yomg'irdan keyin, havo odatda juda toza bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'really fresh' kuchaytiruvchi ravish bilan sifat - 'after the rain' vaqtni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

examples.en: I like fresh air in the morning.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'like' fe'li yoqtirishni bildiradi - 'fresh' sifat 'air' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: with a lot of sun, bright and clear
defUz: quyoshli, yorug' va ochiq, quyosh charaqlab turgan
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: When it's sunny, we play football or ride our bikes.
examples.grammar: 'When it's sunny' - 'when' bog'lovchisi bilan vaqt ergash gap - 'play or ride' 'or' bog'lovchisi bilan ikki fe'l.

examples.en: It is sunny today, so we go to the park.
examples.uz: Bugun havo quyoshli, shuning uchun biz bog'ga boramiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'sunny' sifat ob-havoni bildiradi - 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani ifodalaydi.

defEn: a little hot, not cold
defUz: biroz issiq, sovuq emas, iliq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: It's a warm day today. I think we can swim in the sea.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'a warm day' birlikda ot iborasi - 'I think' fikr bildiruvchi gap - 'can swim' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The water is warm in summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'warm' sifat holatni bildiradi - 'in summer' fasl predlogi.

examples.en: Tomorrow will be warm and sunny.
examples.uz: Ertangi kun issiq va quyoshli bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: Future ('will'); 'Tomorrow will be warm and sunny' - 'will be' kelasi zamon; 'and' bog'lovchisi 'warm' va 'sunny' sifatlarini bog'laydi; 'tomorrow' - vaqt ravishi.

examples.en: This coat is warm.
examples.grammar: 'This + ot + is + sifat' - to be fe'li; 'warm' - sifat; 'is' - uchinchi shaxs birlik.

defEn: with a lot of wind
defUz: ko'p shamolli, shamol esayotgan
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: It's very windy today. I'm happy I don't have to go out!
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'very windy' kuchaytiruvchi ravish bilan sifat - 'I don't have to' zarurat yo'qligini bildiradi.

examples.en: It is windy near the sea.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'windy' sifat ob-havoni bildiradi - 'near the sea' joy predlogi.

uz: yomg'irda ivib ketmoq, ho'l bo'lmoq, shalabbo bo'lmoq
defEn: to become covered with water
defUz: suvga bulg'anmoq, ho'l bo'lmoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Take your umbrella or you'll get wet.
examples.uz: Soyaboningizni olib oling, aks holda shalabbo bo'lasiz.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap ('Take') - 'or' bog'lovchisi natijani bildiradi - 'you'll get wet' Future ('will') kelajakdagi natijani ifodalaydi.

examples.en: We get wet when it rains.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'get wet' holatni bildiradi - 'when' bog'lovchisi bilan vaqt ergash gap.

defEn: during a season of the year
defUz: yilning biror faslida
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: It's beautiful here in the summer when all the trees are green.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'in the summer' fasl predlog iborasi - 'when' bog'lovchisi bilan vaqt ergash gap.

examples.en: We go skiing in the winter.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go skiing' harakatni bildiradi - 'in the winter' fasl uchun predlog iborasi.

defEn: in the area outside towns and cities, with fields and farms
defUz: shahar va qishloqlardan tashqaridagi, dalalar bor joyda, tabiat qo'ynida
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: My family lives in the city so when we can, we go for a ride in the country.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'lives' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s bilan - 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani bildiradi - 'in the country' joy predlog iborasi.

examples.en: My grandparents live in the countryside.
examples.uz: Bobom va buvim tabiat qo'ynida, qishloqda yashaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'live' fe'li ko'plik ega bilan - 'in the countryside' joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: in the air high above the ground
defUz: yerdan baland havoda, osmonda
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: It was a beautiful spring day. There wasn't a cloud in the sky.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' o'tmish holatini bildiradi - 'There wasn't a cloud' o'tmishda narsa yo'qligini bildiradi - 'in the sky' joy predlog iborasi.

examples.en: There are many stars in the sky tonight.
examples.uz: Bugun kechqurun osmonda ko'p yulduzlar bor.
examples.grammar: 'There are + ko'plik ot' borligini bildiradi - 'in the sky' joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: to make sure something stays clean
defUz: biror narsaning toza bo'lib turishini ta'minlamoq, toza tutmoq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Don't throw litter
examples.uz: we have to keep the countryside clean. – Axlat uloqtirmang–tabiat qo'ynini
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap inkori ('Don't throw') - 'have to' zaruratni bildiradi - 'keep the countryside clean' tuzilmada sifat ('clean') ot holatini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We must keep the river clean.
examples.grammar: 'must + infinitiv' modal fe'l zaruratni bildiradi - 'keep the river clean' tuzilmada 'clean' sifat holatni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: on the planet where we live
defUz: biz yashayotgan sayyorada, Yerda
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: How many people live on Earth?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap ('How many people live on Earth?') - 'How many' miqdor so'rashda ko'plik ot bilan - 'on Earth' joy predlog iborasi.

examples.en: There are many animals on Earth.
examples.grammar: 'There are + ko'plik ot' borligini bildiradi - 'on Earth' joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: on the surface of the land, not up high
defUz: yerning sirtida, balandda emas, yerda
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: There's lots of snow on the ground. Let's make a snowman.
examples.uz: Yerda rosa ko'p qor bor. Keling
examples.grammar: 'There's lots of snow' borligini bildiradi - 'on the ground' joy predlog iborasi - 'Let's make' taklif bildiruvchi tuzilma.

examples.en: The leaves are on the ground in autumn.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'are' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'on the ground' joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: a white or grey shape in the sky made of water
defUz: osmondagi suvdan iborat oq yoki kulrang shakl, bulut
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: We were flying above the clouds.
examples.grammar: Past Continuous ('were flying') - o'tmishda davom etgan harakatni bildiradi - 'above the clouds' joy predlogi ko'plik ot bilan.

examples.en: There is a big cloud in the sky.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + ot' birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi - 'in the sky' joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog iborasi.

defEn: thick cloud near the ground that makes it hard to see
defUz: yer yuzasiga yaqin, ko'rishni qiyinlashtiradigan quyuq bulut, tuman
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: We drove slowly through the fog.
examples.uz: Biz tuman oralab sekinlik bilan haydadik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'drove' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli - 'slowly' ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi - 'through the fog' joy predlogi.

examples.en: There is a lot of fog this morning.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a lot of + ot' borligini bildiradi - 'this morning' vaqtni ko'rsatuvchi ibora.

defEn: the quality of being hot
defUz: issiq bo'lish holati, issiqlik
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The heat in the factory was unbearable.
examples.uz: Fabrikadagi issiqlik chidab bo'lmas darajada edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' o'tmish holatini bildiradi - 'in the factory' joy predlogi - 'unbearable' sifat holatni tasvirlaydi.

examples.en: I do not like the heat in summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkori ('do not like') - 'the heat' aniq otni bildiradi - 'in summer' fasl predlogi.

defEn: having a high temperature, very warm
defUz: yuqori haroratli, juda issiq
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: It's very hot here in the summer.
examples.uz: Yoz faslida bu yer juda issiq bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l ob-havoni bildiradi - 'very hot' kuchaytiruvchi ravish bilan sifat - 'in the summer' fasl predlog iborasi.

examples.en: The tea is very hot.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'hot' sifat holatni bildiradi - 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: dirty air, water or land that is bad for nature
defUz: tabiatga zararli bo'lgan iflos havo, suv yoki yer, ifloslanish
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The factory is responsible for air pollution.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is responsible for' javobgarlikni bildiruvchi ibora 'for' predlogi bilan - 'air pollution' ot oti aniqlaydi.

examples.en: Pollution is bad for our health.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'bad for' sifatdan keyin 'for' predlogi keladi.

defEn: made dirty and bad for nature
defUz: iflos qilingan va tabiatga zararli, ifloslangan
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The air in big cities is often polluted.
examples.uz: Katta shaharlardagi havo odatda ifloslangan bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'polluted' sifat holatni bildiradi - 'often' takror ravishi - 'in big cities' joy predlogi.

examples.en: The river is very polluted now.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'polluted' sifat holatni bildiradi - 'now' vaqt ravishi.

defEn: with a lot of rain
defUz: ko'p yomg'irli, yomg'ir yog'ayotgan
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: I hate rainy days because I have to stay at home.
examples.uz: Menga yomg'irli kunlar yoqmaydi chunki men
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'hate' fe'li yoqtirmaslikni bildiradi - 'because' bog'lovchisi sabab ergash gapni boshlaydi - 'have to stay' zaruratni bildiradi.

examples.en: I read books on rainy days.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'read' fe'li odat ish-harakatini bildiradi - 'rainy' sifat 'days' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: using old things again to make new things
defUz: eski narsalardan yangi narsa yasash uchun qayta foydalanish, qayta ishlash
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Recycling is a good way to stop polluting the Earth.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'a good way to + infinitiv' maqsadni bildiradi - 'polluting' sifatdosh harakatni ot kabi ifodalaydi.

examples.en: Recycling helps the Earth.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'helps' fe'liga uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shiladi - 'recycling' sifatdosh ega vazifasida.

defEn: able to be used again to make new things
defUz: yangi narsa yasash uchun qaytadan ishlatsa bo'ladigan, qayta ishlasa bo'ladigan
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: Paper, glass and plastic are all recyclable
examples.uz: don't just throw them away. – Qog'oz, shisha va
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'are' bog'lovchi fe'l ko'plik ega bilan - 'Paper, glass and plastic' ko'p ega 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan - 'recyclable' sifat holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: Glass bottles are recyclable.
examples.uz: Shisha idishlar qayta ishlasa bo'ladigan turdadir.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'are' bog'lovchi fe'l ko'plik ega bilan - 'recyclable' sifat holatni bildiradi.

defEn: bad weather with strong wind and rain
defUz: kuchli shamol va yomg'irli yomon ob-havo, bo'ron
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: A few minutes later the storm broke.
examples.uz: Bir necha daqiqa o'tgach bo'ron boshlandi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'broke' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli - 'A few minutes later' vaqt iborasi gap boshida.

examples.en: There was a big storm last night.
examples.grammar: 'There was + a + ot' o'tmishda narsa borligini bildiradi - 'last night' o'tgan vaqtni ko'rsatuvchi ibora.

defEn: with strong wind and rain
defUz: kuchli shamol va yomg'irli, bo'ronli
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The weather has been stormy for a few days. There has been a lot of rain.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect ('has been') - o'tmishdan hozirgacha davom etgan holatni bildiradi - 'for a few days' davomiylikni 'for' predlogi bilan ifodalaydi.

examples.en: The weather is stormy today.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'stormy' sifat ob-havoni bildiradi - 'today' vaqt ravishi.

defEn: the bright star in the sky that gives us light and heat
defUz: osmonda bizga yorug'lik va issiqlik beradigan yorqin yulduz, quyosh
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The sun was shining and birds were singing.
examples.grammar: Past Continuous ('was shining', 'were singing') - o'tmishda davom etgan harakatlarni bildiradi - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

examples.en: The sun is very bright today.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'bright' sifat holatni bildiradi - 'today' vaqt ravishi.

defEn: air that moves outside
defUz: tashqarida harakatlanadigan havo, shamol
topic: Weather and Seasons, Nature and Ecology

examples.en: The wind is blowing from the south.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous ('is blowing') - hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi - 'from the south' yo'nalishni 'from' predlogi bilan bildiradi.

examples.en: The wind is very strong today.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l - 'strong' sifat holatni bildiradi - 'today' vaqt ravishi.

defEn: Strong shoes that cover your feet and the lower part of your legs.
defUz: Oyoq va boldirning pastki qismini qoplaydigan baquvvat oyoq kiyim.

examples.en: It's snowing, so wear your boots to keep your feet warm.
examples.grammar: 'It's snowing' - Present Continuous (hozir davom etayotgan ish); 'so' - bog'lovchi (sabab-natija); 'wear your boots' - buyruq gap; 'to keep' - infinitiv (maqsadni bildiradi).

examples.en: My new boots are black.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot (ko'plik) + are + sifat' - egalik olmoshi va birikma; 'boots' - ko'plikda; 'are' - to be fe'lining ko'plik shakli.

defEn: A soft hat with a part at the front that covers your eyes from the sun.
defUz: Old qismi quyoshdan to'sib turadigan yumshoq bosh kiyim, kepka.

examples.en: I wear a cap on my head in the winter.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (odatiy ish); 'I wear a cap' - 'a' artikli birlikdagi sanaladigan otdan oldin; 'on my head' - predlog 'on' bilan o'rin; 'in the winter' - 'in' predlogi fasl bilan.

examples.en: He has a blue cap.
examples.grammar: 'have/has + a + ot' - egalik bildiruvchi tuzilma; 'has' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'a' - artikl birlikdagi otdan oldin.

uz: kofta, kardigan: to'qilgan odatda yoqasiz kiyim turi
defEn: A warm piece of clothing for the top of your body that you fasten at the front.
defUz: Tananing tepa qismiga kiyiladigan, oldidan tugmalanadigan iliq to'qima kiyim, kofta.

examples.en: It's a little cold. I'm going to put my cardigan on.
examples.uz: Havo biroz sovuq. Men koftamni kiyib
examples.grammar: 'It's cold' - to be fe'li bilan holat; 'I'm going to put my cardigan on' - 'going to' kelasi zamon rejani bildiradi; 'put ... on' - ajraladigan phrasal fe'l (kiymoq).

examples.en: I like your green cardigan.
examples.grammar: 'I like + ot' - Present Simple; 'your' - egalik olmoshi; 'green' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: A warm piece of clothing with long sleeves that you wear over your other clothes outside.
defUz: Boshqa kiyimlar ustidan, tashqarida kiyiladigan uzun yengli iliq kiyim, palto.

examples.en: You'll need your coat
examples.uz: it's going to snow. – Sizga kurtkangiz kerak bo'ladi–qor yog'adi.
examples.grammar: 'You'll need' - 'will' yordamida kelasi zamon (qisqargan shakl 'you'll'); 'your coat' - egalik olmoshi bilan ot; 'need' - asosiy fe'l (kerak bo'lmoq).

examples.en: It is cold, so wear your coat.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq, shuning uchun paltongizni kiying.
examples.grammar: 'It is cold' - to be fe'li bilan ob-havo; 'so' - sabab-natija bog'lovchisi; 'wear your coat' - buyruq gap.

defEn: A piece of clothing for a woman or girl that covers the body and part of the legs.
defUz: Ayol yoki qiz kiyadigan, tana va oyoqning bir qismini qoplaydigan kiyim, ko'ylak.

examples.en: Lauren is wearing an attractive red dress.
examples.grammar: 'Lauren is wearing' - Present Continuous (hozir kiyib turibdi); 'an attractive red dress' - 'an' artikli unli tovushdan oldin, sifatlar (attractive, red) otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: She has a new red dress.
examples.grammar: 'She has + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'has' - uchinchi shaxs birlik; sifatlar otdan oldin.

defEn: Things that you wear on your hands to keep them warm.
defUz: Qo'llarni issiq saqlash uchun kiyiladigan narsa, qo'lqop.

examples.en: Wear gloves or your hands will get cold.
examples.uz: Qo'lqop kiyib oling, aks holda qo'llaringiz sovuq qotib
examples.grammar: 'Wear gloves' - buyruq gap; 'or' - bog'lovchi; 'your hands will get cold' - 'will' bilan kelasi zamon; 'get cold' - holat o'zgarishini bildiradi.

examples.en: I wear gloves in winter.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (odatiy ish); 'gloves' - ko'plikda; 'in winter' - 'in' predlogi fasl bilan.

defEn: A thing that you wear on your head.
defUz: Boshga kiyiladigan narsa, shapka, qalpoq.

examples.en: When it's cold, I wear a hat.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq bo'lganda, men qalpoq kiyaman.
examples.grammar: 'When it's cold' - 'when' bilan boshlangan ergash gap; 'it's cold' - to be fe'li bilan ob-havo; 'I wear a hat' - Present Simple, 'a' artikli birlikdagi otdan oldin.

examples.en: My hat is warm.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot + is + sifat' - egalik olmoshi va to be fe'li; 'is' - uchinchi shaxs birlik.

defEn: A short coat with sleeves that you wear over your other clothes.
defUz: Boshqa kiyimlar ustidan kiyiladigan yengli kalta kiyim, kurtka.

examples.en: Poppy always wears the same denim jacket.
examples.uz: Po'pi har doim bir xil ko'jenniy kurtka kiyadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (odatiy ish); 'always' - takror-takror ish bajarilishini bildiruvchi ravish, fe'ldan oldin keladi; 'the same denim jacket' - 'the' aniq artikl, sifatlar otdan oldin.

examples.en: I wear a jacket when it is cold.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq bo'lganda men kurtka kiyaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'when it is cold' - 'when' bilan ergash gap; 'a' artikl birlikdagi otdan oldin.

defEn: Trousers made of strong cotton cloth, usually blue.
defUz: Pishiq paxta matodan tikilgan, odatda ko'k rangli shim, jinsi shim.

examples.en: I need a new pair of blue jeans. These are very old.
examples.uz: Menga yangi ko'k jinsi shim kerak. Mana
examples.grammar: 'I need a new pair of blue jeans' - Present Simple; 'a pair of' - juft narsa uchun ishlatiladi; 'These are very old' - 'these' ko'rsatish olmoshi va ko'plik 'are'.

examples.en: I like my blue jeans.
examples.uz: Mening ko'k jinsi shimim menga yoqadi.
examples.grammar: 'I like + egalik olmoshi + ot' - Present Simple; 'jeans' - har doim ko'plikda ishlatiladi.

defEn: A piece of cloth that you wear around your neck to keep warm.
defUz: Issiq saqlash uchun bo'yinga o'raladigan mato, sharf.

examples.en: Wear a scarf around your neck because it's very cold.
examples.grammar: 'Wear a scarf' - buyruq gap; 'around your neck' - predlog 'around' bilan o'rin; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'it's very cold' - to be fe'li bilan ob-havo.

examples.en: She wears a warm scarf.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'wears' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' qo'shimchasi; 'a' artikli sifatli otdan oldin.

defEn: A piece of clothing for the top of your body, with a collar, sleeves and buttons.
defUz: Yoqasi, yengi va tugmalari bor, tananing tepa qismiga kiyiladigan kiyim, erkaklar ko'ylagi.

examples.en: What do you think of my new shirt? Does it match my jacket?
examples.grammar: 'What do you think of ...?' - 'do' yordamchi fe'li bilan so'roq gap (Present Simple); 'Does it match ...?' - 'does' bilan so'roq gap, uchinchi shaxs birlik.

examples.en: He has a white shirt.
examples.grammar: 'He has + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'has' - uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'a' artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: Things that you wear on your feet, usually made of leather or cloth.
defUz: Oyoqqa kiyiladigan, odatda charm yoki matodan tayyorlangan narsa, oyoq kiyim.

examples.en: Ed doesn't wear leather shoes to school. He always wears trainers.
examples.grammar: 'Ed doesn't wear ...' - Present Simple inkor, 'doesn't' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'He always wears trainers' - 'always' ravishi fe'ldan oldin, 'wears' birlikda '-s' bilan.

examples.en: My new shoes are black.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot (ko'plik) + are + sifat' - egalik va to be fe'li; 'shoes' - ko'plikda; 'are' - ko'plik shakli.

defEn: A piece of clothing for a woman or girl that hangs from the waist.
defUz: Belidan pastga osilib turadigan, ayol yoki qiz kiyadigan kiyim, yubka.

examples.en: Madison never wears trousers. She always wears dresses or skirts.
examples.grammar: 'Madison never wears trousers' - Present Simple, 'never' inkor ma'noli ravish fe'ldan oldin; 'She always wears ...' - 'always' ravishi takrorni bildiradi; 'or' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: She is wearing a long skirt.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous (hozir kiyib turibdi); 'a' artikl sifatli otdan oldin; 'long' - sifat otdan oldin.

defEn: Soft things that you wear on your feet inside your shoes.
defUz: Oyoq kiyim ichidan oyoqqa kiyiladigan yumshoq narsa, paypoq.

examples.en: Hugh's feet are always cold, so he wears his socks to bed.
examples.grammar: 'Hugh's feet' - egalik ('-'s) bilan yasalgan; 'are always cold' - to be fe'li, 'always' ravishi; 'so' - sabab-natija bog'lovchisi; 'he wears his socks to bed' - Present Simple.

examples.en: I wear warm socks in winter.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'socks' - ko'plikda; 'in winter' - 'in' predlogi fasl bilan.

defEn: A jacket and trousers, or a jacket and skirt, made of the same cloth.
defUz: Bir xil matodan tikilgan pidjak va shim (yoki pidjak va yubka), kostyum.

examples.en: This jacket matches my trousers, so it looks like one suit.
examples.grammar: 'This jacket matches my trousers' - Present Simple, 'matches' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-es' bilan; 'so' - sabab-natija bog'lovchisi; 'it looks like' - 'look like' o'xshashlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: He wears a black suit to work.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'wears' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'to work' - 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: A warm piece of clothing for the top of your body, made of soft cotton.
defUz: Tananing tepa qismiga kiyiladigan, yumshoq paxtadan tikilgan iliq kiyim, sviter.

examples.en: I wear T-shirts but when it's cold, I put a sweatshirt on top.
examples.grammar: 'I wear T-shirts' - Present Simple; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi; 'when it's cold' - 'when' bilan ergash gap; 'I put a sweatshirt on top' - 'on top' o'rin holini bildiradi.

examples.en: I put on a warm sweatshirt.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'put on' - phrasal fe'l (kiymoq); 'a' artikl sifatli otdan oldin.

defEn: A piece of clothing that you wear on the top part of your body.
defUz: Tananing tepa qismiga kiyiladigan kiyim, kofta.

examples.en: Gracie wore a green skirt with a matching top.
examples.uz: Greysi koftasiga mos tushadigan yashil yubka
examples.grammar: 'Gracie wore a green skirt' - Past Simple, 'wore' - 'wear' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli; 'with a matching top' - 'with' predlogi; 'a' artikllar otlardan oldin.

examples.en: I like this blue top.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'this' - ko'rsatish olmoshi birlikda; 'blue' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: A piece of clothing that covers your legs and has two parts for your legs.
defUz: Oyoqlarni qoplaydigan, ikki pochali kiyim, shim.

examples.en: Hannah wears jeans or trousers every day. She doesn't like skirts.
examples.uz: Hana har kuni jinsi shim yoki
examples.grammar: 'Hannah wears jeans or trousers every day' - Present Simple, 'wears' birlikda; 'or' - bog'lovchi; 'She doesn't like skirts' - Present Simple inkor 'doesn't' bilan.

examples.en: He wears black trousers to work.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'wears' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'trousers' - ko'plikda ishlatiladi.

defEn: A soft cotton shirt with short sleeves and no collar or buttons.
defUz: Kalta yengli, yoqasi va tugmasi yo'q, yumshoq paxtadan tikilgan kiyim, futbolka.

examples.en: When we do PE at school, we wear white shorts and a T-shirt.
examples.grammar: 'When we do PE at school' - 'when' bilan ergash gap, Present Simple; 'we wear white shorts and a T-shirt' - 'and' bog'lovchisi, 'a' artikl birlikdagi otdan oldin.

examples.en: I wear a white T-shirt in summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'a' artikl sifatli otdan oldin; 'in summer' - 'in' predlogi fasl bilan.

defEn: A long thin piece of leather or cloth that you wear around your waist.
defUz: Belga taqiladigan uzun, ingichka charm yoki mato bo'lagi, kamar.

examples.en: I like to wear a belt with my trousers.
examples.uz: Men shimim bilan kamar taqishni yoqtiraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (odatiy ish); 'I like to wear' - 'like + to + infinitiv' tuzilmasi; 'a belt' - 'a' artikl birlikdagi otdan oldin; 'with my trousers' - 'with' predlogi.

examples.en: He wears a brown belt.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'wears' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'a' artikl sifatli otdan oldin.

defEn: The clothes and styles that are popular at a certain time.
defUz: Ma'lum bir vaqtda ommabop bo'lgan kiyim va uslublar, moda, urf.

examples.en: Bright trainers are in fashion this summer.
examples.uz: Yorqin rangdagi krasovkalar bu yozda urfda.
examples.grammar: 'Bright trainers are in fashion this summer' - Present Simple; 'are in fashion' - 'in fashion' ibora (urfda); 'this summer' - 'this' ko'rsatish olmoshi vaqt bilan.

examples.en: Long skirts are in fashion now.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'are' - ko'plik shakli; 'in fashion' - urfda ekanini bildiruvchi ibora; 'now' - ravish.

defEn: A bag that a woman uses to carry her money and small things.
defUz: Ayol pul va mayda narsalarini olib yurish uchun ishlatadigan sumka, ayollar sumkasi.

examples.en: My mum puts her phone and her money in her handbag.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (odatiy ish); 'My mum puts ...' - 'puts' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' bilan; 'her phone and her money' - 'and' bog'lovchisi; 'in her handbag' - 'in' predlogi.

examples.en: My mum has a black handbag.
examples.grammar: 'has + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'has' - uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'a' artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: The part of a coat or jacket that covers your head.
defUz: Palto yoki kurtkaning boshni qoplaydigan qismi, kapyushon.

examples.en: This jacket has a hood. It will keep your head warm.
examples.grammar: 'This jacket has a hood' - Present Simple, 'has' uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'This' - ko'rsatish olmoshi; 'It will keep your head warm' - 'will' bilan kelasi zamon.

examples.en: My coat has a big hood.
examples.grammar: 'has + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'has' - uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'big' - sifat otdan oldin.

defEn: A small bag that is part of your clothes, where you keep small things.
defUz: Kiyimning bir qismi bo'lgan, mayda narsalar solinadigan kichik joy, cho'ntak.

examples.en: I always keep my phone in my shirt pocket.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (odatiy ish); 'always' - takrorni bildiruvchi ravish fe'ldan oldin; 'I keep my phone' - egalik olmoshi bilan ot; 'in my shirt pocket' - 'in' predlogi o'rin bilan.

examples.en: I have a key in my pocket.
examples.grammar: 'have + a + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'in my pocket' - 'in' predlogi o'rin bilan; 'a' artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: The part of a piece of clothing that covers your arm.
defUz: Kiyimning qo'lni qoplaydigan qismi, yeng.

examples.en: In the winter, I wear clothes with long sleeves to keep my arms warm.
examples.grammar: 'In the winter' - 'in' predlogi fasl bilan; 'I wear clothes with long sleeves' - Present Simple, 'with' predlogi; 'to keep my arms warm' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: This shirt has long sleeves.
examples.grammar: 'has + sifat + ot (ko'plik)' - egalik bildiradi; 'has' - uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'sleeves' - ko'plikda.

defEn: Dark glasses that you wear to protect your eyes from the sun.
defUz: Ko'zni quyoshdan himoya qilish uchun taqiladigan qora ko'zoynak.

examples.en: Lucy wears sunglasses on sunny days.
examples.grammar: Present Simple (odatiy ish); 'Lucy wears sunglasses' - 'wears' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' bilan; 'on sunny days' - 'on' predlogi kunlar bilan, 'days' ko'plikda.

examples.en: I wear sunglasses in summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'sunglasses' - ko'plikda ishlatiladi; 'in summer' - 'in' predlogi fasl bilan.

defEn: A small clock that you wear on your wrist.
defUz: Bilakka taqiladigan kichik soat, qo'l soati.

examples.en: He looked at his watch and saw he was late.
examples.uz: U qo'l soatiga qaradi va kech qolganini ko'rdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'looked' va 'saw' - o'tgan zamon shakllari ('saw' noto'g'ri fe'l); 'at his watch' - 'at' predlogi; 'he was late' - to be fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'was'.

examples.en: I have a new watch.
examples.grammar: 'have + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'a' artikl sifatli otdan oldin; 'new' - sifat.

uz: maxsus kiyimlarni kiymoq, chiroyli kiyimlarni kiymoq
defEn: To put on special or nice clothes.
defUz: Maxsus yoki chiroyli kiyimlar kiymoq.

examples.en: The children sometimes dress up in funny clothes and have a party.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'sometimes' - takror darajasini bildiruvchi ravish; 'dress up in funny clothes' - 'dress up' phrasal fe'l (chiroyli/maxsus kiyinmoq); 'and have a party' - 'and' bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: We dress up for the party.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'dress up' - phrasal fe'l; 'for the party' - 'for' predlogi maqsad bilan.

defEn: To close or join two parts of something together.
defUz: Biror narsaning ikki qismini biriktirmoq yoki mahkamlamoq.

examples.en: This jacket is really small
examples.uz: I can't fasten it. – Bu kurtka juda kichik–zamogini taqolmayapman.
examples.grammar: 'This jacket is really small' - to be fe'li bilan holat, 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'I can't fasten it' - 'can't' modal fe'lining inkori (qila olmaslik); 'fasten' - asosiy fe'l.

examples.en: Please fasten your coat.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap; 'please' - xushmuomalalik so'zi; 'your coat' - egalik olmoshi bilan ot.

uz: shunchalik katta bo'lib ketishki ma'lum bir kiyim sizga sig'may qoladi, ma'lum bir kiyim kiyish uchun kichkina bo'lib qolmoq
defEn: To get too big for a piece of clothing because you have grown.
defUz: O'sib ketganligi sababli kiyim kichik bo'lib qolmoq.

examples.en: I grew out of my favourite jacket and I need to buy a new one.
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'grew' - 'grow' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli; 'grow out of' - phrasal fe'l (o'sib sig'masligi); 'I need to buy a new one' - 'need + to + infinitiv'.

examples.en: I grow out of my clothes fast.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'grow out of' - phrasal fe'l; 'fast' - ravish fe'ldan keyin keladi.

uz: biror bir kiyim boshqa bir kiyimga mos tushmoq
defEn: To look good together because of the same colour or style.
defUz: Bir xil rang yoki uslub tufayli biror narsaga mos tushmoq.

examples.en: Luca bought a blue shirt to match his blue trousers.
examples.uz: Luka ko'k shimiga mos tushishi uchun bir
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'bought' - 'buy' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli; 'to match his blue trousers' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'match' - asosiy fe'l (mos kelmoq).

examples.en: This hat matches my coat.
examples.uz: Bu shapka mening paltomga mos tushadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'matches' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-es' qo'shimchasi; 'This' - ko'rsatish olmoshi.

uz: kiyib olmoq, biror kiyimni ustiga tashlab olmoq
defEn: To start wearing a piece of clothing.
defUz: Biror kiyimni kiyishni boshlamoq, kiyib olmoq.

examples.en: When it's cold, I put on a sweatshirt.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq bo'lganda, men sviter kiyib olaman.
examples.grammar: 'When it's cold' - 'when' bilan ergash gap; 'it's cold' - to be fe'li bilan ob-havo; 'I put on a sweatshirt' - Present Simple, 'put on' phrasal fe'l (kiymoq).

examples.en: I put on my coat and go out.
examples.uz: Men paltomni kiyib olaman va tashqariga chiqaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'put on' - phrasal fe'l; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki ishni bog'laydi.

defEn: To remove a piece of clothing from your body.
defUz: Biror kiyimni tanadan yechmoq.

examples.en: When I take off my clothes, I put them on the armchair.
examples.grammar: 'When I take off my clothes' - 'when' bilan ergash gap, Present Simple; 'take off' phrasal fe'l (yechmoq); 'I put them on the armchair' - 'put' asosiy fe'l, 'on' predlog o'rin bilan.

examples.en: I take off my shoes at home.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'take off' - phrasal fe'l; 'at home' - 'at' predlogi o'rin bilan.

defEn: To join the ends of something like a lace together.
defUz: Biror narsaning, masalan ipning uchlarini bog'lamoq.

examples.en: My little brother is three, so he can't tie his shoes.
examples.uz: Mening ukam uch yoshda, shuning uchun u
examples.grammar: 'My little brother is three' - to be fe'li bilan yosh; 'so' - sabab-natija bog'lovchisi; 'he can't tie his shoes' - 'can't' modal fe'lining inkori, 'tie' asosiy fe'l (bog'lamoq).

examples.en: I can tie my shoes.
examples.grammar: 'can + infinitiv' - qobiliyatni bildiruvchi modal fe'l; 'tie' - asosiy fe'l; 'my' - egalik olmoshi.

uz: kiyib ko'rmoq (kiyim yarashganmi yoki yo'q, mos tushganmi yoki yo'qligini ko'rish uchun)
defEn: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or looks good.
defUz: Mosligi yoki yarashishini ko'rish uchun kiyimni kiyib ko'rmoq.

examples.en: I tried the shirt on in the shop, so I know it fits.
examples.uz: Men do'konda ko'ylakni kiyib ko'rdim, shunday
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'tried' - 'try' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli; 'try on' phrasal fe'l (kiyib ko'rmoq); 'so I know it fits' - 'so' bog'lovchisi, 'know' va 'fits' Present Simple.

examples.en: I want to try on this shirt.
examples.grammar: 'want + to + infinitiv' tuzilmasi; 'try on' - phrasal fe'l; 'this' - ko'rsatish olmoshi birlikda.

defEn: Popular and in style at the present time.
defUz: Hozirgi paytda ommabop va urfda bo'lgan, urfdagi.

examples.en: Fyona bought a fashionable new top to wear to the party.
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'bought' - 'buy' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli; 'a fashionable new top' - 'a' artikl, sifatlar (fashionable, new) otdan oldin; 'to wear' - infinitiv maqsad bilan.

examples.en: She has a fashionable coat.
examples.grammar: 'has + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'fashionable' - sifat otdan oldin; 'a' artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: Not tight and not close to the body.
defUz: Tor emas va tanaga yopishib turmaydigan, keng.

examples.en: I prefer clothes that are loose. They feel more comfortable.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'I prefer clothes that are loose' - 'that' bilan ergash gap (sifatlovchi); 'They feel more comfortable' - 'feel' fe'li, 'more comfortable' qiyosiy daraja.

examples.en: I like loose shirts.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'loose' - sifat otdan oldin keladi; 'shirts' - ko'plikda.

defEn: Made from the soft white material that grows on the cotton plant.
defUz: Paxta o'simligida o'sadigan yumshoq oq materialdan tayyorlangan, paxtadan tikilgan.

examples.en: I like cotton shirts
examples.uz: they're comfortable to wear. – Menga paxtadan tikilgan ko'ylaklar yoqadi–
examples.grammar: 'I like cotton shirts' - Present Simple; 'cotton' bu yerda sifat sifatida ot oldida keladi (paxtadan tikilgan); 'shirts' - ko'plik ot.

examples.en: I wear a cotton T-shirt in summer.
examples.uz: Men yozda paxtadan tikilgan futbolka kiyaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'cotton' - ot oldida sifat vazifasida; 'a' artikl otdan oldin; 'in summer' - 'in' predlogi.

defEn: Made from strong cotton cloth, usually blue, that is used for jeans.
defUz: Jinsi shim uchun ishlatiladigan, odatda ko'k rangli pishiq paxta matodan tayyorlangan, jinsi materialli.

examples.en: I like your new denim skirt!
examples.uz: Sizni yangi jinsi materialli yubkangiz menga yoqdi!
examples.grammar: 'I like your new denim skirt!' - Present Simple, undov gap; 'your' egalik olmoshi; 'new' va 'denim' otdan oldin keluvchi aniqlovchilar; 'denim' - materialni bildiradi.

examples.en: He wears a denim jacket.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'wears' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'denim' - ot oldida sifat vazifasida.

defEn: Made from the skin of an animal.
defUz: Hayvon terisidan tayyorlangan, charm.

examples.en: Li wears a leather jacket and trousers when she rides her motorbike.
examples.grammar: 'Li wears a leather jacket and trousers' - Present Simple, 'leather' sifat vazifasida; 'when she rides her motorbike' - 'when' bilan ergash gap, 'rides' uchinchi shaxs birlikda.

examples.en: She has leather shoes.
examples.grammar: 'has + sifat + ot (ko'plik)' - egalik bildiradi; 'leather' - ot oldida sifat vazifasida; 'shoes' - ko'plikda.

defEn: Made from a soft, smooth and shiny cloth.
defUz: Yumshoq, silliq va yaltiroq matodan tayyorlangan, shoyidan tikilgan.

examples.en: Ella bought a silk dress to wear to her sister's party.
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'bought' - 'buy' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli; 'a silk dress' - 'silk' sifat vazifasida; 'her sister's party' - egalik ('-'s) bilan; 'to wear' - infinitiv maqsad bilan.

examples.en: She wears a silk dress.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'wears' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'silk' - ot oldida sifat vazifasida.

defEn: Made from wool, the soft hair of a sheep.
defUz: Jundan, ya'ni qo'yning yumshoq tukidan to'qilgan.

examples.en: I like my woollen sweater
examples.uz: it's very warm. – Jundan to'qilgan sviterim menga yoqadi–u issiqqina.
examples.grammar: 'I like my woollen sweater' - Present Simple; 'my' egalik olmoshi; 'woollen' sifat otdan oldin; 'it's very warm' - to be fe'li, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: I wear a woollen hat in winter.
examples.uz: Men qishda jundan to'qilgan qalpoq kiyaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'woollen' - sifat otdan oldin keladi; 'in winter' - 'in' predlogi fasl bilan.

defEn: Not modern; from a style that was popular in the past.
defUz: Zamonaviy emas; o'tmishda ommabop bo'lgan uslubdagi, eskicha.

examples.en: My clothes are a little old-fashioned but I don't care.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'My clothes are a little old-fashioned' - to be fe'li, 'a little' biroz ma'nosida; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi; 'I don't care' - Present Simple inkor 'don't' bilan.

examples.en: This is an old-fashioned hat.
examples.grammar: 'This is + an + sifat + ot' - to be fe'li; 'an' artikl unli tovushdan oldin; 'old-fashioned' - sifat.

defEn: Having a pattern of squares of different colours.
defUz: Turli rangdagi kataklar naqshiga ega bo'lgan, katak-katakli.

examples.en: Max was wearing a black and white checked shirt.
examples.uz: Maks oq-qora katakli ko'ylak kiyib olgandi.
examples.grammar: Past Continuous; 'Max was wearing' - 'was + -ing' o'tgan zamonda davom etgan ish; 'a black and white checked shirt' - 'a' artikl, sifatlar (black, white, checked) otdan oldin.

examples.en: He wears a checked shirt.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'wears' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'checked' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: Having one colour and no pattern.
defUz: Bir rangli va naqshi yo'q, oddiy.

examples.en: I wanted a plain shirt, not a striped or checked one.
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'I wanted a plain shirt' - 'wanted' o'tgan zamon shakli; 'not a striped or checked one' - 'not' inkor, 'one' takroriy otni almashtiradi; 'or' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: I like a plain white shirt.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'a' artikl sifatli otdan oldin; 'plain' va 'white' - sifatlar otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: Having a pattern of small round marks.
defUz: Kichik dumaloq belgilar naqshiga ega bo'lgan, nuqta-nuqtali.

examples.en: I love that spotted dress! Shall I buy it for you?
examples.uz: Bu nuqta-nuqtali ko'ylak menga yoqdi! Sizga
examples.grammar: 'I love that spotted dress!' - Present Simple, undov gap; 'that' ko'rsatish olmoshi; 'Shall I buy it for you?' - 'shall' bilan taklif so'roq gapi; 'for you' - 'for' predlogi.

examples.en: She has a spotted dress.
examples.grammar: 'has + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'spotted' - sifat otdan oldin; 'a' artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: Having a pattern of lines of different colours.
defUz: Turli rangdagi chiziqlar naqshiga ega bo'lgan, yo'l-yo'lli.

examples.en: Some people say that striped shirts make you look slim.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'Some people say that ...' - 'that' bilan ergash gap; 'striped shirts make you look slim' - 'make + someone + infinitiv' tuzilmasi; 'striped' sifat otdan oldin.

examples.en: I like this striped T-shirt.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'this' - ko'rsatish olmoshi birlikda; 'striped' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: Fitting very close to your body.
defUz: Tanaga juda yopishib turadigan, tor.

examples.en: These trousers are really tight. I can't put them on!
examples.uz: Bu shim juda tor. Men uni kiya
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'These trousers are really tight' - to be fe'li, 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'I can't put them on!' - 'can't' modal fe'l inkori, 'put on' phrasal fe'l.

examples.en: These shoes are too tight.
examples.grammar: 'These + ot + are + sifat' - to be fe'li ko'plikda; 'too' - ortiqcha darajani bildiradi; 'tight' - sifat.

defEn: To be popular or not popular at a certain time.
defUz: Ma'lum bir vaqtda ommabop bo'lmoq yoki ommabop bo'lmaslik.

examples.en: These jeans are in fashion this year.
examples.uz: Bu jinsi shim bu yili urfda.
examples.grammar: 'These jeans are in fashion this year' - Present Simple; 'are in fashion' - 'in fashion' ibora (urfda); 'these' ko'rsatish olmoshi ko'plikda; 'this year' - vaqt birikmasi.

examples.en: Short hair is in fashion now.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'is in fashion' - urfda ekanini bildiruvchi ibora; 'now' - vaqt ravishi.

uz: biror kim kiysa yaxshi ko'rinmoq, biror kimga yarashmoq
defEn: To look nice when a person is wearing it.
defUz: Biror kishi kiyganda chiroyli ko'rinmoq, yarashmoq.

examples.en: That shirt looks good on you
examples.uz: where did you buy it? – Bu ko'ylak sizga yarashibdi–qayerdan sotib
examples.grammar: 'That shirt looks good on you' - Present Simple, 'looks' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'look good on' ibora; 'where did you buy it?' - 'did' bilan so'roq gap (Past Simple).

examples.en: This dress looks good on you.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'looks' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'look good on' - ibora; 'on you' - 'on' predlogi.

uz: bejirim ko'rinmoq, bashang ko'rinmoq, elegant ko'rinmoq
defEn: To look clean, neat and well dressed.
defUz: Toza, ozoda va chiroyli kiyingan ko'rinmoq, bejirim ko'rinmoq.

examples.en: You look smart in those clothes. You could wear them for a party.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'You look smart in those clothes' - 'look + sifat' tuzilmasi; 'in those clothes' - 'in' predlogi, 'those' ko'plik olmoshi; 'You could wear them' - 'could' modal fe'li.

examples.en: You look smart in that suit.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'look smart' - 'look + sifat' tuzilmasi; 'in that suit' - 'in' predlogi o'rin bilan.

uz: eng so'nggi urf = hozirgi paytdagi urf
defEn: The newest fashion at the present time.
defUz: Hozirgi paytdagi eng yangi moda, eng so'nggi urf.

examples.en: I'm not interested in the latest style. I like old-fashioned clothes.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'I'm not interested in the latest style' - to be fe'li inkor, 'interested in' birikmasi; 'the latest' - 'the' aniq artikl bilan eng so'nggi ma'nosi; 'I like old-fashioned clothes' - Present Simple.

examples.en: She likes the latest style.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'likes' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'the' aniq artikl 'latest' bilan birga keladi.

uz: to'g'ri o'lcham, kerakli o'lcham, mos o'lcham
defEn: The correct size that fits a person well.
defUz: Kishiga yaxshi mos keladigan to'g'ri o'lcham.

examples.en: I like these trousers but they're not the right size for me.
examples.uz: Menga mana bu shim yoqdi, lekin u
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'I like these trousers' - 'these' ko'rsatish olmoshi ko'plikda; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi; 'they're not the right size for me' - to be fe'li inkor, 'the' aniq artikl, 'for me' predlog bilan.

examples.en: This shirt is the right size for me.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'is + the + sifat + ot' - to be fe'li; 'the' aniq artikl; 'for me' - 'for' predlogi.

uz: biror kim uchun haddan tashqari katta/kichik
defEn: Not the right size because it is bigger or smaller than a person needs.
defUz: Kishiga kerakligidan kattaroq yoki kichikroq bo'lgani uchun mos kelmaydigan.

examples.en: I've grown out of these dresses and they're too small for me now.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect va Present Simple; 'I've grown out of these dresses' - 'have + grown' Present Perfect, 'grow out of' phrasal fe'l; 'they're too small for me now' - 'too' ortiqcha daraja, 'for me' predlog bilan.

examples.en: These shoes are too small for me.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'are too small' - 'too' ortiqcha darajani bildiradi; 'for me' - 'for' predlogi shaxs bilan.

defEn: Red, blue, green and yellow are colours.
defUz: Qizil, ko'k, yashil va sariq - bu ranglar.

examples.en: What's your favourite colour?
examples.grammar: 'What's your favourite colour?' - 'what' bilan so'roq gap (Present Simple); 'your favourite' - egalik olmoshi va sifat; 'colour' - so'roq gapdagi ot.

examples.en: Blue is my favourite colour.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'is' - to be fe'li birlikda; 'my favourite' - egalik olmoshi va sifat otdan oldin.

defEn: Having many bright colours.
defUz: Ko'p yorqin ranglarga ega bo'lgan, rang-barang.

examples.en: That's a very colourful top you're wearing.
examples.uz: Siz kiyib olgan kofta juda rang-barang ekan.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous; 'That's a very colourful top' - to be fe'li, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'you're wearing' - Present Continuous (hozir kiyib turibsiz), sifatlovchi ergash gap.

examples.en: I have a colourful scarf.
examples.grammar: 'have + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'colourful' - sifat otdan oldin; 'a' artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: A nice feeling of being relaxed and free from pain.
defUz: Bemalol va og'riqsiz bo'lishning yoqimli hissi, qulaylik.

examples.en: Learn a new language in the comfort of your own home.
examples.grammar: 'Learn a new language in the comfort of your own home' - buyruq gap, 'learn' fe'l bilan boshlanadi; 'in the comfort of' birikma; 'your own home' - egalik olmoshi va 'own' kuchaytiruvchi.

examples.en: I like the comfort of my home.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'the comfort of' - birikma; 'my' egalik olmoshi; 'the' aniq artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: Not popular or in style at the present time.
defUz: Hozirgi paytda ommabop yoki urfda bo'lmagan, urfdan chiqqan.

examples.en: I don't care if my clothes are unfashionable. I'm not interested in fashion.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'I don't care if my clothes are unfashionable' - 'don't care' inkor, 'if' bilan ergash gap; 'I'm not interested in fashion' - to be fe'li inkor, 'interested in' birikmasi.

examples.en: This coat is unfashionable now.
examples.grammar: 'This + ot + is + sifat' - to be fe'li; 'unfashionable' - sifat; 'now' - vaqt ravishi.

defEn: Measuring a large amount from one end to the other.
defUz: Bir uchidan ikkinchi uchigacha katta masofani o'lchaydigan, uzun.

examples.en: It was the world's longest bridge.
examples.uz: U dunyodadagi eng uzun ko'prik edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'It was the world's longest bridge' - to be fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'was'; 'the world's' - egalik ('-'s); 'longest' - 'long' sifatining orttirma darajasi.

examples.en: She has long hair.
examples.grammar: 'has + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'long' - sifat otdan oldin keladi; 'has' - uchinchi shaxs birlik.

defEn: How long something is from one end to the other.
defUz: Biror narsaning bir uchidan ikkinchi uchigacha bo'lgan o'lchami, uzunlik.

examples.en: We need to know the length of the table before we buy it. It may be too big for the kitchen.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'We need to know the length of the table' - 'need + to + infinitiv'; 'the length of' birikma; 'It may be too big' - 'may' modal fe'li (ehtimol), 'too' ortiqcha daraja.

examples.en: What is the length of this room?
examples.grammar: 'what' bilan so'roq gap; 'is' - to be fe'li; 'the length of' - birikma; 'this' - ko'rsatish olmoshi.

defEn: True and not pretend or false.
defUz: Chin va yasama yoki yolg'on emas, haqiqiy.

examples.en: She never had any real friends at school.
examples.uz: Uning maktabda hech qachon chin do'stlari
examples.grammar: Past Simple inkor; 'She never had any real friends' - 'never' inkor ma'noli ravish, 'had' o'tgan zamon shakli; 'any' inkor gapda noaniq miqdor; 'real' sifat otdan oldin.

examples.en: This is a real gold ring.
examples.grammar: 'This is + a + sifat + ot' - to be fe'li; 'real' - sifat otdan oldin; 'a' artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: A way of dressing or doing something that is popular.
defUz: Ommabop bo'lgan kiyinish yoki biror ishni qilish usuli, fason.

examples.en: Short skirts are back in style.
examples.uz: Kalta yubkalar yana fasonda (= urfga qaytdi).
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'Short skirts are back in style' - to be fe'li ko'plikda; 'short' sifat otdan oldin; 'back in style' - urfga qaytganini bildiruvchi birikma.

examples.en: I like this style of coat.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'this style of' - birikma; 'this' - ko'rsatish olmoshi birlikda.

defEn: Fashionable and looking good.
defUz: Urfdagi va chiroyli ko'rinadigan, didli.

examples.en: You're looking very stylish today. Are those new clothes?
examples.grammar: Present Continuous va Present Simple; 'You're looking very stylish today' - 'are + looking' Present Continuous, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'Are those new clothes?' - 'are' bilan so'roq gap.

examples.en: She has a stylish bag.
examples.grammar: 'has + a + sifat + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'stylish' - sifat otdan oldin; 'a' artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: A new style or fashion that many people like.
defUz: Ko'pchilikka yoqadigan yangi uslub yoki moda, urf.

examples.en: Linen is on trend again this summer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'Linen is on trend again this summer' - to be fe'li, 'on trend' birikma (urfda); 'again' - takror ravishi; 'this summer' - vaqt birikmasi.

examples.en: Bright colours are a new trend.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'are' - to be fe'li ko'plikda; 'a new trend' - 'a' artikl sifatli otdan oldin.

defEn: Very fashionable and modern.
defUz: Juda urfdagi va zamonaviy, ommalashgan.

examples.en: We went to a trendy café. It was a very fashionable place.
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'We went to a trendy café' - 'went' 'go' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan zamon shakli; 'It was a very fashionable place' - to be fe'li 'was', 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: She wears trendy clothes.
