examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'wears' - uchinchi shaxs birlik '-s' bilan; 'trendy' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: The nice feeling of being warm.
defUz: Iliq bo'lishning yoqimli hissi, iliqlik.

examples.en: It was winter and I didn't want to get up and leave the warmth of my comfortable bed.
examples.grammar: Past Simple; 'It was winter' - to be fe'li 'was'; 'I didn't want to get up' - 'didn't want + to + infinitiv' inkor; 'the warmth of my comfortable bed' - 'the warmth of' birikma.

examples.en: I like the warmth of the fire.
examples.grammar: Present Simple; 'the warmth of' - birikma; 'the' aniq artikl otdan oldin.

defEn: Measuring a large amount from one side to the other.
defUz: Bir tomonidan ikkinchi tomoniga katta masofani o'lchaydigan, keng.

examples.en: How wide is the river?
examples.grammar: 'How wide is the river?' - 'how + sifat' bilan so'roq gap (Present Simple); 'is the river' - to be fe'li so'roq gapda otdan oldin keladi; 'wide' - sifat.

examples.en: This road is very wide.
examples.grammar: 'This + ot + is + sifat' - to be fe'li; 'very' - kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'wide' - sifat.

defEn: How wide something is from one side to the other.
defUz: Biror narsaning bir tomonidan ikkinchi tomoniga bo'lgan o'lchami, kenglik.

examples.en: Can you tell me the length and the width of this carpet?
examples.grammar: 'Can you tell me the length and the width of this carpet?' - 'can' modal fe'l bilan so'roq gap (iltimos); 'the length and the width' - 'and' bog'lovchisi, 'the' aniq artikllar; 'of this carpet' birikma.

examples.en: What is the width of this table?
examples.grammar: 'what' bilan so'roq gap; 'is' - to be fe'li; 'the width of' - birikma; 'this' - ko'rsatish olmoshi.

defEn: the person who is in charge of you at work
defUz: ishxonada sizga rahbarlik qiladigan odam

examples.en: My mum gets on very well with her boss at work.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'gets on well with' iborasi (phrasal verb) birov bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lishni bildiradi; 'her' - egalik olmoshi, 'at work' - joy predlogli ibora.

examples.en: My boss is a kind man.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot' - egalik bildiradi; 'is' - 'to be' fe'lining birlik shakli, 'a kind man' - artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: the work of buying and selling things to make money
defUz: pul topish uchun narsa sotib olish va sotish ishi

examples.en: I'd like to study and have my own business one day.
examples.uz: Men o'qishni va bir kun kelib o'z
examples.grammar: 'I'd like to + infinitiv' - xohishni muloyim bildiradi; 'and have' - 'to' takrorlanmaydigan ikkinchi fe'l; 'one day' - kelajakdagi noaniq vaqt iborasi.

examples.en: My uncle has a small business.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' egalikni bildiradi; 'a small business' - artikl + sifat + ot birikmasi.

defEn: a group of people who work together to sell things or services
defUz: narsa yoki xizmat sotish uchun birga ishlaydigan odamlar guruhi

examples.en: My mum works for a travel company in the city centre.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works for' birikmasi qayerda ishlashni bildiradi; 'a travel company' - artikl + ot aniqlovchi + ot; 'in the city centre' - joy predlogli ibora.

examples.en: She works for a big company.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'works' ga '-s' qo'shimchasi; 'for a big company' - predlog + artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a building where people make things with machines
defUz: odamlar mashinalar yordamida narsa ishlab chiqaradigan bino

examples.en: He works in a car factory.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works in' joyni bildiradi; 'a car factory' - artikl + ot aniqlovchi (car) + ot birikmasi.

examples.en: There is a big factory near my home.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + ot' - birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi; 'near my home' - joy predlogli ibora.

defEn: a doctor who looks after your teeth
defUz: tishlaringizni davolaydigan shifokor

examples.en: I went to the dentist to check my teeth.
examples.uz: Men tishlarimni tekshirtirish uchun tish shifokoriga
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'went' ('go' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'to the dentist' - yo'nalish predlogi; 'to check' - maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: The dentist is very kind.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot' - aniq artikl; 'is' - 'to be' fe'li, 'very kind' - ravish + sifat.

defEn: a person who makes plans for how things will look
defUz: narsalar qanday ko'rinishi haqida reja tuzadigan odam

examples.en: Designers work on many things. If you're creative, you will do well.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'work on' biror narsa ustida ishlashni bildiradi; ikkinchi gap shart mayli: 'If you are ..., you will ...' - 'will' kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

examples.en: My sister is a designer.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot' - egalik; 'is a designer' - 'to be' fe'li + artikl + ot.

defEn: a person who helps people who are ill
defUz: kasal odamlarga yordam beradigan kishi

examples.en: Being a doctor is good
examples.uz: you get a lot of money and you help people. – Shifokor bo'lish yaxshi–
examples.grammar: 'Being a doctor' - sifatdosh (gerund) bosh bo'lak vazifasida; 'is good' - 'to be' fe'li + sifat baho bildiradi.

examples.en: The doctor helps sick people.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'helps' ga '-s' qo'shimchasi; 'sick people' - sifat + ot.

defEn: a person who designs or builds machines, roads or bridges
defUz: mashina, yo'l yoki ko'priklarni loyihalaydigan yoki quradigan kishi

examples.en: I want to be an engineer. Then I will design a new car.
examples.grammar: 'want to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; 'be an engineer' - 'an' artikli unli tovush oldidan; ikkinchi gap Future: 'I will design' - 'will' kelasi zamon.

examples.en: My father is an engineer.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot' - egalik; 'is an engineer' - 'to be' fe'li + 'an' artikli (unli tovush oldidan) + ot.

defEn: a person whose job is to cut and style hair
defUz: ishi sochni kesish va shakl berish bo'lgan kishi

examples.en: A hairdresser cuts and styles people's hair.
examples.uz: Sartarosh odamlarning sochini kesadi va shakl
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'cuts' va 'styles' fe'llariga birlik 3-shaxs '-s' qo'shimchasi; 'people's hair' - egalik ('s) qo'shimchasi.

examples.en: The hairdresser cut my hair today.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'cut' fe'li o'zgarmaydi; 'my hair' - egalik olmoshi + ot, 'today' - vaqt ravishi.

defEn: a person who writes news for newspapers, TV or websites
defUz: gazeta, televideniye yoki vebsaytlar uchun yangiliklar yozadigan kishi

examples.en: A journalist writes things for newspapers or websites.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'writes' fe'liga birlik 3-shaxs '-s' qo'shimchasi; 'for newspapers or websites' - predlog + ot ko'plik shakli, 'or' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: The journalist writes good news.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'writes'; 'good news' - sifat + ot.

defEn: a person whose job is to help people with the law
defUz: ishi odamlarga qonun bo'yicha yordam berish bo'lgan kishi

examples.en: You need to know the law very well if you want to be a lawyer.
examples.grammar: 'need to + infinitiv' - zaruriyatni bildiradi; ikkinchi qism shart ergash gapi: 'if you want to be a lawyer' - 'if' bog'lovchisi shartni bildiradi.

examples.en: My friend wants to be a lawyer.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'wants to + infinitiv' xohishni bildiradi; 'a lawyer' - artikl + ot.

defEn: a person who looks after ill people in a hospital
defUz: kasalxonada bemorlarga qaraydigan kishi

examples.en: My aunt is a nurse. She works with doctors in the hospital in town.
examples.grammar: Birinchi gap 'to be' fe'li bilan: 'My aunt is a nurse'; ikkinchi gap Present Simple 'works with' + 'in the hospital' joy predlogli iboralar.

examples.en: The nurse helps the doctor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'helps'; 'the doctor' - aniq artikl + ot.

defEn: a person who welcomes people at the front desk of an office or hotel
defUz: ofis yoki mehmonxona qabulxonasida odamlarni kutib oladigan kishi

examples.en: My sister works as a receptionist in an office.
examples.uz: Singlim bir ofisda sekretar bo'lib ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works as' birikmasi kasbni bildiradi; 'a receptionist' - artikl + ot, 'in an office' - 'an' artikli unli tovush oldidan + joy predlogi.

examples.en: The receptionist is very polite.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot' - aniq artikl; 'is' - 'to be' fe'li, 'very polite' - ravish + sifat.

defEn: a person who helps customers in a shop
defUz: do'konda xaridorlarga yordam beradigan kishi

examples.en: I work in a department store as a part-time shop assistant.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'work in' joyni bildiradi; 'as a part-time shop assistant' - 'as' birikmasi rolni bildiradi, 'a' artikli + sifat + ot.

examples.en: The shop assistant helps me find shoes.
examples.uz: Sotuvchi menga poyabzal topishda yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'helps'; 'find shoes' - 'help + obyekt + infinitiv (tosiz)' tuzilmasi.

defEn: a person who shows tourists around a place
defUz: sayyohlarga biror joyni ko'rsatib yuradigan kishi

examples.en: I work as a tour guide in Saint Petersburg.
examples.uz: Men Sent Pitersburgda (= tarixda Leningrad bo'lgan)
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'work as' birikmasi kasbni bildiradi; 'as a tour guide' - artikl + ot, 'in Saint Petersburg' - joy predlogli ibora.

examples.en: The tour guide shows us the old city.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'shows'; 'us' - obyekt olmoshi, 'the old city' - aniq artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a person who brings food and drinks to people in a restaurant
defUz: restoranda odamlarga ovqat va ichimlik keltiradigan kishi

examples.en: My elder brother has a part-time job as a waiter in our local café.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has a part-time job' egalikni bildiradi; 'as a waiter' - 'as' rolni bildiradi, 'in our local cafe' - egalik olmoshi + sifat + ot.

examples.en: The waiter brings us the food.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'brings'; 'us' - obyekt olmoshi, 'the food' - aniq artikl + ot.

defEn: a person who is in charge of a business or a team
defUz: biznes yoki guruhga rahbarlik qiladigan kishi

examples.en: I'd like to speak to the manager.
examples.uz: Men ish boshqaruvchi bilan gaplashishni xohlayman.
examples.grammar: 'I'd like to + infinitiv' - muloyim xohishni bildiradi; 'speak to' - predlogli fe'l, 'the manager' - aniq artikl + ot.

examples.en: The manager works in a big office.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'works'; 'in a big office' - predlog + artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a room or building where people work at desks
defUz: odamlar stollar yonida ishlaydigan xona yoki bino

examples.en: I want to work outdoors. I think it'll be boring if I work in an office.
examples.grammar: 'I want to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; ikkinchi gapda 'it'll be' ('it will be') Future zamon + 'if I work in an office' shart ergash gapi.

examples.en: My mother works in an office.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'works'; 'in an office' - 'an' artikli unli tovush oldidan + joy predlogi.

defEn: all the people who work for a company or place
defUz: biror kompaniya yoki joyda ishlaydigan barcha odamlar

examples.en: We've got a big staff at my company
examples.grammar: Present Perfect - 'We've got' ('we have got') egalikni bildiradi; 'a big staff' - artikl + sifat + ot, 'at my company' - joy predlogli ibora.

examples.en: The staff are very friendly.
examples.grammar: 'staff' jamoa oti ko'plikda olinadi - 'are' ko'plik shakli; 'very friendly' - ravish + sifat.

defEn: a job or the things you do to earn money
defUz: ish yoki pul topish uchun qiladigan narsalaringiz

examples.en: It's important to have work but you need free time too.
examples.uz: Ishli bo'lish muhim, lekin bo'sh vaqt
examples.grammar: 'It's important to + infinitiv' - baho bildiruvchi tuzilma; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi, 'you need free time too' - 'too' ravish 'ham' ma'nosida.

examples.en: I go to work every day.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go to work' odatiy harakat; 'every day' - vaqt ravishi.

defEn: to ask for a job or place, usually in writing
defUz: odatda yozma ravishda ish yoki joy so'ramoq

examples.en: My dad is a teacher and he's going to apply for a job at my school.
examples.grammar: 'be going to + infinitiv' - rejalashtirilgan kelasi zamonni bildiradi; 'apply for a job' - predlogli fe'l, 'at my school' - joy predlogli ibora.

examples.en: I want to apply for a new job.
examples.grammar: 'want to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; 'apply for' - predlogli fe'l, 'a new job' - artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: to take action to do something about a problem
defUz: muammoni hal qilish uchun chora ko'rmoq

examples.en: A police officer has to deal with difficult problems daily.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has to + infinitiv' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'deal with' - predlogli fe'l, 'difficult problems' - sifat + ot ko'plik, 'daily' - vaqt ravishi.

examples.en: A teacher must deal with many questions.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi ko'p savollar bilan shug'ullanishi kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must + infinitiv' - majburiyatni bildiradi; 'deal with' - predlogli fe'l, 'many questions' - sifat + ot ko'plik.

defEn: to plan how something will look or work
defUz: biror narsa qanday ko'rinishi yoki ishlashini rejalashtirmoq

examples.en: I want to design computer games when I finish school.
examples.grammar: 'I want to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; 'computer games' - ot aniqlovchi + ot ko'plik; 'when I finish school' - vaqt ergash gapi.

examples.en: I want to design a new house.
examples.grammar: 'want to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; 'a new house' - artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: to get money for the work you do
defUz: qilgan ishingiz uchun pul olmoq

examples.en: Do you know how much money your dad earns from his job?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple yordamchi fe'l 'Do you know'; ichida 'how much money your dad earns' so'roq ergash gapi, 'earns' birlik 3-shaxs '-s'.

examples.en: I want to earn a lot of money.
examples.grammar: 'want to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; 'a lot of money' - ko'plikni bildiruvchi miqdor iborasi.

defEn: to give money for something
defUz: biror narsa uchun pul bermoq

examples.en: My parents pay the bills every month.
examples.uz: Ota-onam har oyda iste'mol to'lovlarini (= suv, svet, gaz,
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'pay the bills' odatiy harakat; 'the bills' - aniq artikl + ot ko'plik, 'every month' - vaqt ravishi.

examples.en: I pay for my lunch every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni tushligim uchun pul to'layman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'pay for' predlogli fe'l; 'every day' - vaqt ravishi.

defEn: to bring food or drinks to people
defUz: odamlarga ovqat yoki ichimlik tortmoq

examples.en: I work as a waiter at weekends. My job is to serve food and drinks.
examples.grammar: Birinchi gap Present Simple 'I work as a waiter'; ikkinchi gap 'My job is to + infinitiv' - vazifani bildiradi, 'food and drinks' - 'and' bog'lovchili ot birikmasi.

examples.en: The waiter serves hot food.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'serves'; 'hot food' - sifat + ot.

defEn: to give medical care to someone who is ill
defUz: kasal odamga tibbiy yordam ko'rsatmoq, davolamoq

examples.en: The doctor treated my dad for a bad cold.
examples.uz: Shifokor dadamni kuchli shamollash uchun davoladi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'treated' fe'liga '-ed' qo'shimchasi o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'for a bad cold' - sabab predlogi 'for' + sifat + ot.

examples.en: The doctor treats sick people.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'treats'; 'sick people' - sifat + ot ko'plik.

defEn: able to learn and understand things quickly
defUz: narsalarni tez o'rganadigan va tushunadigan

examples.en: You have to be clever and work hard to pass all your exams.
examples.grammar: 'have to be + sifat' - zaruriyatni bildiradi; 'and work hard' - 'and' bog'lovchi, 'to pass all your exams' - maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: My sister is very clever.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot' - egalik; 'is' - 'to be' fe'li, 'very clever' - ravish + sifat.

uz: yaratuvchan, o'zgacha fikrlaydigan, yangi g'oyalarga boy
defEn: good at making new things or having new ideas
defUz: yangi narsalar yaratish yoki yangi g'oyalarga ega bo'lishda usta

examples.en: Designers need to be creative
examples.uz: you have to have good ideas. – Dizaynerlar yaratuvchan bo'lishi
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'need to be + sifat' zaruriyatni bildiradi; 'Designers' - ot ko'plik shakli ega vazifasida.

examples.en: She is a creative girl.
examples.grammar: 'is a creative girl' - 'to be' fe'li + artikl + sifat + ot.

uz: mustaqil, bir necha joyga xizmat ko'rsatuvchi
defEn: working for different companies, not just one
defUz: faqat bittasi emas, balki turli kompaniyalar uchun ishlaydigan

examples.en: If you are a freelance designer, you can work for different companies.
examples.grammar: Shart ergash gap - 'If you are a freelance designer, you can ...'; 'can work' - modal fe'l 'can' imkoniyatni bildiradi, 'for different companies' - predlog + sifat + ot ko'plik.

examples.en: He is a freelance writer.
examples.grammar: 'is a freelance writer' - 'to be' fe'li + artikl + sifat + ot.

uz: to'liq smenada ertalabdan kechgacha ishlovchi, to'liq stavkali
defEn: for all the normal working hours of a week
defUz: haftaning barcha odatiy ish soatlari davomida

examples.en: A full-time job is usually about 40 hours a week.
examples.uz: To'liq stavkali ish odatda haftasiga 40 soat
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'A full-time job is + about 40 hours' baho bildiradi; 'a week' - vaqt birligi predlogsiz ibora ('haftasiga').

examples.en: My father has a full-time job.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' egalikni bildiradi; 'a full-time job' - artikl + sifat + ot.

uz: yarim smenada ishlovchi, yarim stavkali (misol uchun maktab yoki universitet darslaridan keyin)
defEn: for only some of the normal working hours of a week
defUz: haftaning faqat ba'zi odatiy ish soatlari davomida

examples.en: A part-time job may be 10 or 20 hours a week.
examples.uz: Yarim stavkali ish haftasiga 10 yoki 20 soat
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'A part-time job may be ...' bahoni bildiradi; 'may' modal fe'l ehtimolni bildiradi, '10 or 20 hours' - 'or' bog'lovchili miqdor.

examples.en: She has a part-time job at the shop.
examples.uz: Uning do'konda yarim stavkali ishi bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' egalikni bildiradi; 'at the shop' - joy predlogli ibora.

defEn: able to be trusted to do the right thing
defUz: to'g'ri ish qilishiga ishonsa bo'ladigan, mas'uliyatli

examples.en: You must be responsible if you want to work with children.
examples.grammar: 'must be + sifat' - majburiyatni bildiradi; 'if you want to work with children' - shart ergash gapi, 'work with' - predlogli fe'l.

examples.en: She is a responsible girl.
examples.grammar: 'is a responsible girl' - 'to be' fe'li + artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: helpful for doing something
defUz: biror ishni qilishga yordam beradigan, foydali

examples.en: A good computer is very useful.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'A good computer is + sifat'; 'very useful' - ravish + sifat baho bildiradi.

examples.en: This book is very useful.
examples.grammar: 'This + ot' - ko'rsatish olmoshi + ot; 'is very useful' - 'to be' fe'li + ravish + sifat.

defEn: giving a lot of money for the work
defUz: ish uchun ko'p pul to'lanadigan

examples.en: A doctor has a well-paid job. They earn a lot of money.
examples.grammar: Birinchi gap Present Simple 'A doctor has a well-paid job'; ikkinchi gap 'They earn a lot of money' - 'They' ko'plik olmoshi, 'a lot of money' miqdor iborasi.

examples.en: An engineer has a well-paid job.
examples.uz: Muhandisning yaxshi haq to'lanadigan ishi bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' egalikni bildiradi; 'an' artikli unli tovush oldidan, 'a well-paid job' - artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: to be the person who controls or looks after something
defUz: biror narsani nazorat qiladigan yoki unga mas'ul kishi bo'lmoq

examples.en: The manager is in charge of this office. Do you want to speak to him?
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is in charge of' iborasi mas'ullikni bildiradi; ikkinchi gap so'roq gap 'Do you want to speak to him?' - yordamchi fe'l 'Do', 'him' obyekt olmoshi.

examples.en: She is in charge of the team.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is in charge of' iborasi; 'the team' - aniq artikl + ot.

defEn: to get work that you are paid for
defUz: haq to'lanadigan ish topmoq yoki ega bo'lmoq

examples.en: When I leave school, I'm going to find a job.
examples.grammar: 'When I leave school' - vaqt ergash gapi (Present Simple kelasi ma'noda); bosh gap 'I'm going to find a job' - 'be going to' rejalashtirilgan kelasi zamon.

examples.en: I want to find a good job.
examples.grammar: 'want to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; 'a good job' - artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: to control or manage a business, company or shop
defUz: biznes, kompaniya yoki do'konni boshqarmoq, yuritmoq

examples.en: My dad works hard
examples.uz: he runs a business and he is always at the office! – Dadam qattiq ishlaydi–u
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works hard'; 'runs a business' birlik 3-shaxs '-s'; 'is always at the office' - 'always' takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: My uncle runs a small shop.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'runs'; 'a small shop' - artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: to put on special clothes for school or work
defUz: maktab yoki ish uchun maxsus kiyim kiymoq

examples.en: Do pupils have to wear a uniform at your school?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple yordamchi fe'l 'Do'; 'have to wear' majburiyatni bildiradi, 'at your school' - joy predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Nurses wear a uniform at work.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'Nurses' ko'plik ega, 'wear' qo'shimchasiz; 'at work' - joy predlogli ibora.

defEn: to have the job of a doctor, teacher, etc
defUz: shifokor, o'qituvchi va hokazo bo'lib ishlamoq

examples.en: My uncle works as a teacher at a school in Leeds.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works as' birikmasi kasbni bildiradi; 'a teacher' - artikl + ot, 'at a school in Leeds' - joy predloglari, 'Leeds' joy nomi.

examples.en: She works as a nurse in the city.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works as' kasbni bildiradi; 'in the city' - joy predlogli ibora.

defEn: to have a job at a company
defUz: biror kompaniyada ishlaydigan bo'lmoq

examples.en: When you work for a company, you have to follow their rules.
examples.grammar: 'When you work for a company' - vaqt ergash gapi; bosh gap 'you have to follow their rules' - 'have to' majburiyat, 'their' egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: My brother works for a big company.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'works'; 'for a big company' - predlog + artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: to put a lot of effort into your work
defUz: ishingizga ko'p kuch sarflamoq, tirishib ishlamoq

examples.en: If you work hard at this job, they'll give you more money.
examples.grammar: Shart ergash gap - 'If you work hard at this job, ...'; bosh gapda 'they'll give' ('they will give') Future zamon, 'more money' qiyosiy miqdor.

examples.en: You must work hard to pass the test.
examples.uz: Imtihondan o'tish uchun tirishib ishlashingiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must + infinitiv' - majburiyatni bildiradi; 'to pass the test' - maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: to have a job in a factory, office, plant, etc
defUz: fabrika, ofis, zavod va hokazoda ishlamoq

examples.en: Roman works in a factory near Rostov-on-Don.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works in' joyni bildiradi; birlik 3-shaxs '-s'; 'near Rostov-on-Don' - joy predlogli ibora.

examples.en: My father works in a factory.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'works'; 'in a factory' - joy predlogli ibora.

defEn: always telling other people what to do
defUz: doimo boshqalarga nima qilishni aytib turadigan

examples.en: She's really bossy
examples.uz: she always tells us to do things! – U xo'jayinchilik qilishni juda yoqtiradi–u har
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'She's' ('She is') + sifat 'bossy'; 'really' - kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: My brother is very bossy.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot' - egalik; 'is' - 'to be' fe'li, 'very bossy' - ravish + sifat.

defEn: having a lot of things to do
defUz: qiladigan ishi ko'p, band

examples.en: The principal is a very busy woman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'The principal is + sifat'; 'a very busy woman' - artikl + ravish + sifat + ot.

examples.en: My mother is very busy today.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot' - egalik; 'is' - 'to be' fe'li, 'very busy' - ravish + sifat, 'today' - vaqt ravishi.

defEn: a man who works in business
defUz: biznes bilan shug'ullanadigan erkak

examples.en: Sam is a businessman. He runs his own company.
examples.uz: Sem biznesmen. U o'z shaxsiy kompaniyasini
examples.grammar: Birinchi gap Present Simple 'Sam is a businessman'; ikkinchi gap 'He runs his own company' - birlik 3-shaxs 'runs', 'his own' egalik + 'own' kuchaytiruvchi so'z.

examples.en: The businessman has a big company.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' egalikni bildiradi; 'a big company' - artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a woman who works in business
defUz: biznes bilan shug'ullanadigan ayol

examples.en: She's a successful businesswoman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'She's' ('She is') + 'a successful businesswoman'; artikl + sifat + ot birikmasi.

examples.en: My aunt is a businesswoman.
examples.grammar: 'My + ot' - egalik; 'is a businesswoman' - 'to be' fe'li + artikl + ot.

defEn: to be in charge of a business, team or place
defUz: biznes, guruh yoki joyni boshqarmoq

examples.en: I think that Forestry Tasmania manages the forest.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'I think that ...' - 'that' bog'lovchili ergash gap; 'Forestry Tasmania manages the forest' - birlik 3-shaxs 'manages' ga '-s' qo'shimchasi.

examples.en: She manages a small shop.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - birlik 3-shaxs 'manages'; 'a small shop' - artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: the place near the entrance of a hotel or office where people are welcomed
defUz: mehmonxona yoki ofis kirish joyidagi odamlar kutib olinadigan joy

examples.en: I've left the keys at reception.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect - 'I've left' ('I have left') yaqinda bajarilgan harakat; 'the keys' - aniq artikl + ot ko'plik, 'at reception' - joy predlogli ibora.

examples.en: Please wait at reception.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'wait' fe'li bosh shaklda; 'Please' muloyimlik so'zi, 'at reception' joy predlogli ibora.

defEn: a person who works, especially with their hands or in a factory
defUz: ishlaydigan kishi, ayniqsa qo'l bilan yoki fabrikada

examples.en: My dad is an office manager. There are 15 workers working for him.
examples.grammar: Birinchi gap 'My dad is an office manager'; ikkinchi gap 'There are 15 workers working for him' - 'There are' ko'plik bor, 'working' sifatdosh, 'for him' predlog + obyekt olmoshi.

examples.en: The workers start at eight o'clock.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'workers' ko'plik ega, 'start' qo'shimchasiz; 'at eight o'clock' - vaqt predlogli ibora.

defEn: a person who acts in films, plays or on television
defUz: kino, spektakl yoki teledagi rollarni ijro etadigan shaxs.

examples.en: The actors and actresses in that film were very good, weren't they?
examples.grammar: 'The + ot (ko'plik) + were ...' - Past Simple, gap 'weren't they?' so'roq qo'shimchasi (tail question) bilan tugaydi.

examples.en: My sister is a good actor.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l birlikdagi shaxsni tasvirlaydi.

defEn: a person who makes art, for example paintings
defUz: san'at asari, masalan rasm yaratadigan shaxs.

examples.en: Kandinsky was a brilliant artist who painted amazing pictures.
examples.grammar: 'ot + was + a + sifat + ot + who ...' - Past Simple ('was'), 'who' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni bosh gapga bog'laydi.

examples.en: She is a famous artist.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l birlikdagi egani sifatlaydi.

defEn: a person who travels to new places to learn about them
defUz: yangi joylarni o'rganish uchun u yerlarga sayohat qiladigan shaxs.

examples.en: I want to be an explorer and discover new places.
examples.grammar: 'I want to + infinitiv ...' - Present Simple, 'want to' dan keyin fe'lning infinitiv shakli ('be') keladi.

examples.en: The explorer found a new place.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + fe'l (Past Simple)' - 'found' o'tgan zamondagi tartibsiz fe'l, 'the' artikli aniq otni bildiradi.

defEn: a person who makes something new for the first time
defUz: biror yangi narsani birinchi marta yaratadigan shaxs.

examples.en: Alexander Graham Bell was the inventor of the telephone, wasn't he?
examples.grammar: 'ot + was + the + ot + of + ot' - Past Simple, 'wasn't he?' so'roq qo'shimchasi (tail question) bilan tasdiq so'raladi.

examples.en: He is a great inventor.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l birlikdagi shaxsni tasvirlaydi.

defEn: a man who rules a country
defUz: mamlakatni boshqaradigan erkak hukmdor.

examples.en: Who was the King of England in 1066?
examples.grammar: 'Who + was + the + ot + of ...?' - Past Simple so'roq gap, 'who' so'roq olmoshi ega vazifasida keladi.

examples.en: The king lives in a big palace.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + fe'l (-s) + in + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, birlikdagi egaga fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

defEn: a person who works in the government of a country
defUz: mamlakat hukumatida ishlaydigan shaxs.

examples.en: Politicians usually help rule a country.
examples.grammar: 'ot (ko'plik) + usually + fe'l ...' - Present Simple, 'usually' takrorlanish ravishi fe'ldan oldin keladi.

examples.en: The politician talks to the people.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + fe'l (-s) + to + the + ot' - Present Simple, birlikdagi egaga fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi, 'to' predlog.

defEn: a woman who rules a country
defUz: mamlakatni boshqaradigan ayol hukmdor.

examples.en: Queen Victoria ruled Britain from 1837 to 1901.
examples.grammar: 'ot + fe'l (Past Simple) + from ... to ...' - o'tgan zamon, 'from ... to ...' vaqt oralig'ini bildiradi.

examples.en: The queen has a big crown.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + has + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'has' egalikni bildiradi (birlik).

defEn: a person who plays a sport
defUz: sport bilan shug'ullanadigan shaxs.

examples.en: Can you earn a lot of money as a sportsman?
examples.uz: Sportchi bo'lib ko'p pul topa olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Can + you + fe'l ...?' - modal fe'l 'can' bilan tuzilgan so'roq gap, 'as a ot' rolni bildiradi.

examples.en: The sportsman runs every day.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + fe'l (-s) + every day' - Present Simple, 'every day' takrorlanishni bildiradi, fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

defEn: a person who writes books or stories
defUz: kitob yoki hikoyalar yozadigan shaxs.

examples.en: I want to be a writer. I want to write stories like Turgenev.
examples.grammar: 'I want to + infinitiv. I want to + infinitiv ...' - Present Simple, 'want to' dan keyin fe'lning infinitiv shakli keladi.

examples.en: The writer wrote a good book.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + fe'l (Past Simple)' - 'wrote' o'tgan zamondagi tartibsiz fe'l.

defEn: a place with walls and a roof, like a house or office
defUz: devorlari va tomi bor joy, masalan uy yoki ofis.

examples.en: There are lots of famous buildings in London.
examples.grammar: 'There are + ot (ko'plik) + in + joy' - Present Simple, 'There are' ko'plikda narsalar borligini bildiradi.

examples.en: This building is very tall.
examples.grammar: 'This + ot + is + very + sifat' - Present Simple, 'this' ko'rsatish olmoshi, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a large strong old building where kings and queens lived
defUz: qirol va qirolichalar yashagan katta, mustahkam, qadimiy bino.

examples.en: There are lots of old castles in Europe.
examples.grammar: 'There are + ot (ko'plik) + in + joy' - Present Simple, 'There are' ko'plikda narsalar borligini bildiradi.

examples.en: The castle is very old.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + is + very + sifat' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a very big and important church
defUz: juda katta va muhim cherkov.

examples.en: A cathedral is a very big church.
examples.grammar: 'A + ot + is + a + very + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, ta'rif beradi, 'a' artikli umumiy otni bildiradi.

examples.en: We saw a big cathedral.
examples.grammar: 'We + fe'l (Past Simple) + a + sifat + ot' - o'tgan zamon, 'saw' tartibsiz fe'l.

defEn: a place where you can see old and important things
defUz: qadimiy va muhim narsalarni ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan joy.

examples.en: I love trips to the museum because History is my favourite subject.
examples.grammar: 'I love + ot + because ...' - Present Simple, 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni bildiruvchi ergash gapni qo'shadi.

examples.en: We went to the museum yesterday.
examples.grammar: 'We + fe'l (Past Simple) + to + the + ot + yesterday' - o'tgan zamon, 'yesterday' o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: a very big house where a king or queen lives
defUz: qirol yoki qirolicha yashaydigan juda katta uy.

examples.en: We heard a story about a king who lived in a very big palace.
examples.grammar: 'We + fe'l (Past Simple) + about + a + ot + who ...' - o'tgan zamon, 'who' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni bosh gapga bog'laydi.

examples.en: The palace is very big.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + is + very + sifat' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a figure of a person made of stone or metal
defUz: tosh yoki metaldan yasalgan odam tasviri.

examples.en: One day, if you're famous, they'll build a statue of you!
examples.uz: Bir kun kelib, agar mashhur bo'lib
examples.grammar: 'if + you're + sifat, they'll + fe'l ...' - shart mayli, 'if' ergash gap, bosh gapda 'will' (they'll) kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

examples.en: There is a big statue in the park.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + sifat + ot + in + the + ot' - Present Simple, 'There is' birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi.

defEn: a tall narrow building or part of a building
defUz: baland va ingichka bino yoki binoning bir qismi.

examples.en: Some old castles have towers that you can climb up.
examples.grammar: 'Some + ot (ko'plik) + have + ot + that ...' - Present Simple, 'that' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni qo'shadi, 'can' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The tower is very tall.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + is + very + sifat' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a thing you get for winning or doing well
defUz: yutgan yoki yaxshi natija ko'rsatgan uchun beriladigan narsa.

examples.en: Did you win a prize for coming first in the race?
examples.grammar: 'Did + you + fe'l + a + ot + for + ...?' - Past Simple so'roq gap, 'did' yordamchi fe'l, asosiy fe'l asl shaklida qoladi.

examples.en: She won the first prize.
examples.grammar: 'She + fe'l (Past Simple) + the + sifat + ot' - o'tgan zamon, 'won' tartibsiz fe'l.

defEn: a very famous singer, actor or sportsperson
defUz: juda mashhur qo'shiqchi, aktyor yoki sportchi.

examples.en: I want to become a singer but not a star. I don't want to be famous.
examples.grammar: 'I want to + infinitiv + but not + a + ot. I don't want to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'don't' inkor shakli, 'but' qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: She is a big film star.
examples.grammar: 'She + is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l birlikdagi egani tasvirlaydi.

uz: diqqatga sazovor joy, sayyohlar ko'p tashrif buyuradigan joy
defEn: a place that many tourists like to visit
defUz: ko'p sayyohlar tashrif buyurishni yoqtiradigan joy.

examples.en: Red Square is the biggest tourist attraction in Moscow.
examples.grammar: 'ot + is + the + orttirma daraja + ot + in + joy' - Present Simple, 'the biggest' orttirma daraja eng yuqori belgini bildiradi.

examples.en: The tower is a famous tourist attraction.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l aniq otni tasvirlaydi.

defEn: the best result in the world for something
defUz: biror narsa bo'yicha dunyodagi eng yaxshi natija.

examples.en: Which athlete holds the world record for the 100-metre race?
examples.grammar: 'Which + ot + fe'l (-s) + the + ot + for ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'which' so'roq olmoshi tanlovni so'raydi, fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi.

examples.en: He broke the world record.
examples.grammar: 'He + fe'l (Past Simple) + the + ot' - o'tgan zamon, 'broke' tartibsiz fe'l.

defEn: to make something new
defUz: biror yangi narsa yaratmoq.

examples.en: I'd like to create a new kind of mobile phone.
examples.uz: Men uyali telefonning yangi turini yaratishni
examples.grammar: 'I'd like to + infinitiv + a + sifat + ot' - 'would like to' (I'd like to) xohishni bildiradi, undan keyin fe'l infinitivi keladi.

examples.en: I want to create a new game.
examples.grammar: 'I + want to + infinitiv + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'want to' dan keyin fe'l infinitivi keladi.

defEn: to find something for the first time
defUz: biror narsani birinchi marta topmoq.

examples.en: Do you know who discovered America?
examples.grammar: 'Do + you + know + who + fe'l (Past Simple) ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'who' bilvosita so'roq ergash gapni qo'shadi.

examples.en: We can discover new things at school.
examples.uz: Biz maktabda yangi narsalarni kashf qila olamiz.
examples.grammar: 'We + can + fe'l + sifat + ot + at + ot' - modal fe'l 'can' dan keyin fe'l asl shaklida keladi.

defEn: to enter a place
defUz: biror joyning ichiga kirmoq.

examples.en: I didn't want to go in the classroom and do my exams!
examples.grammar: 'I didn't want to + infinitiv ...' - Past Simple inkor, 'didn't' yordamchi fe'l, undan keyin fe'l asl shaklida qoladi.

examples.en: Let's go in the house.
examples.grammar: 'Let's + fe'l + the + ot' - buyruq/taklif gap, 'let's' birgalikda harakatni taklif qiladi.

uz: sahna asari ko'rsatmoq, tomosha qo'ymoq, spektakl qo'ymoq; (rol) ijro etmoq
defEn: to act, sing or play in front of people
defUz: odamlar oldida o'ynamoq, qo'shiq aytmoq yoki ijro etmoq.

examples.en: Do you think it is difficult to perform in front of people in a theatre?
examples.grammar: 'Do you think + it is + sifat + to + infinitiv + in front of ...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'to perform' infinitiv, 'in front of' predlog birikmasi.

examples.en: The children perform a play at school.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot (ko'plik) + fe'l + a + ot + at + ot' - Present Simple, ko'plikdagi egaga fe'l asl shaklida qoladi.

defEn: to control a country or its people
defUz: mamlakat yoki uning xalqini boshqarmoq.

examples.en: The queen ruled the country for many years.

examples.en: Good afternoon, listeners! Welcome to the programme!
examples.grammar: 'Good afternoon, + ko'plik ot!' - undalma (murojaat); 'listeners' otining ko'plik shakli '-s' bilan yasalgan.

examples.en: She is a good listener.
examples.grammar: 'is + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simpleda 'is' to be shakli; 'good' sifat 'listener' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: to say words and talk to someone
defUz: so'zlarni aytmoq va biror kishi bilan gaplashmoq

examples.en: You must speak loudly and clearly on the stage.
examples.uz: Sahnada baland ovozda va tiniq gapirishingiz
examples.grammar: 'You must speak + loudly and clearly + on + the + ot' - 'must' modal fe'li majburiyatni bildiradi; 'loudly', 'clearly' ravishlar.

examples.en: I speak English with my teacher.
examples.uz: Men o'qituvchim bilan ingliz tilida gaplashaman.
examples.grammar: 'speak + ot + with + ot' - Present Simpleda odatiy ish; 'with' predlogi kim bilanligini bildiradi.

defEn: a talk that one person gives to a group of people
defUz: bir kishi bir guruh odamga so'zlaydigan nutq

examples.en: Are you worried about giving your speech tomorrow?
examples.grammar: 'Are you worried about + giving + your + ot + tomorrow' - so'roq gap ('Are you...'); 'about' dan keyin gerund ('giving') keladi.

examples.en: He gave a short speech at the party.
examples.grammar: 'gave + a + sifat + ot' - Past Simpleda 'gave' o'tgan ish; 'short' sifat 'speech' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: a person who is talking, especially to a group of people
defUz: gapirayotgan odam, ayniqsa bir guruh odam oldida

examples.en: The manager was the first speaker at the meeting.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + was + the + sifatning orttirma darajasi + ot + at + the + ot' - Past Simpleda 'was' to be o'tgan shakli; 'first' tartib son.

examples.en: The speaker talked about the internet.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + talked about + ot' - Past Simpleda o'tgan ish; 'about' predlogi mavzuni bildiradi.

defEn: to sign up so you get videos, news or other things regularly
defUz: video, yangilik yoki boshqa narsalarni muntazam olish uchun ro'yxatdan o'tmoq

examples.en: To hear the full interview, subscribe to the free National Geographic News podcast.
examples.grammar: 'To hear + ..., subscribe to + the + sifat + ot' - buyruq gap; 'To hear' infinitivi maqsadni bildiradi; 'subscribe to' predlogli fe'l.

examples.en: I subscribe to a video channel.
examples.uz: Men bitta video kanalga obuna bo'laman.
examples.grammar: 'subscribe to + a + ot' - Present Simpleda odatiy ish; 'to' fe'l bilan keladigan predlog.

defEn: an agreement to pay so you get something regularly
defUz: biror narsani muntazam olish uchun to'lashga kelishuv

examples.en: Do you have to have a subscription to that music website to listen to music?
examples.grammar: 'Do you have to have + a + ot + to + that + ot + ...' - so'roq gap; 'have to' zaruratni bildiradi; 'to' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I pay for a music subscription every month.
examples.uz: Men har oy musiqa obunasi uchun to'layman.
examples.grammar: 'pay for + a + ot' - Present Simpleda odatiy ish; 'for' predlogi nima uchunligini bildiradi.

defEn: a person who has signed up to get something regularly
defUz: biror narsani muntazam olish uchun ro'yxatdan o'tgan odam

examples.en: There are over 5,000 subscribers to this website.
examples.grammar: 'There are over + son + ot + to + this + ot' - 'there are' ko'plikda narsa borligini bildiradi; 'over' predlogi (dan ortiq) ma'nosini bildiradi.

examples.en: This channel has many subscribers.
examples.grammar: 'has + many + ot' - Present Simpleda 'has' egalikni bildiradi; 'many' sanaladigan otlar bilan keladi.
